Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B-Eligibility Factors (FITAP) Section No./Name B-1800 Drug Testing (FITAP) Document No./Name B-1850-FITAP Coordination with OBH Effective Date February 1, 2013

1 of 1 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

OBH will advise the worker of the results of their assessment.

OBH will determine whether the recipient’s participation in the recommended treatment program is satisfactory and will notify the worker if it is determined to be unsatisfactory.

Prior to a determination that the recipient has failed to participate, OBH and ES will work together to encourage the recipient to satisfactorily participate through a collaborative intervention.

II. PROCEDURES

If OBH determines that the recipient is not using or dependent on illegal drugs, no further action is necessary unless subsequent screening or other reasonable cause indicates use of or dependence on illegal drugs. If OBH determines a substance abuse problem other than illegal drugs, encourage the client to take advantage of OBH’s proposal treatment plan; however, a penalty for failure to participate is not applicable.

If OBH determines that the recipient is using or is dependent on illegal drugs, an education, treatment and rehabilitation plan will be established by OBH staff.

If OBH recommends residential treatment and the recipient is unable to arrange for the temporary care of dependent children, Economic Stability Section and/or OBH will coordinate with the Child Welfare Section to arrange for the care of such children.

OBH will determine whether the recipient is able to participate in work activities while under treatment and rehabilitation and will advise the worker of the decision. If OBH determines that the individual is unable to participate while involved in treatment, a good cause determination is appropriate.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

* There are no forms or instructions associated with this policy.

1 of 1 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

Supportive services to enable an applicant or recipient to participate in the screening, education, treatment and/or rehabilitation program are provided through STEP Supportive Services.

II. PROCEDURES

B-1861-FITAP - PR CHILD CARE

If it is determined that the client will need child care to participate in the OBH assessment or the education, treatment and rehabilitation program recommended by OBH, assist the client in making arrangements for needed child care by referring the client to the Louisiana Department of Education (LDE) for services. Contact information for the LDE/Child Care can be found at: http://www.louisianabelieves.com/early-childhood/child-care-assistance-program.

If the treatment program recommended by OBH includes residential treatment and the recipient is unable to arrange for the temporary care of the children, contact the Child Welfare Section to arrange for the care of the children.

B-1862-FITAP - PR TRANSPORTATION

Transportation incurred to enable the applicant or recipient to participate in the screening, education, treatment and rehabilitation program is provided through STEP Supportive Services unless free transportation is available.

***

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

There are no forms or instructions associated with this policy.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B-Eligibility Factors (FITAP) Section No./Name B-1800 Drug Testing (FITAP) Document No./Name B-1870-FITAP Failure to Satisfactorily Participate Effective Date February 1, 2013

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

Failure or refusal of an applicant or recipient to participate without good cause in the initial drug screening or to sign the release forms is determined by the DCFS worker. Failure to participate with OBH in any subsequent assessment and testing, or failure to participate in the education, treatment, and rehabilitation program is determined by OBH. OBH will notify DCFS if the applicant or recipient failed or refused to participate. OBH and DCFS will work together to encourage participation. DCFS will determine if the applicant or recipient has good cause for not complying.

II. PROCEDURES

Failure to comply with drug testing requirements without good cause will result in the following sanctions:

● At application, the application must be rejected.

● For certified cases in which the family is not work-eligible, the case must be closed and remain closed for at least one month and until the client complies with this requirement, whichever is later.

● For certified cases in which the family is work-eligible, impose a STEP sanction with the appropriate occurrence and reason. The case must remain closed for the duration of the sanction period and until the client complies with this requirement, whichever is later.

If the client appeals and the DCFS Bureau of Appeals rules that the sanction is inappropriate, the sanction is considered as never having been imposed. The sanction must be deleted from LAMI.

B-1871-FITAP - * PR ** SATISFACTORY PARTICIPATION AFTER CLOSURE OR REMOVAL DUE TO FAILURE TO PARTICIPATE

For purposes of recertification, satisfactory participation with:

● DCFS is defined as completing the screening, and, if applicable, signing the release forms and agreeing to keep an appointment with OBH.

● OBH is defined as keeping an appointment with OBH, cooperating during that appointment and agreeing to comply with assessment and treatment recommendations made by OBH.

Once a case has been recertified, satisfactory participation with DCFS and OBH must continue.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

* There are no forms or instructions associated with this policy.

body:
Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B-Eligibility Factors (FITAP) Section No./Name B-1800 Drug Testing (FITAP) Document No./Name B-1890-FITAP Confidentiality Effective Date February 1, 2013

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

The regulations governing substance abuse confidentiality (42 CFR Part 2), pertaining to both alcohol and drug abuse, are stricter than most other confidentiality rules because the public health approach is based on the belief that a person with a substance abuse problem is more likely to seek treatment and succeed in treatment if he is assured his identity will not be revealed.

Federal regulations apply to any information, whether or not recorded, which identifies a patient as an alcohol or drug abuser, either directly or indirectly. An exception to this disclosure requirement is that a crime committed by a patient on the premises or against an employee or any threat to commit such a crime may be reported to a law enforcement authority without a signed consent.

II. PROCEDURES

Since DCFS and OBH will be working together to provide services to the client, it is essential that the two agencies share information. Information may not be shared by DCFS and OBH unless the recipient signs a consent specifically for the release of the information. To facilitate communication between the two agencies, two Consent for the Release of Information forms will be completed by DCFS prior to referral to OBH. (Refer to B-1830-FITAP-Consent for Release of Information.) Communication shared is on a “need to know” basis.

Disclosure restrictions are not lifted even after:

● treatment has been terminated, ● the patient has died, or ● the case has been closed.

Violation of the confidentiality law is a federal criminal offense and any violator is subject to a criminal penalty in the form of a fine. Fines for:

● a first offense shall not exceed $500; ● subsequent offenses shall not exceed $5,000.

(Reference 42 U.S.C., Section 290dd-3(f); 42 CFR, Section 2.4). Violations of the confidentiality law may be referred to the U.S. Attorney for prosecution. (Reference 42 CFR, Section 2.5).

The re-disclosure of information received from OBH to any other agency/entity is prohibited by federal law unless DCFS obtains another consent form authorizing release of specific information to the specific agency. A general or blanket authorization for the release of medical or other information is not sufficient for this purpose.

Safeguard written documents pertaining to the screening, testing, education, treatment and rehabilitation services in accordance with federal law. Entries must be made on a separate Form CR

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B – Eligibility Factors (FITAP) Section No./Name B-1900 FITAP Educational Requirements Document No./Name B-1910 FITAP Education Requirement for Single Minor Parents Effective Date March 1, 2023

1 of 1 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

If a single parent is under age 18, has a child at least 12 weeks of age, and does not have a high school diploma or its equivalent, * the single parent ** must participate in a Secondary/GED activity or in an alternative educational or training program approved by the * STEP Coach. ** This federal provision applies to all FITAP minor parents, regardless of whether they are head of household or not.

II. PROCEDURES

In work-eligible families, single minor parents are not considered exempt from this work activity. Single minor parents in work-eligible families who fail to participate in these activities and do not have good cause are subject to * a ** STEP sanction for non-participation.

For families that are not work-eligible, failure for single minor parents to participate without good cause will result in case closure for at least one month and until the single minor parent/caretaker complies, whichever is later.

The * STEP Coach ** will monitor participation in this work activity. Participation *** must be documented * in person notes, documentation uploaded to OnBase ** and * activity hour ** entered *in LITE. **

If needed, child care and STEP supportive services shall be provided to the clients participating in an educational activity.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

There are no forms or instructions associated with this policy.

IV. REFERENCES

* Title IV of the Social Security Act, Sec. 408 **

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 - Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B - Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-200 Citizenship/Non-Citizen Status Document No./Name B-210-FITAP Eligibility Requirement/Citizenship Effective Date September 1, 2022

1 of 3 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

U.S. CITIZENS AND * U.S. NATIONALS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS IF THEY MEET ALL ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA.

A U.S. NATIONAL IS A PERSON BORN IN AMERICAN SAMOA OR THE SWAINS ISLAND. THESE PLACES ARE KNOWN AS OUTLYING POSSESSIONS OF THE UNITED STATES. INDIVIDUALS BORN IN GUAM BETWEEN 1898 AND 1950, IN PUERTO RICO BETWEEN 1898 AND 1917, IN THE US VIRGIN ISLANDS BETWEEN 1917 AND 1927, OR IN THE PHILIPPINES BETWEEN 1898 AND 1946 ARE ALSO CONSIDERED A U.S. NATIONAL BUT NOT A U.S. CITIZEN, UNLESS CITIZENSHIP WAS INHERITED FROM HIS OR HER PARENTS. THERE IS NO REQUIREMENT FOR U.S. NATIONALS TO REGISTER WITH THE U.S. CITIZENSHIP AND IMMIGRATION SERVICES OR CARRY ANY DOCUMENTATION. **

B-211-FITAP - PO VERIFICATION

CITIZENSHIP MUST BE VERIFIED ONLY IF QUESTIONABLE. THE PERSON WHOSE CITIZENSHIP IS QUESTIONABLE DOES NOT QUALIFY UNTIL THE WORKER RECEIVES PROOF OF CITIZENSHIP. THE REMAINING HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS MAY BE CERTIFIED.

Count the income of parents who are not citizens or where citizenship has not been established when determining eligibility and benefits for the household.

CITIZENSHIP VERIFICATION FOR FITAP/KCSP OR SNAP IS USED FOR BOTH PROGRAMS.

B-212-FITAP - PO DOCUMENTS TO VERIFY QUESTIONABLE CITIZENSHIP

OBTAIN ONE OF THE FOLLOWING:

● BIRTH, BAPTISMAL, HOSPITAL CERTIFICATES, VOTER'S REGISTRATION CARD, PASSPORT OR MILITARY SERVICE RECORDS.

U. S. CITIZENSHIP AND IMMIGRATION SERVICES 2424 EDENBORN AVENUE SUITE 300 METAIRIE, LA 70001-1845 (504)-219-2554

1 of 3 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

U.S. CITIZENS AND U.S. NATIONALS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS IF THEY MEET ALL ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA.

A U.S. NATIONAL IS A PERSON BORN IN AMERICAN SAMOA OR THE SWAINS ISLAND. THESE PLACES ARE KNOWN AS OUTLYING POSSESSIONS OF THE UNITED STATES. INDIVIDUALS BORN IN GUAM BETWEEN 1898 AND 1950, IN PUERTO RICO BETWEEN 1898 AND 1917, IN THE US VIRGIN ISLANDS BETWEEN 1917 AND 1927, OR IN THE PHILIPPINES BETWEEN 1898 AND 1946, ARE ALSO CONSIDERED A U.S. NATIONAL BUT NOT A U.S. CITIZEN, UNLESS CITIZENSHIP WAS INHERITED FROM HIS OR HER PARENTS. THERE IS NO REQUIREMENT FOR U.S. NATIONALS TO REGISTER WITH THE U.S. CITIZENSHIP AND IMMIGRATION SERVICES (USCIS) OR CARRY ANY DOCUMENTATION.

B-211-SNAP - PO VERIFICATION

CITIZENSHIP MUST BE VERIFIED FOR ALL INDIVIDUALS IN THE SNAP HOUSEHOLD. IF PROOF OF CITIZENSHIP IS NOT PROVIDED FOR ONE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, THEY WILL BE DISQUALIFIED AND THE REMAINING HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS MAY BE CERTIFIED.

Before receiving proof, unless expedited, treat the person as disqualified. Count all his resources and all but his pro rata share of income as available to the household.

CITIZENSHIP VERIFICATION FOR FITAP/KCSP OR SNAP IS USED FOR BOTH PROGRAMS.

B-212-SNAP - PO DOCUMENTS TO VERIFY CITIZENSHIP

OBTAIN THE FOLLOWING:

BIRTH CERTIFICATE, HOSPITAL CERTIFICATE OR U.S. PASSPORT, OR UNITED STATES CITIZENSHIP AND IMMIGRATION SERVICES (USCIS) CERTIFICATE OF CITIZENSHIP OR NATURALIZATION.

IF THE CLIENT CANNOT PROVIDE ANY DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE, THE FOLLOWING SOURCES MUST BE USED:

• THE PATERNITY ESTABLISHMENT AND SUPPORT ENFORCEMENT (PESE) INTERFACE IF THE INDIVIDUAL WAS BORN IN LOUISIANA OR • THE SYSTEMATIC ALIEN VERIFICATION FOR ENTITLEMENTS (SAVE) PROGRAM.

IF THE INDIVIDUAL’S CITIZENSHIP CANNOT BE VERIFIED BY ANY OF THE FORMENTIONED SOURCES, A THIRD-PARTY AFFIDAVIT OF U.S. CITIZENSHIP OR U.S. NATIONALITY FORM

1 of 20 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

B-220-FITAP - PO FITAP NON-CITIZEN OVERVIEW

A NON-CITIZEN IS AN INDIVIDUAL WHO IS NOT A U.S. CITIZEN BY BIRTH OR NATURALIZATION. NON-CITIZEN IMMIGRATION STATUS MUST BE VERIFIED ONLY AT INITIAL APPLICATION, WHEN ADDING A NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, OR WHEN THE AGENCY IS NOTIFIED THAT THE STATUS OF A PARTICIPANT HAS CHANGED.

A NON-CITIZEN MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS IF THEY HAVE A QUALIFIED IMMIGRATION STATUS. CERTAIN QUALIFIED IMMIGRANTS MUST MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS. EACH APPLICANT FOR BENEFITS MUST PROVIDE IMMIGRATION DOCUMENT(S) THAT WILL BE USED TO VERIFY THEIR IMMIGRATION STATUS THROUGH THE SYSTEMATIC ALIEN VERIFICATION FOR ENTITLEMENTS (SAVE) PROGRAM.

B-220-1-FITAP - PO IMMIGRATION STATUSES THAT DO NOT REQUIRE ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS TO BE MET

THE FOLLOWING NON-CITIZENS HAVE QUALIFIED ALIEN IMMIGRATION STATUSES WHICH MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS WITHOUT HAVING TO MEET ANY ADDITIONAL CONDITION OR WAITING PERIOD:

• AFGHANI/IRAQI SPECIAL IMMIGRANT • AFGHAN HUMANITARIAN PAROLEE • AMERASIAN IMMIGRANT • ASYLEE • CUBAN/HAITIAN ENTRANT • DEPORTATION WITHHELD • REFUGEE • VICTIM OF TRAFFICKING • UKRAINIAN PAROLEE

THE FOLLOWING NON-CITIZENS ARE NOT QUALIFIED ALIENS BUT STILL MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS WITHOUT HAVING TO MEET ANY ADDITIONAL CONDITION OR WAITING PERIOD:

• AMERICAN INDIAN BORN IN CANADA • HMONG/HIGHLAND LAOTIAN IMMIGRANT

2 of 20 B-220-2-FITAP - PO IMMIGRATION STATUSES THAT REQUIRE AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION TO BE MET

THE FOLLOWING NON-CITIZENS HAVE QUALIFIED ALIEN IMMIGRATION STATUSES AND MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS, HOWEVER THEY MUST MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS:

• BATTERED NON-CITIZEN • CONDITIONAL ENTRANT • LAWFULLY ADMITTED PERMANENT RESIDENT (LPR) * EXCEPTION: IF THE LPR PREVIOUSLY HELD ONE OF THE STATUSES IDENTIFIED IN B-221-FITAP – PO, THE LPR IS NOT REQUIRED TO MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION. ** • PAROLEE

THESE NON-CITIZENS MUST MEET AT LEAST ONE OF THE FOLLOWING ADDITONAL CONDITIONS TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS:

• 5 YEARS OF RESIDENCE - INDIVIDUALS WHO HAVE LIVED IN THE UNITED STATES AS QUALIFIED ALIENS FOR AT LEAST FIVE YEARS. THESE ALIENS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN UNLIMITED PERIOD BEGINNING THE DATE THE REQUISITE IMMIGRATION STATUS IS ACQUIRED. THE FIVE-YEAR PERIOD IN QUALIFIED STATUS MAY BE EITHER CONSECUTIVE OR NON-CONSECUTIVE. TEMPORARY ABSENCES OF LESS THAN SIX MONTHS FROM THE UNITED STATES WITH NO INTENTION OF ABANDONING UNITED STATES RESIDENCY DO NOT TERMINATE OR INTERRUPT THE INDIVIDUAL’S PERIOD OF UNITED STATES RESIDENCY.

EXAMPLE: AN IMMIGRANT WHO ENTERED THE U.S. UNDER A QUALIFIED STATUS ON APRIL 20, 1999 WOULD HAVE LIVED IN THE U.S. FOR 5 YEARS ON APRIL 20, 2004. THEREFORE, THE ALIEN WOULD BE ELIGIBLE FOR AN UNLIMITED PERIOD BEGINNING APRIL 21, 2004.

• 40 QUALIFYING WORK QUARTERS – A LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENT (LPR) WHO HAS WORKED 40 QUALIFYING QUARTERS OF COVERAGE UNDER TITLE II OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY ACT OR CAN BE CREDITED WITH SUCH QUALIFYING QUARTERS. A QUALIFYING QUARTER INCLUDES ONE WORKED BY A PARENT OF AN ALIEN WHILE THE ALIEN WAS UNDER 18, INCLUDING QUARTERS WORKED PRIOR TO THE BIRTH OF THE CHILD, AND A QUARTER WORKED BY A SPOUSE DURING THEIR MARRIAGE IF THE ALIEN REMAINED MARRIED TO THE SPOUSE OR THE SPOUSE IS DECEASED. QUALIFYING QUARTERS INCLUDE ALL QUARTERS WORKED WHILE THE PERSON WAS LIVING IN THIS COUNTRY REGARDLESS OF THE PERSON'S LEGAL OR ILLEGAL STATUS AT THE TIME THE WORK WAS PERFORMED AND REGARDLESS OF WHETHER A VALID SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER WAS USED.

o LAWFULLY RESIDING ACTIVE DUTY ARMED FORCES PERSONNEL (OTHER THAN ACTIVE DUTY FOR TRAINING) AND THEIR SPOUSES OR UNMARRIED DEPENDENT CHILDREN,

o UNREMARRIED SURVIVING SPOUSE OR UNMARRIED DEPENDENT CHILDREN OF A DECEASED VETERAN OR INDIVIDUAL ON ACTIVE DUTY PROVIDED THE SPOUSE HAS NOT REMARRIED AND THE MARRIAGE WAS ONE YEAR IN DURATION, WAS WITHIN 15 YEARS FOLLOWING THE END OF THE PERIOD OF MILITARY SERVICE IN WHICH THE INJURY OR DISEASE WAS INCURRED OR AGGRAVATED OR MARRIED FOR ANY PERIOD IF A CHILD WAS BORN OF THE MARRIAGE OR WAS BORN BEFORE THE MARRIAGE.

B-220-3-FITAP - PO IMMIGRATION STATUSES OF CHILDREN UNDER 18

CHILDREN UNDER THE AGE OF 18, UNLESS THEY ARE U.S. CITIZENS, ARE TO BE CONSIDERED TO HAVE THE SAME IMMIGRATION STATUS AS THEIR PARENT(S).

AFGHAN NON-SPECIAL IMMIGRANT (AFGHAN HUMANITARIAN PAROLEE)

2) AMERICAN INDIANS BORN ABROAD

AMERICAN INDIANS BORN IN CANADA LIVING IN THE U.S. UNDER SEC 289 OF THE INA OR NON-CITIZEN MEMBERS OF A FEDERALLY-RECOGNIZED INDIAN TRIBE UNDER SEC 4(e) OF THE INDIAN SELF-DETERMINATION AND EDUCATION ASSISTANCE ACT. • ACCEPTABLE DOCUMENTATION

3) AMERASIAN IMMIGRANT

AMERASIAN IMMIGRANTS ARE LPR THAT WERE ADMITTED UNDER SEC 584 FO FOREIGN OPERATIONS, EXPORT FINANCING AND RELATED PROGRAM APPROPRIATIONS ACT. AMERASIANS ARE NOT SUBJECT TO ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS AND ARE CONSIDERED QUALIFIED ALIENS.

4) ASYLEE

AN ASYLEE IS A NON-CITIZEN WHO IS GRANTED ASYLUM * BY USCIS OR AN IMMIGRATION JUDGE UNDER SECTION 208 OF THE IMIGRATION AND NATIONALITY ACT (INA). ASYLEES ARE NOT SUBJECT TO ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS AND ARE CONSIDERED QUALIFIED ALIENS.

5) BATTERED NON-CITIZEN

A BATTERED NON-CITIZEN IS A NON-CITIZEN, NON-CITIZEN CHILD OF A BATTERED PARENT, OR THE NON-CITIZEN PARENT OF A CHILD WHO HAS BEEN BATTERED OR SUBJECTED TO EXTREME CRUELTY IN THE UNITED STATES BY A SPOUSE OR PARENT OR BY A MEMBER OF THE SPOUSE'S OR PARENT'S FAMILY RESIDING IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD AS THE ALIEN AND/OR CHILD. THE WORKER, WITH SUPERVISORY APPROVAL, DETERMINES THERE IS A SUBSTANTIVE CONNECTION BETWEEN THE BATTERY OR CRUELTY AND THE NEED FOR ASSISTANCE AND HAS BEEN APPROVED OR HAS A PETITION PENDING.

A BATTERED NON-CITIZEN MAY BE A QUALIFIED ALIEN IF HE OR SHE MEETS ALL OF THE FOLLOWING FOUR REQUIREMENTS:

o THE NON-CITIZEN’S CHILD HAS BEEN BATTERED OR SUBJECT TO EXTREME CRUELTY IN THE U.S. BY A SPOUSE OR PARENT OF THE NON-CITIZEN, OR BY A MEMBER OF THE SPOUSE’S OR PARENT’S FAMILY RESIDING IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD IF THE SPOUSE OR PARENT CONSENTS TO OR ACQUIESCES IN THE BATTERY OR CRUELTY; OR

o THE PARENT OF A NON-CITIZEN CHILD HAS BEEN BATTERED OR SUBJECT TO EXTREME CRUELTY IN THE U.S. BY A SPOUSE OR PARENT OF THE NON-CITIZEN, OR BY A MEMBER OF THE SPOUSE’S OR PARENT’S FAMILY RESIDING IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD IF THE SPOUSE OR PARENT CONSENTS TO OR ACQUIESCES ** IN THE BATTERY OR CRUELTY; AND

• THE BATTERED NON-CITIZEN, CHILD, OR PARENT NO LONGER RESIDES IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD AS THE ABUSER.

6) CONDITIONAL ENTRANT

A CONDITIONAL ENTRANT IS A NON-CITIZEN THAT IS GRANTED CONDITIONAL ENTRY UNDER SEC 203(A)(7) OF THE INA AS IN EFFECT BEFORE 4/1/1980.

CONDITIONAL ENTRANTS MUST MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION OUTLINED IN B-220-2- FITAP-PO TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS.

o INS FORM I-766 (EMPLOYMENT AUTHORIZATION DOCUMENT) ANNOTATED “A3.”

7) CUBAN OR HAITIAN ENTRANT

A CUBAN OR HAITIAN ENTRANT IS AN INDIVIDUAL WHO HAS FLED TO THE U.S. FROM EITHER CUBA OR HAITI TO EXCAPE OPPRESSION, PERSECUTION, NATIONAL DISTRESS, OR ENVIRONMENTAL DISASTERS. TO BE CONSIDERED A CUBAN OR HAITIAN ENTRANT, A NON-CITIZEN NEEDS TO BE ONE OF THE FOLLOWING:

• AN INDIVIDUAL GRANTED PAROLE AS A CUBAN OR HAITIAN ENTRANT (STATUS PENDING) OR GRANTED ANY OTHER SPECIAL STATUS ESTABLISHED UNDER THE IMMIGRATION LAWS FOR NATIONALS OF CUBA OR HAITI, OR,

• ANY OTHER NATIONAL OF CUBA OR HAITI WHO:

o WAS PAROLED INTO THE U.S. AND HAS NOT ACQUIRED ANY OTHER STATUS UNDER THE INA,

o IS THE SUBJECT OF REMOVAL PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE INA, OR,

o HAS AN APPLICATION FOR ASYLUM PENDING WITH THE INA.

NON-CITIZENS CLASSIFIED AS CUBAN OR HAITIAN ENTRANTS ARE CONSIDERED QUALIFIED NONCITIZENS AND ARE NOT SUBJECT TO ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS.

9) HMONG/HIGHLAND LAOTIAN TRIBAL MEMBER

A NON-CITIZEN LAWFULLY RESIDING IN THE U.S. WHO WAS A MEMBER OF A HMONG OR HIGHLAND LAOTIAN TRIBE THAT RENDERED ASSISTANCE TO U.S. * PERSONNEL BY TAKING PART IN A MILITARY OR RESCUE OPERATION DURING THE VIETNAM ERA (8/5/1964 TO 5/7/1975).

• THE UNLAWFUL PRESENCE MUST BE A FINDING OF FACT OR CONCLUSION OF LAW THAT IS MADE AS PART OF A FORMAL DETERMINATION THAT IS SUBJECT TO ADMINISTRATIVE REVIEW ON AN ALIEN’S CLAIM, AND

IF A NON-CITIZEN DOES NOT WISH USCIS BE CONTACTED TO VERIFY HIS IMMIGRATION STATUS, THE HOUSEHOLD MUST BE GIVEN THE OPTION OF WITHDRAWING ITS APPLICATION OR PARTICIPATING WITHOUT THAT MEMBER. THAT MEMBER WILL BE CONSIDERED AN INELIGIBLE ALIEN. THE FACT THAT A NON-CITIZEN DOES NOT WANT USCIS CONTACTED DOES NOT CONSTITUTE KNOWLEDGE OF ILLEGAL ALIEN STATUS.

B-224-FITAP - PO ABSENCE OF PROOF OF IMMIGRATION STATUS

NON-CITIZEN HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS INELIGIBLE IF THE HOUSEHOLD DOES NOT PROVIDE PROOF OF IMMIGRATION STATUS FOR THAT MEMBER. IF THE INELIGIBLE NON- CITIZEN IS UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO PROVIDE DOCUMENTATION OF IMMIGRATION STATUS, DO NOT MAKE ANY FURTHER EFFORTS TO OBTAIN VERIFICATION OF IMMIGRATION STATUS. INELIGIBILITY DOES NOT MEAN THAT THE PERSON IS AN ILLEGAL ALIEN. THE REMAINING MEMBERS OF THE HOUSEHOLD CAN BE CERTIFIED IF THEY MEET ALL ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS. REFER TO E-110 FITAP/* SNAP, Section 221-FITAP for instructions on treatment of income and resources of an ineligible alien.

B-225-FITAP - PO AGENCY DOCUMENTATION

DOCUMENTS PROVIDED FOR EACH NON-CITIZEN APPLYING FOR FITAP MUST BE SAVED IN ONBASE. FORM OFS 4AEC MAY BE COMPLETED FOR EACH NON-CITIZEN APPLYING FOR FITAP.

II. PROCEDURES

B-220-FITAP - PR FITAP NON-CITIZEN

THE IMMIGRATION STATUS OF EACH NON-CITIZEN IN THE HOUSEHOLD APPLYING FOR BENEFITS MUST BE DISCUSSED DURING THE INTERVIEW. DOCUMENT THE CLIENT’S STATEMENTS REGARDING IMMIGRATION STATUS AND AVAILABLE DOCUMENTATION TO VERIFY THAT STATUS IN A CASE NOTE. ASSIST THE NON-CITIZEN IN IDENTIFYING ACCEPTABLE DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE OF STATUS BY REFERENCING B-220-4-FITAP-PO.

IN LITE, ON THE PERSON DEMOGRAPHIC – DETAILS PAGE SELECT “ALIEN” IN THE DROP DOWN BOX FOR CITIZENSHIP FOR ALL NON-CITIZENS IN THE HOUSEHOLD. THE ALIEN DETAILS SCREEN WILL BE ENABLED.

17 of 20 B-220-1-FITAP - PR IMMIGRATION STATUSES

DETERMINE IF THE NON-CITIZEN IS A QUALIFIED ALIEN BASED ON THE INTERVIEW, DOCUMENTS PROVIDED, AND RESULTS OF SAVE.

ON THE ALIEN DETAILS SCREEN, THE WORKER MUST SELECT AN OPTION TO THE QUESTION “DO YOU AGREE TO DCFS CONTACTING UNITED STATES IMMIGRATION SERVICES (USCIS) TO VERIFY YOUR IMMIGRATION STATUS.” IF ‘NO’ IS SELECTED OR THE QUESTION IS NOT ANSWERED, LITE WILL DISQUALIFY THAT INDIVIDUAL FROM THE CASE. WHEN ‘NO’ IS SELECTED, ‘OPT OUT’ WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY POPULATED AS THE IMMIGRATION STATUS FOR THAT INDIVIDUAL.

THE WORKER MUST SELECT THE APPOPRIATE IMMIGRATION STATUS FROM THE DROP DOWN MENU AND SELECT THE APPORPRIATE IMMIGRATION STATUS VERIFICATION FROM THE DROP DOWN MENU.

AFGHAN HUMANITARIAN PAROLEES AND UKRAINIAN PAROLEES MUST BE CODED AS HAVING AN IMMIGRATION STATUS OF A REFUGEE.

A LPR WHO PREVIOUSLY HELD AN IMMIGRATION STATUS IDENTIFIED IN B-220-1 FITAP-PO MUST BE CODED USING THE PREVIOUS IMMIGRATION STATUS. **

RECORD THE CLIENTS STATEMENT OF THE DATE THE IMMIGRATION STATUS STARTED AND SELECT THE CORRESPONDING VERIFICATION CODE.

IMMIGRATION STATUS VERIFICATION - IF THE VALUE IS PENDING VERIFICATION BY THE DUE DATE, THE INDIVIDUAL WILL BE DISQUALIFIED.

INITIAL DATE OF ENTRY MUST BE ENTERED AND THE INITIAL DATE OF ENTRY VERIFICATION FIELD MUST BE ENTERED. IF THE DATE OF ENTRY AND INITIAL DATE OF ENTRY VERIFICATION FIELDS ARE BLANK, LITE WILL DISQUALIFY THE INDIVIDUAL. IF THE VALUE IS PENDING VERIFICATION BY THE DUE DATE, LITE WILL DISQUALIFY THE INDIVIDUAL.

40 QUARTERS OF WORK VERIFIED? IF THE LPR HAS 40 QUARTERS OF COVERED WORK AND THIS IS VERIFIED, ‘YES’, MUST BE SELECTED FROM THE DROP DOWN MENU IF THAT IS THE ONLY CONDITION THAT THE LPR MEETS TO BE ELIGIBLE. THIS IS VERIFIED THROUGH THE SSA 40 QUARTERS DATA VERIFICATION TASK. WHEN THE TASK IS RECEIVED, CHECK THE EMPLOYMENT HISTORY PANEL IN CLEARANCE SUMMARY TO VERIFY THE NUMBER OF CREDITED QUARTERS WORKED FOR THE INDIVIDUAL.

18 of 20 B-220-5-FITAP - PR Ineligible Non-Citizens

IF AN INDIVIDUAL IN THE HOUSEHOLD IS IDENTIFIED AS AN INELIGIBLE NON-CITIZEN, SELECT ALIEN IN LITE FOR THE CITIZENSHIP FIELD ON THE PERSON DEMOGRAPHICS – DETAILS SCREEN. ON THE ALIEN – DETAILS SCREEN, SELECT UNDOCUMENTED ALIENS AS THE IMMIGRATION STATUS. B-221-FITAP - PR VERIFICATION

VERIFY ALIEN STATUS AT CERTIFICATION OR WHEN ADDING NEW MEMBERS AND WHEN THE ALIEN’S STATUS HAS CHANGED SINCE THEIR DATE OF ENTRY.

SAVE

THE SAVE PROGRAM MUST BE USED TO VERIFY ALIEN STATUS FOR ALL ALIENS APPLYING FOR FITAP, IF THEY APPEAR TO BE ELIGIBLE, FOR ALL STATUSES EXCEPT VICTIMS OF TRAFFICKING. IF IT HAS BEEN DETERMINED THAT AN ALIEN IS INELIGIBLE, SAVE SHOULD NOT RUN FOR THAT INDIVIDUAL. A DCFS CASE RELATED HELP TICKET MUST BE SUBMITTED THROUGH THE USER SUPPORT CENTER REMEDY INTRANET TICKET GENERATOR. THE HELP TICKET SHOULD INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION:

• PLEASE VERIFY ALIEN STATUS THROUGH SAVE • LAST NAME • FIRST NAME • DATE OF BIRTH • ALIEN NUMBER • DOCUMENT TYPE

UPLOAD THE DOCUMENTS PROVIDED WHEN SUBMITTING THE TICKET.

*IF A SAVE RESPONSE IS NOT RECEIVED BY THE 30TH DAY, AND THE ALIEN’S IMMIGRATION STATUS WOULD MAKE THEM ELIGIBLE, AND ALL OTHER ELIGIBILITY FACTORS ARE MET, THE ALIEN MUST BE INCLUDED. THE CASE MUST NOT REMAIN IN PENDING STATUS DUE TO AWAITING FOR THE SAVE RESULT. IF THE SAVE RESPONSE IS RETURNED INDICATING THAT THE VERIFICATION SUBMITTED WAS INVALID, RECOVERY MUST BE INITIATED FOR THAT INDIVIDUAL. **

***

IF A TRAFFICKING MINOR HAS AN INTERIM ASSISTANCE LETTER, THE ANALYST OR OTHER ASSIGNED WORKER MUST CONTACT ORR AT (866) 401-5510 PRIOR TO OR AT RECERTIFICATION TO DETERMINE IF THE CHILD WILL RECEIVE ANOTHER INTERIM ASSISTANCE LETTER OR AN ELIGIBILITY LETTER. CONTACT MUST BE MADE WITH ORR TO VERIFY THE VALIDITY OF THE ORR ISSUED INTERIM ASSISTANCE OR ELIGIBILITY LETTER.

B-223-FITAP - PR CONTACT WITH USCIS

WHEN REPORTING THAT AN ALIEN IS IN THE U.S. ILLEGALLY, THE REPORT TO USCIS MUST BE MADE IN WRITING, SIGNED BY THE SUPERVISOR, AND SUBMITTED TO THE NEAREST USCIS OFFICE.

AN ALIEN WHO DOES NOT WISH USCIS BE CONTACTED TO VERIFY HIS IMMIGRATION STATUS MUST BE GIVEN THE OPTION OF WITHDRAWING ITS APPLICATION OR PARTICIPATING WITHOUT THAT MEMBER. THAT MEMBER WILL BE CONSIDERED AN INELIGIBLE ALIEN. THE FACT THAT AN ALIEN DOES NOT WANT USCIS CONTACTED DOES NOT CONSTITUTE KNOWLEDGE OF ILLEGAL ALIEN STATUS.

ON THE ALIEN DETAILS SCREEN, THE WORKER MUST SELECT ‘NO’ TO THE QUESTION “DO YOU AGREE TO DCFS CONTACTING UNITED STATES IMMIGRATION SERVICES (USCIS) TO VERIFY YOUR IMMIGRATION STATUS.” ‘OPT OUT’ WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY POPULATED AS THE IMMIGRATION STATUS FOR THAT INDIVIDUAL. LITE WILL DISQUALIFY THAT INDIVIDUAL FROM THE CASE.

B-224-FITAP - PR ABSENCE OF PROOF OF IMMIGRATION STATUS

IF PROOF OF IMMIGRATION STATUS IS NOT PROVIDED, LITE WILL EXCLUDE THE NON- CITIZEN FOR FAILURE TO ATTEST TO ALIEN STATUS.

B-225-FITAP - PR AGENCY DOCUMENTATION

DOCUMENT HOW ALIEN STATUS IS DETERMINED IN LITE. THE FORM OFS 4AEC MAY BE COMPLETED FOR EACH ALIEN APPLYING FOR FITAP.

ENTER A CASE NOTE TO RECORD THE DOCUMENTS PROVIDED FOR THE ALIEN STATUS. ALSO, DOCUMENT THE RESULTS OF SAVE.

AFTER RUNNING ELIGIBILITY IN LITE AND PRIOR TO AUTHORIZING THE CASE, THE SUPERVISOR MUST REVIEW THE DETERIMINATION MADE AND MAKE A CASE NOTE INDICATING THAT THE CASE WAS REVIEWED.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

OFS 4AEC Form / Instructions Alien Eligibility Checklist

1 of 13 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

B-220-SNAP - PO SNAP NON-CITIZEN OVERVIEW

A NON-CITIZEN IS AN INDIVIDUAL WHO IS NOT A U.S. CITIZEN BY BIRTH OR NATURALIZATION. NON-CITIZEN IMMIGRATION STATUS MUST BE VERIFIED AT INITIAL APPLICATION, REDETERMINATION, AND WHEN ADDING A NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, OR WHEN THE AGENCY IS NOTIFIED THAT THE STATUS OF A PARTICIPANT HAS CHANGED.

A NON-CITIZEN MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS IF THEY HAVE A QUALIFIED IMMIGRATION STATUS. CERTAIN QUALIFIED IMMIGRANTS MUST MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS. EACH APPLICANT FOR BENEFITS MUST PROVIDE IMMIGRATION DOCUMENT(S) THAT WILL BE USED TO VERIFY THEIR IMMIGRATION STATUS THROUGH THE SYSTEMATIC ALIEN VERIFICATION FOR ENTITLEMENTS (SAVE) PROGRAM.

B-220-1-SNAP - PO IMMIGRATION STATUSES THAT DO NOT REQUIRE ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS TO BE MET

THE FOLLOWING NON-CITIZENS HAVE QUALIFIED ALIEN IMMIGRATION STATUSES WHICH MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS WITHOUT HAVING TO MEET ANY ADDITIONAL CONDITION OR WAITING PERIOD:

• CUBAN/HAITIAN ENTRANT • COMPACTS OF FREE ASSOCIATION (COFA) CITIZENS

B-220-2-SNAP - PO IMMIGRATION STATUSES THAT MAY REQUIRE AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION TO BE MET

THE FOLLOWING NON-CITIZENS HAVE QUALIFIED ALIEN IMMIGRATION STATUS AND MAY BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS, HOWEVER THEY MAY NEED TO MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS:

• LAWFULLY ADMITTED PERMANENT RESIDENT (LPR)

IF THE INDIVIDUAL IS AN LPR, ELIGIBILTY MUST BE DETERMINED BASED ON: • THE DATE THE QUALIFIED ALIEN OBTAINED LPR STATUS, AND • WHETHER THE INDIVIDUAL MEETS IS REQUIRED TO MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION OR NOT.

AFTER CONFIRMING LPR STATUS, DETERMINE WHETHER THE INDIVIDUAL IS SUBJECT TO THE FIVE-YEAR WAITING PERIOD OR QUALIFIES FOR AN EXCEPTION.

2 of 13 NOTE: AN INDIVIDUAL IS NOT CONSIDERED AN LPR IF THEY HAVE APPLIED TO ADJUST STATUS AND HAVE NOT YET RECEIVED A DECISION. 5 - YEAR WAITING PERIOD INDIVIDUALS WHO HAVE LIVED IN THE UNITED STATES AS QUALIFIED ALIENS FOR AT LEAST FIVE YEARS. THESE ALIENS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN UNLIMITED PERIOD BEGINNING THE DATE THE REQUISITE IMMIGRATION STATUS IS ACQUIRED. THE FIVE-YEAR PERIOD IN QUALIFIED STATUS MAY BE EITHER CONSECUTIVE OR NON-CONSECUTIVE. TEMPORARY ABSENCES OF LESS THAN SIX MONTHS FROM THE UNITED STATES WITH NO INTENTION OF ABANDONING UNITED STATES RESIDENCY DO NOT TERMINATE OR INTERRUPT THE INDIVIDUAL’S PERIOD OF UNITED STATES RESIDENCY.

EXAMPLE: AN IMMIGRANT WHO ENTERED THE U.S., AS A LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENT ON APRIL 20, 1999 WOULD HAVE LIVED IN THE U.S. FOR 5 YEARS ON APRIL 20, 2004. THEREFORE, THE ALIEN WOULD BE ELIGIBLE FOR AN UNLIMITED PERIOD BEGINNING APRIL 21, 2004.

LPR GROUPS SUBJECT TO THE 5 YEAR WAITING PERIOD LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENTS ARE SUBJECT TO THE FIVE-YEAR WAITING PERIOD FROM THE DATE THEY OBTAIN LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENT STATUS IF THEY HELD THE FOLLOWING IMMIGRATION STATUS BEFORE BECOMING AND LPR: • CONDITIONAL ENTRANTS • BATTERED ALIENS, • VICTIMS OF SEVERE TRAFFICKING, AND • INDIVIDUALS GRANTED PAROLE FOR A PERIOD OF AT LEAST ONE YEAR

LPR GROUPS NOT SUBJECT TO THE 5 YEAR WAITING PERIOD LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENTS ARE NOT SUBJECT TO THE 5 YEAR WAITING PERIOD IF THEY HELD THE FOLLOWING IMMIGRATION STATUS BEFORE BECOMING AN LPR: • REFUGEES • INDIVIDUALS GRANTED ASYLUM • DEPORTATION WITHHELD • AMERASIAN IMMIGRANTS • AMERICAN INDIANS BORN ABROAD • HMONG AND HIGHLAND LAOTIAN TRIBAL MEMBERS • IRAQI AND AFGHAN SPECIAL IMMIGRANTS (SIV)

ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS ALLOWING LPR ELIGIBILITY

LPRs MAY BE ELIGIBLE WITHOUT WAITING FIVE YEARS IF THEY MEET AT LEAST ONE OF THE FOLLOWING ADDITONAL CONDITIONS:

• 40 QUALIFYING WORK QUARTERS – A LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENT (LPR) WHO HAS WORKED 40 QUALIFYING QUARTERS OF COVERAGE UNDER TITLE II OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY ACT OR CAN BE CREDITED WITH SUCH QUALIFYING QUARTERS. A QUALIFYING QUARTER INCLUDES ONE WORKED BY A PARENT OF AN ALIEN WHILE THE ALIEN WAS UNDER 18, INCLUDING QUARTERS WORKED PRIOR TO THE BIRTH OF THE CHILD, AND A QUARTER WORKED BY A SPOUSE DURING THEIR MARRIAGE IF THE ALIEN REMAINED MARRIED TO THE SPOUSE OR THE SPOUSE IS DECEASED. QUALIFYING QUARTERS INCLUDE ALL QUARTERS WORKED WHILE THE PERSON WAS LIVING IN THIS COUNTRY REGARDLESS OF THE PERSON'S LEGAL OR ILLEGAL STATUS AT THE TIME THE WORK WAS PERFORMED AND REGARDLESS OF WHETHER A VALID SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER WAS USED.

NOTE: BEGINNING JANUARY 1, 1997, A QUARTER IN WHICH AN ALIEN RECEIVED FEDERAL MEANS-TESTED ASSISTANCE IS NOT COUNTED AS A QUALIFYING QUARTER.

• CHILDREN UNDER 18 – CHILDREN UNDER 18 YEARS OF AGE, WHO ARE LAWFULLY RESIDING IN THE UNITED STATES,

• BLIND OR DISABLED - INDIVIDUALS RECEIVING PAYMENTS OR ASSISTANCE FOR BLINDNESS OR DISABILITY, AS DEFINED IN FITAP POLICY,

• ELDERLY BORN ON OR BEFORE 8-22-31 WHO LAWFULLY RESIDED IN THE UNITED STATES ON 8-22-96,

• MILITARY CONNECTION

o LAWFULLY RESIDING VETERANS WHO HAVE MET THE MINIMUM ACTIVE DUTY SERVICE REQUIREMENTS OF SECTION 5303A(D) OF TITLE 38, UNITED STATES CODE (24 MONTHS OR THE PERIOD FOR WHICH THE PERSON WAS CALLED TO ACTIVE DUTY) WHO WERE HONORABLY DISCHARGED FOR REASONS OTHER THAN ALIENAGE AND THEIR SPOUSES OR UNMARRIED DEPENDENT CHILDREN,

B-220-3-SNAP - PO OTHER IMMIGRATION STATUSES

THE FOLLOWING IMMIGRATION STATUSES, AS DEFINED BELOW, MUST ADJUST TO LPR STATUS IN ORDER TO MEET ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS. INDIVIDUALS IN THESE STATUSES ARE NOT ELIGIBLE BASED SOLELY ON THE STATUS ITSELF. REFER TO POLICY B-220-2-SNAP.

• AMERASIAN IMMIGRANT – INDIVIDUALS ADMITTED TO THE UNITED STATES AS AN AMERASIAN IMMIGRANT.

• AMERICAN INDIAN BORN ABROAD – AMERICAN INDIANS BORN IN CANADA LIVING IN THE UNITED STATES (U.S.) UNDER §289 OF THE IMMIGRATION AND NATIONALITY ACT (INA) OR ALIEN MEMBERS OF A FEDERALLY RECOGNIZED INDIAN TRIBE UNDER §4(E) OF THE INDIAN SELF-DETERMINATION AND EDUCATION ASSISTANCE ACT.

• CERTAIN HMONG OR HIGHLAND LAOTIAN TRIBAL MEMBERS - AN INDIVIDUAL LAWFULLY RESIDING IN THE U.S. WHO WAS A MEMBER OF A HMONG OR HIGHLAND LAOTIAN TRIBE THAT RENDERED ASSISTANCE TO U.S. PERSONNEL BY TAKING PART IN A MILITARY OR RESCUE OPERATION DURING THE VIETNAM ERA (AUG. 5, 1964 – MAY 7, 1975). THIS CATEGORY INCLUDES THE SPOUSE (OR UN-REMARRIED SURVIVING SPOUSE) OR UNMARRIED DEPENDENT CHILDREN OF THESE INDIVIDUALS.

• REFUGEES – A REFUGEE IS A NON-CITIZEN THAT HAS FLED THEIR COUNTRY TO ESCAPE INVASION, OPPRESSION, OR PERSECUTION.

• INDIVIDUALS GRANTED ASYLUM - AN ASYLEE IS A NON-CITIZEN WHO IS GRANTED ASYLUM BY USCIS OR AN IMMIGRATION JUDGE UNDER SECTION 208 OF THE IMIGRATION AND NATIONALITY ACT (INA).

• DEPORTATION WITHHELD - A NON-CITIZEN WHOSE DEPORATION IS WITHHELD AND WHOSE CONTINUED PRESENCE IN THE U.S. IS REQUIRED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT.

• IRAQI AND AFGHAN SPECIAL IMMIGRANTS (SIV) - AFGHAN OR IRAQI NATIONALS GRANTED A SPECIAL IMMIGRANT VISA (SIV) OR SPECIAL IMMIGRANT (SQ OR SI) PAROLE BY THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY FOR SERVICE TO THE U.S. GOVERNMENT.

• VICTIMS OF SEVERE TRAFFICKING - A VICTIM OF TRAFFICKING IS A NON-CITIZEN OR IMMEDIATE FAMILY MEMBER OF A NON- CITIZEN THAT HAS BEEN A VICTIM OF SEVERE TRAFFICKING AND HAS BEEN CERTIFIED BY THE OFFICE OF REFUGEE RESETTLEMENT (ORR) TO HAVE BEEN SUBJECTED TO COMMERCIAL SEX ACTS, DEBT BONDAGE, INVOLUNTARY SERVITUDE, PEONAGE, OR SLAVERY.

• AFGHAN NATIONALS - CITIZENS, OR THOSE WHO LAST HABITALLY LIVED IN AFGHANASTAIN WHO ARE GRANTED PAROLE BETWEEN JULY 31, 2021, AND SEPTEMBER 30, 2023

• UKRAINIAN NATIONALS - A UKRAINIAN NATIONAL, CITIZEN, OR SOMEONE WHO LAST HABITUALLY LIVED IN UKRAINE WHO IS GRANTED PAROLE BETWEEN FEBRUARY 24,2022, AND SEPTEMBER 30, 2024

• CONDITIONAL ENTRANT - A CONDITIONAL ENTRANT IS A NON-CITIZEN THAT IS GRANTED CONDITIONAL ENTRY UNDER SEC 203(A)(7) OF THE INA AS IN EFFECT BEFORE 4/1/1980.

• BATTERED ALIENS - A BATTERED NON-CITIZEN IS A NON-CITIZEN, NON-CITIZEN CHILD OF A BATTERED PARENT, OR THE NON-CITIZEN PARENT OF A CHILD WHO HAS BEEN BATTERED OR SUBJECTED TO EXTREME CRUELTY IN THE UNITED STATES BY A SPOUSE OR PARENT OR BY A MEMBER OF THE SPOUSE'S OR PARENT'S FAMILY RESIDING IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD AS THE ALIEN AND/OR CHILD. THE WORKER, WITH SUPERVISORY APPROVAL, DETERMINES THERE IS A SUBSTANTIVE CONNECTION BETWEEN THE BATTERY OR CRUELTY AND THE NEED FOR ASSISTANCE AND HAS BEEN APPROVED OR HAS A PETITION PENDING.

• INDIVIDUALS GRANTED PAROLE FOR AT LEAST ONE YEAR - A PAROLEE IS A NON- CITIZEN THAT IS PAROLED UNDER SECTION 212(d)(5) OF THE INA FOR AT LEAST ONE YEAR.

1) CUBAN OR HAITIAN ENTRANT

A CUBAN AND HAITIAN ENTRANT IS DEFINED IN SECTION 501(E) OF THE REFUGEE EDUCATION ASSISTANCE ACT OF 1980, 8 U.S.C. SEC 1522 NOTE, AS: ***

• AN INDIVIDUAL GRANTED PAROLE STATUS AS A CUBAN OR HAITIAN ENTRANT (STATUS PENDING) OR GRANTED ANY OTHER SPECIAL STATUS ESTABLISHED UNDER THE IMMIGRATION LAWS FOR NATIONALS OF CUBA OR HAITI, OR,

• ANY OTHER NATIONAL OF CUBA OR HAITI WHO:

o WAS PAROLED INTO THE U.S. AND HAS NOT ACQUIRED ANY OTHER STATUS UNDER THE IMMIGRATION AND NATIONALITY ACT (INA),

o IS THE SUBJECT OF REMOVAL PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE INA, OR,

o HAS AN APPLICATION FOR ASYLUM PENDING WITH THE U.S. IMMIGRATION AND NATURALIZATION SERVCIES (INS).

NON-CITIZENS CLASSIFIED AS CUBAN OR HAITIAN ENTRANTS ARE CONSIDERED QUALIFIED NONCITIZENS AND ARE NOT SUBJECT TO ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS. EVEN AFTER A CUBAN/HATIAN ENTRANT BECOMES A PERMANENT RESIDENT, THEY TECHNICALLY RETAIN THE STATUS OF CUBAN/HAITIAN ENTRANT.

ACCEPTABLE DOCUMENTATION

o PAROLE OR OTHER SPECIAL STATUS

▪ FORM I-94 – (ARRIVAL/DEPARTURE RECORD) WITH A STAMP NOTING “CUBAN- HAITIAN ENTRANT” OR “PAROLED INTO THE U.S. ON OR AFTER 4/21/1980, UNDER 212(d)(5).” THE I-94 MAY BE EXPIRED

▪ FORM I-551 – PERMANENT RESIDENT CARD WITH A CATEGORY CODE CH6. THE I-551 MAY BE EXPIRED

▪ CUBAN OR HAITIAN PASSPORT WITH SEC 212(d)(5) STAMP DATED AFTER 10/10/1980

▪ FORM I-766 EMPLOYMENT AUTHORIZATION DOCUMENT WITH CODE “A04” OR “C11”

7 of 13 o AN INDIVIDUAL WHO IS THE SUBJECT OF REMOVAL, DEPORTATION, OR EXCLUSION PROCEEDINGS:

▪ DHS FORM I-862 – NOTICE TO APPEAR

▪ DHS FORM I-220A – ORDER OF RELEASE ON RECOGNIZANCE

o AN INDIVIDUAL WHO HAS AN APPLICATION FOR ASYLUM PENDING:

▪ FORM I-797C, NOTICE OF ACTION CONFIRMING USCIS RECEIPT FOR FILING FORM I-589 – APPLICATION FOR ASYLUM AND WITHHHOLDING OF REMOVAL

▪ FORM I-766 EMPLOYMENT AUTHORIZATION DOCUMENT WITH THE CODE “C08”

2) LAWFULLY ADMITTED PERMANENT RESIDENT (LPR)

AN LPR IS A NON-CITIZEN THAT WAS GIVEN PERMISSION TO PERMANENTLY LIVE AND WORK IN THE U.S. MOST LPRs COME TO THE U.S. ON TEMPORARY STATUS. A NON- CITIZEN THAT DOES NOT ENTER THE U.S.IN A TEMPORARY STATUS AND ENTERS THE U.S. AS AN LPR IS OFTEN SPONSORED.

AN LPR MUST MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION OUTLINED IN B-220-2-SNAP-PO TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS. IF THE LPR PREVIOUSLY HELD ONE OF THE IMMIGRATION STATUSES IDENTIFIED IN B-220-1 SNAP PO, THE LPR IS NOT REQUIRED TO MEET AN ADDITIONAL CONDITION.

PRIOR TO COMPLETING THE ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION FOR AN LPR, IT MUST BE DETERMINED IF THE LPR HAS A SPONSOR AND IF THE INCOME AND RESOURCES OF THE SPONSOR NEED TO BE DEEMED FOR THE HOUSEHOLD. FOR SPONSORED ALIENS, SEE E-110-FITAP/SNAP.

ACCEPTABLE DOCUMENTATION

o INS FORM I-551, (PERMANENT RESIDENT CARD, COMMONLY KNOWN AS A “GREEN CARD”); OR;

o UNEXPIRED TEMPORARY I-551 STAMP IN FOREIGN PASSPORT OR ON INS FORM I- 94 (ARRIVAL/DEPATURE RECORD) OR

o FORM I-327, REENTRY PERMIT

3) COFA CITIZENS

8 of 13 THE CONSOLIDATED APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2024 (CAA) PROVIDES THAT COFA CITIZENS OF THE FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA, THE REPUBLIC OF THE MARSHALL ISLANDS, AND THE REPUBLIC OF PALAU WHO LAWFULLY RESIDE IN THE U.S. ARE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS WITHOUT A WAITING PERIOD IF THEY MEET ALL OTHER PROGRAM ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS.

ACCEPTABLE DOCUMENTATION

COFA CITIZENS ARE USUALLY DOCUMENTED WITH A FORM I-94, FOREIGN PASSPORT WITH AN ADMISSION STAMP, OR A VALID FORM I-766, EMPLOYMENT AUTHORIZATION DOCUMENT (EAD).

B-220-5-SNAP - PO Ineligible Non-Citizens

THE FOLLOWING NON-CITIZENS ARE INELIGIBLE FOR SNAP:

• NON-CITIZENS WHO ARE LAWFULLY PRESENT IN THE UNITED STATES IN A NON- QUALIFIED STATUS, SUCH AS STUDENTS AND H-1B VISA WORKERS,

• UNDOCUMENTED NON-CITIZENS (E.G. INDIVIDUALS WHO ENTERED THE UNITED STATES AS TEMPORARY RESIDENTS AND OVERSTAYED THEIR VISAS OR WHO ENTERED WITHOUT A VISA),

• INDIVIDUALS GRANTED TEMPORARY PROTECTED STATUS (TPS), UNLESS THE INDIVIDUAL BECAME A QUALIFIED ALIEN IN SOME OTHER QUALIFYING STATUS, AND

• MOST INDIVIDUALS PRESENT IN THE UNITED STATES WITH A U VISA, UNLESS THE INDIVIDUAL BECAME A QUALIFIED ALIEN IN SOME OTHER QUALIFYING STATUS.

B-221-SNAP - PO VERIFICATION

ALIEN STATUS MUST BE VERIFIED WHEN MEMBERS ARE IDENTIFIED AS NON-CITIZENS ALIENS AT CERTIFICATION OR WHEN ADDING NEW MEMBERS. ALIEN STATUS MUST BE VERIFIED BY THE SYSTEMATIC ALIEN VERIFICATION FOR ENTITLEMENTS (SAVE) PROGRAM FOR EACH NON-CITIZEN APPLYING FOR SNAP.

A HISTORY OF AN NON-ALIEN’S IMMIGRATION STATUS MUST BE OBTAINED FOR IMMIGRANTS WHOSE STATUS HAS CHANGED SINCE THEIR DATE OF ENTRY IF THEY HAVE LIVED IN THE UNITED STATES FOR MORE THAN FIVE YEARS AND WOULD BE ELIGIBLE ONLY IF THEY HAVE LIVED IN THE U.S. FOR FIVE YEARS OR MORE.

B-222-SNAP - RESERVED

B-223-SNAP – PO CONTACT WITH USCIS

IF THE AGENCY KNOWS FOR CERTAIN THAT NON-CITIZEN IS IN THE U.S. ILLEGALLY, THE WORKER MUST REPORT THE ILLEGAL ALIEN TO USCIS.

IN ORDER TO KNOW FOR CERTAIN THAT A PERSON IS AN ILLEGAL ALIEN THE FOLLOWING MUST OCCUR:

• THE UNLAWFUL PRESENCE MUST BE A FINDING OF FACT OR CONCLUSION OF LAW THAT IS MADE AS PART OF A FORMAL DETERMINATION THAT IS SUBJECT TO ADMINISTRATIVE REVIEW ON AN ALIEN’S CLAIM, AND

• THE FINDING OR CONCLUSION OF UNLAWFUL PRESENCE MUST BE SUPPORTED BY A DETERMINATION BY USCIS OR THE EXECUTIVE OFFICE OF IMMIGRATION REVIEW, SUCH AS A FINAL ORDER OF DEPORTATION.

IF A NON-CITIZEN DOES NOT WISH USCIS BE CONTACTED TO VERIFY HIS IMMIGRATION STATUS, THE HOUSEHOLD MUST BE GIVEN THE OPTION OF WITHDRAWING ITS APPLICATION OR PARTICIPATING WITHOUT THAT MEMBER. THAT MEMBER WILL BE CONSIDERED AN INELIGIBLE ALIEN. THE FACT THAT A NON-CITIZEN DOES NOT WANT USCIS CONTACTED DOES NOT CONSTITUTE KNOWLEDGE OF ILLEGAL ALIEN STATUS.

B-224-SNAP - PO ABSENCE OF PROOF OF IMMIGRATION STATUS

NON-CITIZEN HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS INELIGIBLE IF THE HOUSEHOLD DOES NOT PROVIDE PROOF OF IMMIGRATION STATUS FOR THAT MEMBER. IF THE INELIGIBLE NON- CITIZEN IS UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO PROVIDE DOCUMENTATION OF IMMIGRATION STATUS, DO NOT MAKE ANY FURTHER EFFORTS TO OBTAIN VERIFICATION OF IMMIGRATION STATUS. INELIGIBILITY DOES NOT MEAN THAT THE PERSON IS AN ILLEGAL ALIEN. THE REMAINING MEMBERS OF THE HOUSEHOLD CAN BE CERTIFIED IF THEY MEET ALL ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS. Refer to E-220 FITAP/SNAP, Section 221-SNAP for instructions on treatment of income and resources of an ineligible alien.

B-225-SNAP - PO AGENCY DOCUMENTATION

DOCUMENTS PROVIDED FOR EACH NON-CITIZEN APPLYING FOR SNAP MUST BE SAVED IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY SYSTEM. FORM OFS 4AEC MAY BE COMPLETED FOR EACH NON-CITIZEN APPLYING FOR SNAP.

II. PROCEDURES

B-220-SNAP - PR SNAP NON-CITIZEN

THE IMMIGRATION STATUS OF EACH NON-CITIZEN IN THE HOUSEHOLD APPLYING FOR BENEFITS MUST BE DISCUSSED DURING THE INTERVIEW. DOCUMENT THE CLIENT’S STATEMENTS REGARDING IMMIGRATION STATUS AND AVAILABLE DOCUMENTATION TO VERIFY THAT STATUS IN A CASE NOTE. ASSIST THE NON-CITIZEN IN IDENTIFYING ACCEPTABLE DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE OF STATUS BY REFERENCING B-220-4-SNAP-PO.

IN LITE, ON THE PERSON DEMOGRAPHIC – DETAILS PAGE SELECT “ALIEN” IN THE DROP- DOWN BOX FOR CITIZENSHIP FOR ALL NON-CITIZENS IN THE HOUSEHOLD. WHEN ‘ALIEN’ IS SELECTED ON THE PERSON DEMOGRAPHIC – DETAILS PAGE, THE ALIEN DETAILS SCREEN WILL BE ENABLED.

B-220-1-SNAP - PR IMMIGRATION STATUSES

DETERMINE IF THE NON-CITIZEN IS A QUALIFIED ALIEN BASED ON THE INTERVIEW, DOCUMENTS PROVIDED, AND RESULTS OF SAVE.

ON THE ALIEN DETAILS SCREEN, THE WORKER MUST SELECT AN OPTION TO THE QUESTION “DO YOU AGREE TO LDH CONTACTING UNITED STATES IMMIGRATION SERVICES (USCIS) TO VERIFY YOUR IMMIGRATION STATUS.” IF ‘NO’ IS SELECTED OR THE QUESTION IS NOT ANSWERED, LITE WILL DISQUALIFY THAT INDIVIDUAL FROM THE CASE. WHEN ‘NO’ IS SELECTED, ‘OPT OUT’ WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY POPULATED AS THE IMMIGRATION STATUS FOR THAT INDIVIDUAL.

THE WORKER MUST SELECT THE APPROPRIATE IMMIGRATION STATUS FROM THE DROP DOWN MENU AND SELECT THE APPROPRIATE IMMIGRATION STATUS VERIFICATION FROM THE DROP DOWN MENU.

A LPR WHO PREVIOUSLY HELD AN IMMIGRATION STATUS IDENTIFIED IN B-220-1 SNAP-PO MUST BE CODED USING THE PREVIOUS IMMIGRATION STATUS.

COFA CITIZENS MUST BE CODED AS HAVING AN IMMIGRATION STATUS OF A COFA.

RECORD THE CLIENTS STATEMENT OF THE DATE THE IMMIGRATION STATUS STARTED AND SELECT THE CORRESPONDING VERIFICATION CODE.

IMMIGRATION STATUS VERIFICATION - IF THE VALUE IS PENDING VERIFICATION BY THE DUE DATE, THE INDIVIDUAL WILL BE DISQUALIFIED.

40 QUARTERS OF WORK VERIFIED? B-220-5-SNAP - PR Ineligible Non-Citizens

IF AN INDIVIDUAL IN THE HOUSEHOLD IS IDENTIFIED AS AN INELIGIBLE NON-CITIZEN, SELECT ALIEN IN LITE FOR THE CITIZENSHIP FIELD ON THE PERSON DEMOGRAPHICS – DETAILS SCREEN. ON THE ALIEN – DETAILS SCREEN, SELECT UNDOCUMENTED ALIENS AS THE IMMIGRATION STATUS.

B-221-SNAP - PR VERIFICATION

VERIFY ALIEN STATUS AT CERTIFICATION OR WHEN ADDING NEW MEMBERS AND WHEN THE ALIEN’S STATUS HAS CHANGED SINCE THEIR DATE OF ENTRY.

SAVE

THE SAVE PROGRAM MUST BE USED TO VERIFY ALIEN STATUS FOR ALIENS APPLYING FOR SNAP, IF THEY APPEAR TO BE ELIGIBLE, FOR ALL STATUSES EXCEPT VICTIMS OF TRAFFICKING. IF IT HAS BEEN DETERMINED THAT AN ALIEN IS INELIGIBLE, SAVE SHOULD NOT RUN FOR THAT INDIVIDUAL. A LDH CASE RELATED HELP TICKET MUST BE SUBMITTED THROUGH THE USER SUPPORT CENTER REMEDY INTRANET TICKET GENERATOR. THE HELP TICKET SHOULD INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION:

• PLEASE VERIFY ALIEN STATUS THROUGH SAVE • LAST NAME • FIRST NAME • DATE OF BIRTH • ALIEN NUMBER • DOCUMENT TYPE

UPLOAD THE DOCUMENTS PROVIDED WHEN SUBMITTING THE TICKET.

WHEN REPORTING THAT AN ALIEN IS IN THE U.S. ILLEGALLY, THE REPORT TO USCIS MUST BE MADE IN WRITING, SIGNED BY THE SUPERVISOR, AND SUBMITTED TO THE NEAREST USCIS OFFICE.

LITE WILL DISQUALIFY THAT INDIVIDUAL FROM THE CASE.

B-224-SNAP - PR ABSENCE OF PROOF OF IMMIGRATION STATUS

IF PROOF OF IMMIGRATION STATUS IS NOT PROVIDED, LITE WILL EXCLUDE THE NON- CITIZEN FOR FAILURE TO ATTEST TO ALIEN STATUS.

B-225-SNAP - PR AGENCY DOCUMENTATION

DOCUMENT HOW ALIEN STATUS IS DETERMINED IN LITE. THE FORM OFS 4AEC MAY BE COMPLETED FOR EACH ALIEN APPLYING FOR SNAP.

ENTER A CASE NOTE TO RECORD THE DOCUMENTS PROVIDED FOR THE ALIEN STATUS. ALSO, DOCUMENT THE RESULTS OF SAVE.

AFTER RUNNING ELIGIBILITY IN LITE AND PRIOR TO AUTHORIZING THE CASE, THE SUPERVISOR MUST REVIEW THE DETERMINATION MADE AND MAKE A CASE NOTE INDICATING THAT THE CASE WAS REVIEWED.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B – Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-400-FITAP-SNAP Enumeration/Social Security Numbers Document No./Name B-410-FITAP Eligibility Requirement Effective Date March 1, 2020

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

REFER TO CHAPTER 7, PART D FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON THE ENUMERATION PROCESS.

THE HOUSEHOLD MUST PROVIDE A SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER (SSN) OR ACCEPTABLE PROOF OF APPLICATION FOR AN SSN FOR ALL HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS. THE ENUMERATION REQUIREMENT IS MET WHEN:

● A COMPLETED FORM 1ER IS RECEIVED INDICATING THAT THE APPLICATION HAS BEEN COMPLETED, OR

● ACCEPTABLE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED THAT THE SSN APPLICATION WAS MADE THROUGH A COMPLETED FORM SSA 5028 FOR PERSONS WHO HAVE APPLIED DIRECTLY THROUGH SSA OR THROUGH A COMPLETED FORM SSA 2853 OR MODIFIED VERSION (REFER TO B-470-FITAP/SNAP ENUMERATION AT BIRTH PROJECT), AND THE SSN IS REPORTED UPON RECEIPT.

B-410-FITAP - PO ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

IN CASES IN WHICH A HOUSEHOLD IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE OR APPLY FOR AN SSN FOR A NEWBORN IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE BABY’S BIRTH, THE HOUSEHOLD MUST PROVIDE THE SSN OR PROOF OF APPLICATION FOR A SSN FOR A NEWBORN *** * AT ITS NEXT REDETERMINATION OR WITHIN SIX MONTHS FOLLOWING THE MONTH IN WHICH THE BABY IS BORN, WHICHEVER IS LATER. **

***

B-411-FITAP - PO INITIAL CERTIFICATION OR ADDING PERSONS

ALL MEMBERS EXCEPT NEWBORNS MUST PROVIDE VERBALLY OR IN WRITING A SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER OR APPLY FOR A NUMBER BEFORE CERTIFICATION. IF A MEMBER DOES NOT DO THIS, AND GOOD CAUSE FOR FAILURE TO TIMELY APPLY FOR AN SSN IS NOT ESTABLISHED, THE MEMBER IS NOT ELIGIBLE.

IF GOOD CAUSE IS ESTABLISHED AT APPLICATION, THE MEMBER MAY BE INCLUDED FOR ONE MONTH IN ADDITION TO THE MONTH OF APPLICATION. GOOD CAUSE MUST BE ESTABLISHED EVERY 30 DAYS THEREAFTER.

II. PROCEDURES

B-411-FITAP - PR INITIAL CERTIFICATION OR ADDING PERSONS

2 of 2 OBTAIN A SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER (SSN) OR ACCEPTABLE PROOF THAT THE CLIENT HAS APPLIED FOR AN SSN.

IF THE MEMBER DOES NOT PROVIDE THE SSN OR ACCEPTABLE PROOF OF APPLICATION FOR AN SSN, AND GOOD CAUSE FOR FAILURE TO TIMELY APPLY FOR AN SSN IS NOT ESTABLISHED, DISQUALIFY THE MEMBER BY ENTERING THE APPROPRIATE INCLUSION/EXCLUSION CODE AND INCLUSION/EXCLUSION REASON CODE ON THE REGISTER MAINTAIN MEMBER BY CASE SCREEN ON LAMI.

If good cause is not established for a person required to be in the assistance unit, exclude the person and budget income without allocation for needs. If the unenumerated person is the only child in the assistance unit, close or reject the case as there is no eligible child in the home. If an SSN is not provided for a person not required to be in the assistance unit, do not include that person.

Do not deny or delay benefits pending issuance of an SSN after receipt of completed Form 1ER from the Social Security Administration indicating the enumeration activity is completed.

Allow thirty days from the first day of the first full month of benefits for all members except newborns to report the SSN to the agency. Staff should set a task in CAFÉ to ensure the SSN is provided timely.

IF GOOD CAUSE IS ESTABLISHED AT APPLICATION AND THE MEMBER IS INCLUDED, ESTABLISH GOOD CAUSE EVERY 30 DAYS THEREAFTER.

INFOPAC REPORT LAMR55P - PSEUDO SSN MUST BE CHECKED AND ACTION TAKEN FOR ALL ACTIVE CASES APPEARING ON THE LISTING. HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS ON THIS LIST HAVE HAD PSUEDO SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBERS ON LAMI FOR MORE THAN 6 MONTHS.

Agency Name Office of Family Support (OFS) Chapter No./Name 04 – Family Assistance Manual (FAM) Part No./Name B. Eligibility Factors (FITAP) Section No./Name B-400 Enumeration/Social Security Numbers (FITAP) Document No./Name B-420-FITAP Applying For A Social Security Number (SSN) Dates Issue February 27, 1998 Effective March 01, 1998

1 of 1

A CLIENT WHO DOES NOT HAVE A SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER OR CANNOT FURNISH ONE MUST: * ● PRESENT THE FORM 1ER TO THE LOCAL SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE WITHIN 10 DAYS, OR **

● PROVIDE ACCEPTABLE PROOF OF SSN APPLICATION AS OUTLINED IN B-470, OR BY FORM SSA 5028, * AND **

● COOPERATE IN PROVIDING ALL INFORMATION THE SSA REQUIRES. * IF THE CLIENT HAS NOT SUPPLIED ALL NECESSARY DOCUMENTATION TO THE LOCAL SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE FOR ANY MEMBER, AND GOOD CAUSE IS NOT ESTABLISHED, DISQUALIFY THAT MEMBER UNTIL HE COMPLIES WITH THE SSA OR PROVIDES HIS SSN. **

THE WORKER MUST:

1. ASSIGN OR SECURE AN INTERIM STATE I.D. NUMBER FOR ANY INDIVIDUAL WHO DOES NOT HAVE AN SSN.

2. EXPLAIN THE PURPOSE AND USE OF SSN INFORMATION AS SPECIFIED ON FORM 4.

3. EXPLAIN TO THE CLIENT THE DOCUMENTS NECESSARY TO COMPLETE THE SSN APPLICATION AND COMPLETE FORM 1ER, IF APPLICABLE.

4. REFER THE APPLICANT, WITH A FORM 1ER TO THE LOCAL SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE IF SSN APPLICATION HAS NOT ALREADY BEEN MADE THROUGH ANOTHER PROCEDURE.

5. ALLOW SSA NO LESS THAN 15 CALENDAR DAYS TO RETURN THE COMPLETED FORM 1ER.

6. REFER TO B-411 (DOCNO: B-410) IF THE FORM 1ER IS NOT RECEIVED OR IF THE FORM INDICATES THAT THE APPLICATION WAS NOT COMPLETED FOR ANY OF THE *** PERSONS NEEDING A NUMBER.

1 of 1 A CLIENT WHO DOES NOT HAVE A SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER OR CANNOT FURNISH ONE MUST:

● PRESENT THE FORM 1ER TO THE LOCAL SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE WITHIN 10 DAYS, OR

● PROVIDE ACCEPTABLE PROOF OF SSN APPLICATION AS OUTLINED IN B-470, OR BY FORM SSA 5028, AND

THE WORKER MUST:

1. ASSIGN OR SECURE AN INTERIM STATE I.D. NUMBER FOR ANY INDIVIDUAL WHO DOES NOT HAVE AN SSN.

2. EXPLAIN THE PURPOSE AND USE OF SSN INFORMATION AS SPECIFIED ON FORM 4.

3. EXPLAIN TO THE CLIENT THE DOCUMENTS NECESSARY TO COMPLETE THE SSN APPLICATION AND COMPLETE FORM 1ER, IF APPLICABLE.

4. REFER THE APPLICANT, WITH A FORM 1ER TO THE LOCAL SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE IF SSN APPLICATION HAS NOT ALREADY BEEN MADE THROUGH ANOTHER PROCEDURE.

5. ALLOW SSA NO LESS THAN 15 CALENDAR DAYS TO RETURN THE COMPLETED FORM 1ER.

6. REFER TO B-411 (DOCNO: B-410) IF THE FORM 1ER IS NOT RECEIVED OR IF THE FORM INDICATES THAT THE APPLICATION WAS NOT COMPLETED FOR ANY OF THE PERSONS NEEDING A NUMBER.

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

EACH CLIENT’S NAME AND DATE OF BIRTH MUST MATCH SSA RECORDS FOR SSA TO VERIFY THE SSN DATA.

A SSN IS VERIFIED BY ENUMERATION AND DIRECT NOTIFICATION FROM SSA, SSNEVCS, AND SDX PROCESSES. ALL SSNS WILL BE SYSTEM VERIFIED THROUGH ONE OF THESE SOURCES.

SSN(S) VERIFIED BY SIEVS AUTOMATICALLY POPULATE THE NON-FINANCIAL MEMBER SCREEN ON LAMI WITH A VERIFICATION CODE 67.

THE CLIENT IS RESPONSIBLE TO REPORT A VALID SSN AND CLEAR DISCREPANCIES RELATED TO THEIR NAME AND/OR DATE OF BIRTH ON FILE AT THE SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE.

II. PROCEDURES

ENTER THE UNVERIFIED SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER (SSN) REPORTED BY/FOR THE INDIVIDUAL ON LAMI.

IF THE CLIENT HAS A SOCIAL SECURITY CARD, BUT THE NAME ON THE CARD IS DIFFERENT FROM THE NAME HE IS USING, USE THE NAME AS IT APPEARS ON THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD FOR DCFS PURPOSES.

● ADVISE THE CLIENT TO GO TO THE SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE TO REQUEST A NAME CHANGE. UPON RECEIPT OF VERIFICATION FROM THE CLIENT THAT THE SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION HAS PROCESSED A NAME CHANGE, ADJUST DCFS RECORDS AND LAMI ACCORDINGLY.

UNVERIFIED SSN(S) ARE LISTED ON INFOPAC REPORT SVM533. LOCAL AGENCY STAFF MUST RESEARCH AND CLEAR SSN DISCREPANCIES. * BASED ON THE NON-MATCH CODE FOR THE INDIVIDUAL. THE CODES ARE AS FOLLOWS:

1 - SSN NOT IN FILE (NEVER ISSUED TO ANYONE) 2 - NAME AND DATE OF BIRTH MATCH, BUT SEX CODE DOES NOT MATCH 3 - NAME AND SEX CODE MATCH, BUT DATE OF BIRTH DOES NOT MATCH 4 - NAME MATCHES, BUT DATE OF BIRTH AND SEX CODE DO NOT MATCH 5 - NAME DOES NOT MATCH, AND DATE OF BIRTH AND SEX CODE WERE NOT CHECKED

CHECK ONBASE FOR VERIFICATION OF THE NAME, SSN, DATE OF BIRTH AND SEX, REVIEW INFORMATION THE CLIENT REPORTED FOR THESE ITEMS AND DETERMINE IF THIS INFORMATION IS CORRECT IN LAMI. IF ANY OF THE ITEMS ARE INCORRECT BASED ON THE

2 of 2 CLIENT’S STATEMENT AND THE VERIFICATION PROVIDED, UPDATE LAMI WITH THE CORRECT INFORMATION AND DISPOSITION THE CASE.

IF INFORMATION PROVIDED BY THE CLIENT IS DISCREPANT:

FOR NON-MATCH CODE 1, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE IF THE SSN IS CORRECT. IF THE SSN PROVIDED IS THE SAME AND A COPY OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD IS NOT IN ONBASE, REQUEST A COPY OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD. IF THE VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, REMOVE THE MEMBER OR CLOSE THE CASE IF THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD.

FOR A NON-MATCH CODE 2, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE THE CORRECT SEX OF THE MEMBER.

FOR A NON-MATCH CODE 3, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE THE CORRECT DATE OF BIRTH. IF THE DATE OF BIRTH ENTERED IS THE SAME AND VERIFICATION IS NOT IN ONBASE, REQUEST BIRTH VERIFICATION. IF VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, REMOVE THE MEMBER OR CLOSE THE CASE IF THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD.

FOR NON-MATCH CODE 4, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE THE CORRECT DATE OF BIRTH AND SEX OF THE MEMBER.

FOR NON-MATCH CODE 5, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE THE NAME ON THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD. IF IT IS THE SAME AS WHAT IS IN LAMI, REQUEST A COPY OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD. IF VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, REMOVE THE MEMBER OR CLOSE THE CASE IF THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD.

IF VERIFICATION IS REQUESTED AND NOT PROVIDED, COMPLETE A FORM 20CD TO RECOVER BENEFITS.

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

A CLIENT MAY APPLY FOR AN SSN FOR A NEWBORN WHILE IN THE HOSPITAL. THE CLIENT WILL BE GIVEN PROOF OF APPLICATION WHICH WILL BE FORM SSA 2853 OR A MODIFIED VERSION OF THE FORM WHICH VERIFIES THE SSN APPLICATION HAS BEEN MADE. ALSO, SOME BIRTH CERTIFICATES WILL INDICATE WHETHER AN SSN APPLICATION HAS BEEN MADE. A COPY OF THE VERIFICATION MUST BE FILED IN THE CASE RECORD.

TO BE ACCEPTABLE VERIFICATION THE FORM SSA 2853 MUST INCLUDE:

● THE NAME OF THE NEWBORN AND

● THE DATE AND SIGNATURE OF AN AUTHORIZED HOSPITAL OFFICIAL.

A MODIFIED FORM SSA 2853 MUST INCLUDE:

● THE NAMES OF THE PARENT AND NEWBORN,

● THE DATE AND SIGNATURE OF AN AUTHORIZED HOSPITAL EMPLOYEE AND

● THE NAME AND ADDRESS OF THE HOSPITAL.

A CHILD'S BIRTH CERTIFICATE MUST INCLUDE:

● THE NAME OF THE NEWBORN,

● THE SIGNATURE OF ONE AUTHORIZED HOSPITAL OFFICIAL AND

● A "YES" BLOCK TO INDICATE ELECTION TO APPLY.

II. PROCEDURES

WHEN A NEWBORN IS ENUMERATED THROUGH THIS PROCEDURE, THE SSN MUST BE PROVIDED TO THE AGENCY UPON ITS RECEIPT. PROVIDE THE CLIENT WITH A SELF- ADDRESSED STAMPED ENVELOPE FOR THIS PURPOSE.

IN CASES IN WHICH A HOUSEHOLD IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE OR APPLY FOR AN SSN FOR A NEWBORN IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE BABY’S BIRTH, THE HOUSEHOLD MUST PROVIDE THE SSN OR PROOF OF APPLICATION FOR A SSN FOR A NEWBORN *** * AT ITS NEXT REDETERMINATION OR WITHIN SIX MONTHS FOLLOWING THE MONTH IN WHICH THE BABY IS BORN, WHICHEVER IS LATER. **

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Independence (EI) Part No./Name B – Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-400-FITAP-SNAP Enumeration/Social Security Numbers Document No./Name B-410-SNAP Eligibility Requirement Effective Date September 1, 2026

1 of 3 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

REFER TO CHAPTER 7, PART D FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON THE ENUMERATION PROCESS.

THE HOUSEHOLD MUST PROVIDE A SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER (SSN) OR ACCEPTABLE PROOF OF APPLICATION FOR AN SSN FOR ALL HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS. THE ENUMERATION REQUIREMENT IS MET WHEN:

• A COMPLETED FORM 1ER IS RECEIVED INDICATING THAT THE APPLICATION HAS BEEN COMPLETED, OR

• ACCEPTABLE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED THAT THE SSN APPLICATION WAS MADE THROUGH A COMPLETED FORM SSA 5028 FOR PERSONS WHO HAVE APPLIED DIRECTLY THROUGH SSA OR THROUGH A COMPLETED FORM SSA 2853 OR MODIFIED VERSION (REFER TO B-470-FITAP/SNAP ENUMERATION AT BIRTH PROJECT), AND THE SSN IS REPORTED UPON RECEIPT.

B-410-SNAP - PO ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

IN CASES IN WHICH A HOUSEHOLD IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE OR APPLY FOR AN SSN FOR A NEWBORN IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE BABY’S BIRTH, THE HOUSEHOLD MUST PROVIDE THE SSN OR PROOF OF APPLICATION FOR A SSN FOR A NEWBORN AT ITS NEXT REDETERMINATION OR WITHIN SIX MONTHS FOLLOWING THE MONTH IN WHICH THE BABY IS BORN, WHICHEVER IS LATER.

Categorically eligible households are considered to have met this requirement.

B-411-SNAP – PO INITIAL CERTIFICATION OR ADDING PERSONS

ALL MEMBERS EXCEPT NEWBORNS MUST PROVIDE VERBALLY OR IN WRITING A SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER OR APPLY FOR A NUMBER BEFORE CERTIFICATION. IF A MEMBER DOES NOT DO THIS, AND GOOD CAUSE FOR FAILURE TO TIMELY APPLY FOR AN SSN IS NOT ESTABLISHED, THE MEMBER IS NOT ELIGIBLE.

IF GOOD CAUSE IS ESTABLISHED AT APPLICATION, THE MEMBER MAY BE INCLUDED FOR ONE MONTH IN ADDITION TO THE MONTH OF APPLICATION. GOOD CAUSE MUST BE ESTABLISHED EVERY 30 DAYS THEREAFTER.

Exception: If the case is expedited, an SSN does not have to be provided prior to certification (See C-665- PO - SNAP).

2 of 3

B-412-SNAP - PO EXPEDITED SERVICES

B-412-1-SNAP - PO Application Date on or Before the 15th of the Month

Household members other than newborns who are unable to furnish or apply for a social security number before certification can receive benefits with the household in the initial month. They must provide or apply for their social security number before the household's next monthly issuance or be disqualified.

• If the household fails to submit or apply for an SSN without good cause, an advance notice must be sent to remove the disqualified member(s) effective the following month.

• If the household applies for benefits at a Social Security Administration office, allow thirty days from the first day of the first full month to obtain the SSN.

B-412-2-SNAP - PO Application Date After the 15th of the Month (Simultaneous Issuance)

Household members other than newborns who are unable to furnish or apply for a social security number before certification can receive benefits with the household in both the initial month and the second month. They must provide or apply for their social security number before the household's next monthly issuance or be disqualified.

• If the household fails to submit or apply for an SSN without good cause, an advance notice must be sent to remove the disqualified member(s) effective the following month.

• If the household applies for benefits at a Social Security Administration office, allow thirty days from the first day of the first full month to obtain the SSN.

II. PROCEDURES

B-411-SNAP - PR INITIAL CERTIFICATION OR ADDING PERSONS

OBTAIN A SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER (SSN) OR ACCEPTABLE PROOF THAT THE CLIENT HAS APPLIED FOR AN SSN.

IF THE MEMBER DOES NOT PROVIDE THE SSN OR ACCEPTABLE PROOF OF APPLICATION FOR AN SSN, AND GOOD CAUSE FOR FAILURE TO TIMELY APPLY FOR AN SSN IS NOT ESTABLISHED, DISQUALIFY THE MEMBER BY SELECTING THE APPROPRIATE REASON ON THE REASON SSN NOT APPLIED FOR DROPDOWN ON THE PERSON DEMOGRAPHICS – SSN APPLICATION SCREEN IN LITE.

If the household fails to submit or apply for an SSN without good cause, disqualify the member by selecting the appropriate reason on the Reason SSN Not Applied For dropdown on the Person Demographics – SSN Application screen in LITE.

LITE will automatically send Advance Notice of Adverse Action to remove the disqualified member(s) from the SNAP household effective the month following the second month of certification.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Independence (EI) Part No./Name B – Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-400-FITAP-SNAP Enumeration/Social Security Numbers Document No./Name B-450-SNAP How An SSN Is Verified Effective Date September 1, 2026

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

EACH CLIENT’S NAME AND DATE OF BIRTH MUST MATCH SSA RECORDS FOR SSA TO VERIFY THE SSN DATA.

A SSN IS VERIFIED BY ENUMERATION AND DIRECT NOTIFICATION FROM SSA, SSNEVCS, AND SDX PROCESSES. ALL SSNS WILL BE SYSTEM VERIFIED THROUGH ONE OF THESE SOURCES. t SSN VERIFICATION FOR SSN(S) VERIFIED BY SIEVS AUTOMATICALLY POPULATES ON THE PERSON - DETAILS SCREEN IN LITE.

THE CLIENT IS RESPONSIBLE TO REPORT A VALID SSN AND CLEAR DISCREPANCIES RELATED TO THEIR NAME AND/OR DATE OF BIRTH ON FILE AT THE SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE.

II. PROCEDURES

ENTER THE UNVERIFIED SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER (SSN) REPORTED BY/FOR THE INDIVIDUAL IN LITE.

IF THE CLIENT HAS A SOCIAL SECURITY CARD, BUT THE NAME ON THE CARD IS DIFFERENT FROM THE NAME HE IS USING, USE THE NAME AS IT APPEARS ON THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD FOR LDH PURPOSES.

• ADVISE THE CLIENT TO GO TO THE SOCIAL SECURITY OFFICE TO REQUEST A NAME CHANGE. UPON RECEIPT OF VERIFICATION FROM THE CLIENT THAT THE SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION HAS PROCESSED A NAME CHANGE, ADJUST LDH RECORDS AND LITE ACCORDINGLY.

UNVERIFIED SSN(S) ARE LISTED ON INFOPAC REPORT SVM533. LOCAL AGENCY STAFF MUST RESEARCH AND CLEAR SSN DISCREPANCIES. BASED ON THE NON-MATCH CODE FOR THE INDIVIDUAL. THE CODES ARE AS FOLLOWS:

1 - SSN NOT IN FILE (NEVER ISSUED TO ANYONE) 2 - NAME AND DATE OF BIRTH MATCH, BUT SEX CODE DOES NOT MATCH 3 - NAME AND SEX CODE MATCH, BUT DATE OF BIRTH DOES NOT MATCH 4 - NAME MATCHES, BUT DATE OF BIRTH AND SEX CODE DO NOT MATCH 5 - NAME DOES NOT MATCH, AND DATE OF BIRTH AND SEX CODE WERE NOT CHECKED

CHECK THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY SYSTEM FOR VERIFICATION OF THE NAME, SSN, DATE OF BIRTH AND SEX, REVIEW INFORMATION THE CLIENT REPORTED FOR THESE ITEMS AND DETERMINE IF THIS INFORMATION IS CORRECT IN LITE. IF ANY OF THE ITEMS ARE INCORRECT BASED ON THE CLIENT’S STATEMENT AND THE VERIFICATION PROVIDED,

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Independence (EI) Part No./Name B – Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-400-FITAP-SNAP Enumeration/Social Security Numbers Document No./Name B-450-SNAP How An SSN Is Verified Effective Date September 1, 2026

2 of 2 UPDATE LITE WITH THE CORRECT INFORMATION, RUN ELIGIBILITY AND AUTHORIZE THE CASE.

IF INFORMATION PROVIDED BY THE CLIENT IS DISCREPANT:

FOR NON-MATCH CODE 1, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE IF THE SSN IS CORRECT. IF THE SSN PROVIDED IS THE SAME AND A COPY OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD IS NOT IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY SYSTEM, REQUEST A COPY OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD. IF THE VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, REMOVE THE MEMBER OR CLOSE THE CASE IF THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD.

FOR A NON-MATCH CODE 2, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE THE CORRECT SEX OF THE MEMBER.

FOR A NON-MATCH CODE 3, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE THE CORRECT DATE OF BIRTH. IF THE DATE OF BIRTH ENTERED IS THE SAME AND VERIFICATION IS NOT IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY SYSTEM, REQUEST BIRTH VERIFICATION. IF VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, REMOVE THE MEMBER OR CLOSE THE CASE IF THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD.

FOR NON-MATCH CODE 4, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE THE CORRECT DATE OF BIRTH AND SEX OF THE MEMBER.

FOR NON-MATCH CODE 5, CONTACT THE CLIENT TO DETERMINE THE NAME ON THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD. IF IT IS THE SAME AS WHAT IS IN LITE, REQUEST A COPY OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY CARD. IF VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, REMOVE THE MEMBER OR CLOSE THE CASE IF THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD.

IF VERIFICATION IS REQUESTED AND NOT PROVIDED, COMPLETE A FORM 20CD TO RECOVER BENEFITS.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

OFS 20CD Form/Instructions Report of Claim Determination

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Independence (EI) Part No./Name B – Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-400-FITAP-SNAP Enumeration/Social Security Numbers Document No./Name B-470-SNAP Enumeration At Birth Project Effective Date September 1, 2026

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

A CLIENT MAY APPLY FOR AN SSN FOR A NEWBORN WHILE IN THE HOSPITAL. THE CLIENT WILL BE GIVEN PROOF OF APPLICATION WHICH WILL BE FORM SSA 2853 OR A MODIFIED VERSION OF THE FORM WHICH VERIFIES THE SSN APPLICATION HAS BEEN MADE. ALSO, SOME BIRTH CERTIFICATES WILL INDICATE WHETHER AN SSN APPLICATION HAS BEEN MADE. A COPY OF THE VERIFICATION MUST BE FILED IN THE CASE RECORD.

TO BE ACCEPTABLE VERIFICATION THE FORM SSA 2853 MUST INCLUDE:

• THE NAME OF THE NEWBORN AND

• THE DATE AND SIGNATURE OF AN AUTHORIZED HOSPITAL OFFICIAL.

A MODIFIED FORM SSA 2853 MUST INCLUDE:

• THE NAMES OF THE PARENT AND NEWBORN,

• THE DATE AND SIGNATURE OF AN AUTHORIZED HOSPITAL EMPLOYEE AND

• THE NAME AND ADDRESS OF THE HOSPITAL.

A CHILD'S BIRTH CERTIFICATE MUST INCLUDE:

• THE NAME OF THE NEWBORN,

• THE SIGNATURE OF ONE AUTHORIZED HOSPITAL OFFICIAL, AND

• A "YES" BLOCK TO INDICATE ELECTION TO APPLY.

II. PROCEDURES

WHEN A NEWBORN IS ENUMERATED THROUGH THIS PROCEDURE, THE SSN MUST BE PROVIDED TO THE AGENCY UPON ITS RECEIPT. PROVIDE THE CLIENT WITH A SELF- ADDRESSED STAMPED ENVELOPE FOR THIS PURPOSE.

IN CASES IN WHICH A HOUSEHOLD IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE OR APPLY FOR AN SSN FOR A NEWBORN IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE BABY’S BIRTH, THE HOUSEHOLD MUST PROVIDE THE SSN OR PROOF OF APPLICATION FOR A SSN FOR A NEWBORN AT ITS NEXT REDETERMINATION OR WITHIN SIX MONTHS FOLLOWING THE MONTH IN WHICH THE BABY IS BORN, WHICHEVER IS LATER.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 –Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B-Eligibility Factors (FITAP) Section No./Name B-500 Home (FITAP) Document No./Name B-510-FITAP Eligibility Requirement Effective Date May 1, 2016

1 of 2 I.

STATEMENT OF POLICY

A child must reside with a parent or other qualified relative who is responsible for the day-to-day care of the child.

● If the parent is in the home, the parent is the payee, unless a third party payee is required and available.

● If the parent is not in the home, the other qualified relative is the payee.

Eligibility of Two-Parent Households

FITAP households that have two parents residing in the home are not eligible for cash assistance unless at least one parent is determined to be:

● physically or mentally incapacitated, or

● caring for a disabled family member living in the home.

Note: This policy also applies to a pregnant woman only certification in which the father of the unborn child resides in the home.

Cases of applicants or recipients claiming a physical or mental illness or impairment must be reviewed for consideration of incapacity per * C-1510-FITAP **.

Cases of applicants or recipients claiming to care for a disabled family member living in the home must be reviewed for consideration based on documentation from a medical professional. Medical documentation must be obtained and must verify the need for the parent to remain in the home to care for the disabled family member. The need for care must be due to a disability that is expected to last longer than 30 days. The continued need for care must be redetermined and documented at each redetermination.

B-511-FITAP JOINT CUSTODY

When custody of a child is shared, the child is considered living with the parent who is requesting/receiving assistance if the child is in that parent’s home at least one-half of the time.

If the child spends equal time with each parent, only one parent may receive assistance for the child and the other parent is referred to CSE.

II.

PROCEDURES

There are no procedures associated with this policy.

Agency Name Office of Family Support (OFS) Chapter No./Name 04 – Family Assistance Manual (FAM) Part No./Name B. Eligibility Factors (FITAP) Section No./Name B-500 Home (FITAP) Document No./Name B-520-FITAP Temporary Absence From Home Dates Issue February 1, 2006 Effective February 1, 2006

1 of 2

Do not deny benefits when the qualified relative or the child is temporarily out of the home.

If the temporary absence has been or is anticipated to continue beyond 45 days * but will not exceed 180 days:

● determine whether good cause for the absence exists in accordance with the Good Cause reasons cited below, and

● document the record to establish that the nature of the absence is temporary as evidenced by established plans for the return to the home.

Good Cause Reasons for Qualified Relative:

● the qualified relative is out of the home to attend school, training, or Job Corps and comes home at least twice a month to retain responsibility for the care and control of the child.

● the qualified relative is in a medical facility, psychiatric facility, or maternity home. A third party payee may be necessary during the absence of the caretaker relative.

Good Cause Reasons for Child:

● the child is out of the home for a visit including a two or three month summer vacation. (Three months is the maximum time allowed for an out of the home visit.)

● the child is out of the home to attend school, training, or Job Corps for 180 days or less and the caretaker relative is required to provide a portion of financial assistance and/or comes home on weekends.

● the child is in a medical facility, psychiatric facility, or maternity home for 180 days or less.

● additional good cause reasons may be determined on an individual case basis. Supervisory approval and documentation is required.

B-520-1-FITAP Removal of Child or Case Closure Due to Absence From the Home.

Remove the needs of a child that is expected to be out of the home for a visit longer than 3 months when it is known that the absence will exceed 3 months.

Remove the needs of a child that is expected to be out of the home for longer than 180 days when it is known that the absence will exceed 180 days.

Close a FITAP/KCSP case once it is known that the only child in the home is expected to be absent from the home for a visit longer than 3 months.

Agency Name Office of Family Support (OFS) Chapter No./Name 04 – Family Assistance Manual (FAM) Part No./Name B. Eligibility Factors (FITAP) Section No./Name B-500 Home (FITAP) Document No./Name B-520-FITAP Temporary Absence From Home Dates Issue February 1, 2006 Effective February 1, 2006

2 of 2

Close a FITAP/KCSP case once it is known that the only qualified relative or only child in the home is expected to be absent from the home for longer than 180 days when it is known that the absence will exceed 180 days.

Note: Advance notice is required for removal of a child or for closure of a FITAP/KCSP case.

B-520-2-FITAP Reporting Requirement

If the payee failed to timely report a child's absence of more than a 45 day duration and good cause for the absence is not established:

● determine the first month of overpayment or ineligible payment based on the effective month the child should have been removed from the grant, and

● exclude the needs of the child(ren) in determining the amount of the overpayment or ineligible payment, or

● exclude the needs of the payee as well as the child(ren) in determining the amount of the overpayment or ineligible payment if no eligible child or caretaker relative remained in the home. **

B-521-FITAP ASSISTANCE FOR HOMELESS FAMILIES

Do not deny assistance solely because the assistance unit does not reside at a fixed address or in a permanent dwelling. For purpose of this policy, a home is defined as the family setting maintained by the relative with whom the child lives as evidenced by the fact that the relative assumes responsibility for the day to day care of the child.

Assist the homeless client to establish a mailing address which will ensure regular and timely receipt of agency correspondence. This could be the parish office, a local non-profit agency or local Post Office.

NOTE: These clients must meet the residency requirement. See B-910-FITAP.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B- Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-600-FITAP-SNAP Income Document No./Name B-610-FITAP Definitions Effective Date February 1, 2018

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

* B-611-FITAP-PO INCOME **

INCOME IS ANY TYPE OF PAYMENT THAT IS OF GAIN OR BENEFIT TO A HOUSEHOLD. INCOME IS EITHER NON-EXEMPT OR EXEMPT FROM THE BUDGETING PROCESS.

Consider the income of any person who is in the income unit.

DO NOT COUNT MONEY WITHHELD FROM ANY INCOME SOURCE TO REPAY A PRIOR OVERPAYMENT FROM THAT SOURCE.

B-611-1-FITAP - PO Earned Income

INCOME RELATED TO EMPLOYMENT OR SELF-EMPLOYMENT. IT ENTITLES A HOUSEHOLD TO DEDUCTIONS NOT ALLOWED FOR UNEARNED INCOME.

B-611-2-FITAP - PO Unearned Income

INCOME OTHER THAN EARNED INCOME, SUCH AS CHILD SUPPORT AND CONTRIBUTIONS (CASH, CHECK, OR MONEY ORDER) AND BENEFITS FROM SOME OTHER PROGRAMS. UNLESS OTHERWISE INDICATED, NO DEDUCTIONS ARE ALLOWED FROM UNEARNED INCOME.

B-611-3-FITAP - PO Gross Income

The amount of income before any deductions are made.

B-612-FITAP - PO INCOME UNIT

The income unit includes:

● All persons included in the assistance unit.

***

● The alien sponsor and spouse.

● * All persons required to be included in the assistance unit who are not included due to: **

o *** An intentional program violation.

o *** The ineligibility of fleeing felons and probation/parole violators. (Refer to *** C-140-

FITAP.)

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 04 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B – Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-600-FITAP-SNAP Income Document No./Name B-610-SNAP Definitions Effective Date February 1, 2018

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

* B-611-SNAP - PO INCOME **

INCOME IS ANY TYPE OF PAYMENT THAT IS OF GAIN OR BENEFIT TO A HOUSEHOLD. INCOME IS EITHER NON-EXEMPT OR EXEMPT FROM THE BUDGETING PROCESS.

Consider the income of any household member, ineligible alien, disqualified member (SSN, IPV, work registration requirements, ABAWD work requirement, fleeing felon, probation/parole violation), or member excluded because of questionable citizenship.

DO NOT COUNT MONEY WITHHELD FROM ANY INCOME SOURCE TO REPAY A PRIOR OVERPAYMENT FROM THAT SOURCE.

EXCEPTION: Count the amount recouped for FITAP or SSI fraud, which has been verified.

B-611-1-SNAP - PO Earned Income

INCOME RELATED TO EMPLOYMENT OR SELF-EMPLOYMENT. IT ENTITLES A HOUSEHOLD TO DEDUCTIONS NOT ALLOWED FOR UNEARNED INCOME.

B-611-2-SNAP - PO Unearned Income

INCOME OTHER THAN EARNED INCOME, SUCH AS CHILD SUPPORT AND CONTRIBUTIONS (CASH, CHECK, OR MONEY ORDER) AND BENEFITS FROM SOME OTHER PROGRAMS. UNLESS OTHERWISE INDICATED, NO DEDUCTIONS ARE ALLOWED FROM UNEARNED INCOME.

B-611-3-SNAP - PO Gross Income

The amount of income after excluding child support payments made by a member of the household but before any deductions are made.

B-612-SNAP - PO RESERVED

B-613-SNAP - PO PROSPECTIVE BUDGETING

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name B – Eligibility Factors Section No./Name B-600-FITAP-SNAP Income Document No./Name B-620-FITAP Types of Income Effective Date May 1, 2023

1 of 28 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

THERE ARE DIFFERENCES BETWEEN FITAP AND SNAP IN NON-EXEMPT AND EXEMPT INCOME. ANY INCOME NOT SPECIFICALLY EXEMPTED IN THIS SECTION IS COUNTED FOR FITAP AND SNAP.

B-620-1-FITAP- PO Adoption Subsidy Income

ADOPTION SUBSIDY INCOME IS PROVIDED BY CHILD WELFARE TO CERTAIN FAMILIES WHO ADOPT CHILDREN.

Do not count Adoption Subsidy.

Include the child in the assistance unit.

B-620-1A-FITAP- PO Agent Orange Settlement Payments Income

DO NOT COUNT ANY PAYMENTS MADE FROM THE AGENT ORANGE SETTLEMENT FUND. THIS INCLUDES BOTH DISABILITY PAYMENTS MADE TO VETERANS EACH YEAR THEY ARE DISABLED AND NON-RECURRING LUMP-SUM PAYMENTS MADE TO SURVIVORS OF DECEASED VETERANS. THIS EXCLUSION IS RETROACTIVE TO JANUARY 1, 1989.

B-620-1B-FITAP- PO Achieving a Better Life Experience (ABLE)

AN ABLE ACCOUNT IS A TAX-FAVORED SAVINGS ACCOUNT ESTABLISHED TO PROVIDE SECURE FUNDING FOR DISABILITY-RELATED EXPENSES ON BEHALF OF DESIGNATED BENEFICIARIES DEEMED DISABLED BEFORE THE AGE OF 26 YEARS OLD.

DO NOT COUNT THE VALUE OF CONTRIBUTIONS TO OR DISTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED FROM ABLE ACCOUNTS.

B-620-2-FITAP- PO Agriculture and Stabilization and Conservation Service (ASCS) Payments Income

CASH PAYMENTS ARE COUNTED AS EARNED, SELF-EMPLOYMENT INCOME UNLESS PAYMENTS ARE MADE AS THE RESULT OF A PRESIDENTIALLY DECLARED DISASTER OR EMERGENCY. IF ASCS PAYMENTS ARE MADE AS A RESULT OF A PRESIDENTIALLY DECLARED DISASTER OR EMERGENCY, THEY ARE EXCLUDED FROM INCOME.

B-620-3-FITAP- PO Alien Sponsor's Income

CONSIDER INCOME OF THE SPONSOR AND THE SPONSOR'S SPOUSE IN ACCORDANCE WITH E-100-FITAP-SNAP.
