body:
Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 - Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C - Case Processing Section No./Name C-500-FITAP-SNAP Management Document No./Name C-540-FITAP Management - Sources of Verification Effective Date December 15, 2022

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

IF A MANAGEMENT REVIEW IS REQUIRED TO BE CONDUCTED AS OUTLINED IN C-520-FITAP AND THE CLIENT CANNOT EXPLAIN MANAGEMENT, THE SITUATION BECOMES QUESTIONABLE AND MAY REQUIRE VERIFICATION. VERIFY ANY QUESTIONABLE INFORMATION WHICH AFFECTS ELIGIBILITY. SOURCES MAY INCLUDE LWC CLEARANCES, COLLATERAL CONTACTS, COPIES OF PAID OR UNPAID BILLS, CONTACTS WITH FORMER EMPLOYERS OR ABSENT PARENTS, OR ANY OTHER SOURCE WHICH CAN VERIFY THE CLIENT'S SITUATION.

* DOCUMENT THE HOUSEHOLD’S EXPLANATION OF MANAGEMENT ON THE MANAGEMENT REVIEW- DETAILS SCREEN IN LITE. IF VERIFICATION OF MANAGEMENT IS REQUIRED, THE REQUEST MUST BE MADE ON THE APPROPRIATE SCREENS IN DATA COLLECTION SO THAT A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION WITH THE APPLICABLE FORM IS SENT. **

II. PROCEDURES

THE WORKER MAY REQUEST FROM THE CLIENT ANY VERIFICATION NEEDED THAT THE CLIENT CAN REASONABLY PROVIDE. THE WORKER MAY CONTACT COLLATERALS, FORMER EMPLOYERS, ABSENT PARENTS, OR ANY OTHER SOURCE WHICH CAN VERIFY THE CLIENT’S SITUATION. DO NOT REQUEST VERIFICATION THAT WILL BE IMPOSSIBLE FOR THE CLIENT TO OBTAIN. ***

* TO DOCUMENT THE HOUSEHOLD’S EXPLANATION OF MANAGEMENT ON THE MANAGEMENT REVIEW- DETAILS SCREEN IN LITE TAKE THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS:

 SELECT ‘YES’ TO THE COMPLETE MANAGEMENT REVIEW,  SELECT THE APPROPRIATE EXPLANATION OF MANAGEMENT,  SELECT THE VERIFICATION TYPE (CLIENT STATEMENT, PAST DUE BILLS, OR OTHER) OR SPECIFY THE VERIFCATION TYPE IF OTHER, AND  CLICK ‘NEXT’.

NOTE: STAFF WILL NO LONGER BE ABLE TO GENERATE THE OFS 18C AND THE APPLICABLE FORMS (OFS 80, OFS 81, AND OFS 86) TO REQUEST VERIFICATION OF MANAGEMENT FROM THE MANANGEMENT REVIEW DETAILS SCREEN. STAFF MUST NAVIGATE TO THE APPLICABLE SCREEN IN DATA COLLECTION AND SEND A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION AND THE APPROPRIATE NOTICE ATTACHMENT.

THE COLLATERAL STATEMENT (OFS 80) IS REQUESTED ON THE PERSON HOUSEHOLD STATUS SCREEN, THE LANDLORD VERIFICATION (OFS 81) IS REQUESTED ON SHELTER DETAILS SCREEN, AND THE VERIFICATION OF CONTRIBUTIONS (OFS 86) IS REQUESTED ON THE UNEARNED DETAILS SCREEN.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-600-FITAP Application Processing Document No./Name C-610-FITAP Procedures For Applicants Effective Date May 1, 2023

1 of 5 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

C-611-FITAP - PO REQUEST FOR APPLICATION

THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD, OTHER RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, OR HIS REPRESENTATIVE MAY REQUEST AN APPLICATION BY CONTACTING ANY PARISH OFFICE OR THE CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER, OR MAY DOWNLOAD THE MANUAL APPLICATION FORM THAT MAY BE PRINTED FROM THE DCFS WEBSITE. IF THE REQUEST IS MADE TO THE PARISH OFFICE OR THE CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER, A STAFF MEMBER MUST PROVIDE AN APPLICATION FORM THAT INCLUDES THE OFS 1VR VOTER REGISTRATION DECLARATION STATEMENT, AN OFS 4I, INFORMATION ABOUT THE APPLICATION FOR ASSISTANCE, A LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATON FORM, AND, IF NECESSARY, A POSTAGE-PAID RETURN ENVELOPE TO THE INDIVIDUAL THE SAME DAY THE REQUEST IS RECEIVED.

IF THE REQUEST FOR THE APPLICATION IS MADE BY TELEPHONE, THE STAFF MEMBER MUST ADVISE THE INDIVIDUAL WHO CONTACTED THE OFFICE THAT THE APPLICATION MAY BE DOWNLOADED FROM THE DCFS WEBSITE, THAT AN APPLICATION MAY BE COMPLETED ONLINE AND SUBMITTED ELECTRONICALLY THROUGH THE CAFÉ SELF-SERVICE PORTAL (SSP), * OR THAT THE APPLICATION MAY BE COMPLETED BY TELEPHONE. **

A STAFF MEMBER MUST ALSO PROVIDE ASSISTANCE WITH COMPLETING A LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION FORM UNLESS ASSISTANCE IS REFUSED. THE DCFS EMPLOYEE MUST SIGN, CIRCLE ‘PA’ AND DATE ALL APPLICATION FORMS RETURNED TO DCFS.

C-612-FITAP - PO ONLINE APPLICATION

THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD, OTHER RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, or someone acting responsibly for the household MAY COMPLETE AN ONLINE APPLICATION AND SUBMIT THE APPLICATION ELECTRONICALLY THROUGH THE CAFÉ SELF-SERVICE PORTAL (SSP).

ONLY SECTIONS OF THE APPLICATION RELEVANT TO THE PROGRAM BEING APPLIED FOR WILL BE DISPLAYED. THE APPLICANT HAS THE OPTION TO CANCEL THE ENTIRE APPLICATION. TO SUBMIT THE APPLICATION TO DCFS, THE APPLICANT MUST READ THE RIGHTS AND RESPONSIBILITIES AND THE ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE AGREEMENT AND CLICK THE APPROPRIATE BOXES TO ACKNOWLEDGE THEY READ AND UNDERSTAND THEIR RIGHTS AND RESPONSIBILITIES. THE APPLICANT MUST THEN ENTER THEIR SIX DIGIT PIN AND CLICK THE SUBMIT BUTTON. CLIENT-ENTERED INFORMATION WILL DISPLAY BUT CANNOT BE CHANGED BY DCFS STAFF OR THE CLIENT ONCE SUBMITTED.

2 of 5 C-612-1- FITAP-PO ONLINE APPLICATION BY CSR (TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE)

CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVES (CSR) IN THE DCFS CALL CENTER CAN ACCEPT APPLICATIONS FOR SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (SNAP), FAMILY INDEPENDENCE TEMPORARY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (FITAP), AND KINSHIP CARE SUBSIDY PROGRAM (KCSP) BY TELEPHONE UTILIZING A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE. APPLICANTS HAVE THE OPTION TO CALL THE DCFS CALL CENTER AT 1-888-LAHELPU (1- 888-524-3578) TO SUBMIT AN INITIAL APPLICATION FOR SNAP, FITAP, AND KCSP OVER THE TELEPHONE BETWEEN THE HOURS OF * 8:00 AM AND 5:00PM.

C-613-FITAP-PO TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE

ALL APPLICATIONS TAKEN OVER THE TELEPHONE MUST HAVE A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE. A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE IS AN ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE AND HAS THE SAME LEGAL EFFECT AND ENFORCEABILITY AS A WRITTEN SIGNATURE. BY PROVIDING A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE, THE APPLICANT ATTESTS THAT ALL QUESTIONS ON THE APPLICATION WERE UNDERSTOOD AND ANSWERED TRUTHFULLY. PROVIDING A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE CERTIFIES UNDER THE PENALTY OF PERJURY THAT THE INFORMATION GIVEN ON THE APPLICATION IS TRUTHFUL, COMPLETE, AND CORRECT. A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE ALLOWS THE RELEASE OF ANY INFORMATION TO DCFS BY ANY PERSON, AGENCIES, OR FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS THAT HAVE KNOWLEDGE OF THE APPLICANT’S CIRCUMSTANCES TO DETERMINE THE CORRECTNESS OF THEIR CERTIFICATION.

C-614-FITAP-PO - NO FORM APPLICATION BY DCFS STAFF (TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE)

INTAKE STAFF CAN ACCEPT APPLICATIONS FOR SNAP, LaCAP, FITAP, AND KCSP BY TELEPHONE UTILIZING A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE. APPLICANTS HAVE THE OPTION TO CALL 1-888-LAHELPU (1-888-524-3578) OR 1-833-DCFS4U2 ** TO SUBMIT AN INITIAL APPLICATION FOR SNAP, LaCAP, FITAP AND KCSP OVER THE TELEPHONE BETWEEN THE HOURS OF 8:00 AM AND 2:00 PM.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-600-FITAP Application Processing Document No./Name C-610-FITAP Procedures For Applicants Effective Date May 1, 2023

3 of 5 APPLICANT WILL BE ABLE TO USE THE ACCOUNT TO APPLY FOR NEW SERVICES FOR MULTIPLE PROGRAMS, COMPLETE REDETERMINATIONS, AND TRACK THE STATUS OF APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED THROUGH THE * CAFÉ SELF-SERVICE PORTAL (SSP) WITHIN THE PRIOR 60 DAYS. IF THE APPLICANT ATTEMPTS TO LOGIN TO THEIR ACCOUNT UNSUCCESSFULLY THREE CONSECUTIVE TIMES, THE ACCOUNT WILL BE LOCKED FOR FIVE MINUTES. IF THE APPLICANT FORGETS THEIR PASSWORD, PASSWORDS CAN BE RETRIEVED ON THE DCFS CAFÉ WEBSITE BY CLICKING ON THE “FORGOT PASSWORD” LINK. IF THE CLIENT DOES NOT REMEMBER THEIR SECURITY QUESTIONS WHEN ATTEMPTING TO RETRIEVE THE PASSWORD, THEY MAY CONTACT DCFS CALL CENTER, DCFS CLIENT SERVICES AT (225) 342-6700 OR EMAIL LAHELPU.DCFS@LA.GOV TO RESET THEIR PASSWORD. PASSWORDS CAN BE RESET IF THE CLIENT IS ABLE TO PROVIDE THEIR USER ID FOR THEIR ACCOUNT. IF THE CLIENT DOES NOT KNOW THEIR USER ID AND DCFS IS UNABLE TO OBTAIN THE USER ID FROM A PREVIOUS APPLICATION OR SR IN CAFÉ, THE CLIENT IS INFORMED TO CREATE A NEW CAFÉ USER ACCOUNT TO APPLY FOR ADDITIONAL SERVICES.

APPLICANTS MAY COMPLETE THE ONLINE APPLICATION IN ONE SESSION, OR MAY COMPLETE THE APPLICATION IN MORE THAN ONE SESSION BY LOGGING INTO THEIR USER ACCOUNT. THE APPLICATION MUST BE COMPLETED AND SUBMITTED WITHIN 30 DAYS OR IT WILL BE DELETED AND THE APPLICANT WILL BE REQUIRED TO COMPLETE A NEW APPLICATION. THE APPLICATION MAY BE VIEWED FROM THE USER ACCOUNT IN THE CAFÉ ** SELF-SERVICE PORTAL (SSP) AT ANY TIME AFTER THE APPLICATION IS SUBMITTED AND UP TO 60 DAYS AFTER SUBMISSION. THE APPLICANT MAY PRINT A COPY OF THEIR APPLICATION OR MAY SAVE A COPY TO THEIR COMPUTER.

C-612-1-FITAP-PR – ONLINE APPLICATION BY CSR (TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE)

CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVES (CSR) WILL ACCESS THE CAFÉ’ SELF SERVICE PORTAL (SSP) USING A GUEST ACCOUNT AND COMPLETE THE APPLICATION ON BEHALF OF THE APPLICANT, IF REQUESTED.

THE FOLLOWING WILL BE COMPLETED BY THE CSR WHEN COMPLETING THE APPLICATIONS:  REMIND THE APPLICANT THAT THE CALL IS BEING RECORDED.  ACCESS THE CAFÉ SSP.  ASK THE APPLICANT THE QUESTIONS ON THE ONLINE APPLICATION AND COMPLETE THE RESPONSES.  OBTAIN A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE ATTESTING THAT THE INFORMATION PROVIDED IS COMPLETE AND CORRECT.  SUBMIT THE ONLINE APPLICATION.  INFORM THE CALLER THAT AN APPLICATION HAS BEEN SUBMITTED AND AN INTERVIEW IS REQUIRED.  PRINT A COPY OF THE APPLICATION AND MAIL IT TO THE APPLICANT.

4 of 5  * EXPLAIN TO THE APPLICANT THAT THE CALL CAN BE TRANSFERRED TO THE INTERVIEW LINE, IF IT IS BETWEEN 8:00 AM AND 2:00 PM TO BE INTERVIEWED..  INFORM THE APPLICANT OF THE WAIT TIME FOR THE INTERVIEW LINE.  TRANSFER THE APPLICANT TO THE INTERVIEW LINE, IF THE APPLICANT WANTS TO BE INTERVIEWED AT THAT TIME.  EXPLAIN TO THE APPLICANT THAT A LETTER SCHEDULING AN INTERVIEW WILL BE SENT, IF THE APPLICANT CHOOSES NOT TO BE TRANSFERRED TO THE INTERVIEW LINE OR IF IT IS AFTER 2:00 PM. **

C-613-FITAP-PR TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE

A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE MUST BE OBTAINED BY ASKING THE APPLICANT “THIS TELEPHONE CALL HAS BEEN RECORDED TO DOCUMENT THE DETAILS YOU PROVIDED DURING THIS TELEPHONE CONVERSATION. DO YOU CERTIFY UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY THAT THE INFORMATION GIVEN DURING THIS INTERVIEW WAS TRUTHFUL, COMPLETE AND CORRECT TO THE BEST OF YOUR KNOWLEDGE?” THE APPLICANT MUST CONFIRM EITHER “YES” OR “NO”. WHEN THE RESPONSE IS “YES”, SELECT THE CORRESPONDING RADIO BUTTON ON THE ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION SCREEN AND THEN RUN EDBC. WHEN THE RESPONSE IS “NO”, SELECT THE CORRESPONDING RADIO BUTTON. ELIGIBILITY CANNOT BE RUN SINCE A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE IS REQUIRED; THEREFORE, WITHDRAW THE “NO FORM” APPLICATION FOR REFUSAL TO PROVIDE A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE.

C-614 -FITAP-PR - NO FORM APPLICATION BY DCFS STAFF (TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE)

INTAKE STAFF WILL COMPLETE THE APPLICATION WITH THE APPLICANT WHILE IN LITE.

THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS WILL BE TAKEN BY THE INTAKE WORKER WHEN COMPLETING THE APPLICATION:  REMIND THE APPLICANT THAT THE CALL IS BEING RECORDED.  CLICK ON SEARCH WORK ITEM TO DETERMINE IF THE CLIENT HAS SUBMITTED AN APPLICATION. IF NO EXISTING APPLICATION CAN BE FOUND, PROCEED TO APPLICATION REGISTRATION.  CLICK ON APPLICATION REGISTRATION, SELECT “NO FORM” AS THE SOURCE, COMPLETE THE APPLICATION REGISTRATION PAGE AND CLICK NEXT.  NAVIGATE FROM THE ADDRESS AND CONTACT SCREEN. LITE WILL CREATE AN INTAKE WORK ITEM AND ASSIGN TO THE WORKER CREATING THE WORK ITEM IN APPLICATION REGISTRATION. THE SOURCE OF THE WORK ITEM WILL SHOW AS “NO FORM”.  CLICK “SUBMIT” ON THE APPLICATION REGISTRATION SUMMARY SCREEN. UPON CLICKING SUBMIT, THE START DATA COLLECTION BUTTON WILL ENABLE.

CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVES (CSR) WILL ACCESS THE CAFÉ’ SELF-SERVICE PORTAL (SSP) USING A GUEST ACCOUNT AND COMPLETE THE APPLICATION ON BEHALF OF THE APPLICANT, IF REQUESTED.

THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS WILL BE TAKEN BY THE CSR WHEN COMPLETING THE APPLICATION: • REMIND THE APPLICANT THAT THE CALL IS BEING RECORDED. • ACCESS THE CAFÉ’ SSP. • ASK THE APPLICANT THE QUESTIONS ON THE ONLINE APPLICATION AND COMPLETE THE RESPONSES. • OBTAIN A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE ATTESTING THAT THE INFORMATION PROVIDED IS COMPLETE AND CORRECT. • SUBMIT THE ONLINE APPLICATION. • INFORM THE CALLER THAT AN APPLICATION HAS BEEN SUBMITTED AND AN INTERVIEW IS REQUIRED. • PRINT A COPY OF THE APPLICATION AND MAIL IT TO THE APPLICANT. • EXPLAIN TO THE APPLICANT THAT A LETTER SCHEDULING AN INTERVIEW WILL BE SENT.

4 of 5 C-613-SNAP-PR TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE

A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE MUST BE OBTAINED BY ASKING THE APPLICANT “THIS TELEPHONE CALL HAS BEEN RECORDED TO DOCUMENT THE DETAILS YOU PROVIDED DURING THIS TELEPHONE CONVERSATION. DO YOU CERTIFY UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY THAT THE INFORMATION GIVEN DURING THIS INTERVIEW WAS TRUTHFUL, COMPLETE AND CORRECT TO THE BEST OF YOUR KNOWLEDGE?” THE APPLICANT MUST CONFIRM EITHER “YES” OR “NO”. WHEN THE RESPONSE IS “YES”, SELECT THE CORRESPONDING RADIO BUTTON ON THE ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION SCREEN AND THEN RUN EDBC. WHEN THE RESPONSE IS “NO”, SELECT THE CORRESPONDING RADIO BUTTON. ELIGIBILITY CANNOT BE RUN SINCE A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE IS REQUIRED; THEREFORE, WITHDRAW THE “NO FORM” APPLICATION FOR REFUSAL TO PROVIDE A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE.

C-614 -SNAP-PR - NO FORM APPLICATION BY DCFS STAFF (TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE)

INTAKE STAFF WILL COMPLETE THE APPLICATION WITH THE APPLICANT WHILE IN LITE.

THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS WILL BE TAKEN BY THE INTAKE WORKER WHEN COMPLETING THE APPLICATION: • REMIND THE APPLICANT THAT THE CALL IS BEING RECORDED. • CLICK ON SEARCH WORK ITEM TO DETERMINE IF THE CLIENT HAS SUBMITTED AN APPLICATION. IF NO EXISTING APPLICATION CAN BE FOUND, PROCEED TO APPLICATION REGISTRATION. • CLICK ON APPLICATION REGISTRATION, SELECT “NO FORM” AS THE SOURCE, COMPLETE THE APPLICATION REGISTRATION PAGE AND CLICK NEXT. • NAVIGATE FROM THE ADDRESS AND CONTACT SCREEN. LITE WILL CREATE AN INTAKE WORK ITEM AND ASSIGN TO THE WORKER CREATING THE WORK ITEM IN APPLICATION REGISTRATION. THE SOURCE OF THE WORK ITEM WILL SHOW AS “NO FORM”. • CLICK “SUBMIT” ON THE APPLICATION REGISTRATION SUMMARY SCREEN. UPON CLICKING SUBMIT, THE START DATA COLLECTION BUTTON WILL ENABLE. • CLICK “START DATA COLLECTION” BUTTON ON THE APPLICATION REGISTRATION SCREEN TO NAVIGATE TO THE INITIATE DATA COLLECTION SCREEN IN INTAKE MODE. • NAVIGATE THROUGH DATA COLLECTION IN INTAKE MODE. • ASK THE APPLICANT THE QUESTIONS AND COMPLETE THE RESPONSES. • OBTAIN A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE ATTESTING THAT THE INFORMATION PROVIDED IS COMPLETE AND CORRECT. • RUN EDBC. AN APPLICATION SUMMARY WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE MAILED TO THE CLIENT.

1 of 9 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

C-621-FITAP - PO RECEIPT OF APPLICATION

APPLICATIONS MAY BE SUBMITTED IN PERSON, BY MAIL, OVER THE TELEPHONE, OR THROUGH ELECTRONIC TRANSMISSION, SUCH AS FAX, E-MAIL, OR ONLINE. THE APPLICANT MAY REQUEST A COPY OF THEIR APPLICATION IN AN ELECTRONIC FORMAT OR PAPER COPY.

A VALID APPLICATION CONTAINS THE APPLICANT'S NAME, ADDRESS, AND APPROPRIATE SIGNATURE. IF THE APPLICATION DOES NOT CONTAIN A COMPLETE ADDRESS OR APPROPRIATE SIGNATURE, IT IS NOT CONSIDERED VALID. THE APPLICATION MAY BE SIGNED BY THE APPLICANT, ANOTHER RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, OR someone acting responsibly for the household. AN ONLINE APPLICATION CONTAINS AN ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE. AN APPLICATION TAKEN OVER THE TELEPHONE CONTAINS A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE.

THE APPLICATION DATE IS THE DATE THE AGENCY RECEIVES A VALID APPLICATION. HOWEVER, AN APPLICATION RECEIVED AFTER 4:30 PM CENTRAL TIME WILL HAVE AN APPLICATION DATE OF THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY. ONLINE APPLICATIONS AND APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED THROUGH THE DOCUMENT PROCESSING CENTER WILL HAVE THE APPLICATION DATE AUTOMATICALLY POPULATED ON THE WORK ITEM IN LITE. THE APPLICATION DATE FOR AN APPLICATION TAKEN OVER THE TELEPHONE IS THE DATE THE TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE IS OBTAINED.

APPLICATIONS RECEIVED IN A DCFS OFFICE, FAXED DIRECTLY TO THE PARISH OFFICE, OR EMAILED DIRECTLY TO THE WORKER MUST BE DATE STAMPED BY THE RECEIVING OFFICE ON THE DATE OF RECEIPT. THIS MUST BE DONE PRIOR TO SCANNING THE APPLICATION INTO FILENET. IF AN APPLICATION IS SCANNED LOCALLY, A ‘SCAN DATE’ WILL NOT BE DISPLAYED. WHEN INDEXING THE APPLICATION, STAFF MUST UPDATE THE ‘DOCUMENT DATE’ TO INDICATE THE DATE OF RECEIPT. THE 'DOCUMENT DATE’ MUST MATCH THE DATE THE APPLICATION WAS STAMPED BY THE OFFICE. STAFF SHOULD USE THE ‘DOCUMENT DATE’ WHEN DETERMINING THE DATE OF RECEIPT WHEN THERE IS NO ‘SCAN DATE’.

APPLICATIONS RECEIVED THROUGH THE DOCUMENT PROCESSING CENTER WILL HAVE A 'SCAN DATE', WHICH IS THE DATE RECEIVED. IF THE ‘SCAN DATE’ IS AFTER 4:30 PM ON A WORKDAY, THE DATE OF RECEIPT WILL BE THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY.

UPON THE APPLICATION SUBMISSION IN THE CAFÉ SSP, THE APPLICANT IS INFORMED THAT AN APPOINTMENT LETTER WILL BE MAILED WITH THE DATE AND TIME OF THEIR SCHEDULED INTERVIEW AND THAT AN AGENCY REPRESENTATIVE WILL CONTACT THEM TO CONDUCT THEIR INTERVIEW.

2 of 9 UPON RECEIPT OF THE APPLICATION WORK ITEM, LITE ROUTES THE APPLICATION WORK ITEM TO THE BOT FOR REGISTRATION. THE BOT WILL REGISTER WORK ITEMS WITH 80% OR GREATER MPI MATCH RESULTS. WORK ITEMS WITH LESS THAN AN 80% MPI MATCH RESULT ROUTES TO A WORK ITEM OWNER WITH REGISTRATION CHARACTERISTICS. AFTER REGISTRATION, THE WORK ITEM IS ROUTED TO THE WORKER’S DASHBOARD VIA THE STATEWIDE ROUND ROBIN (SWRR). LITE AUTOMATICALLY SCHEDULES AN INTERVIEW FOR A DATE AND TIME BASED ON THE WORKER’S AVAILABILITY AND MAILS AN APPOINTMENT LETTER TO THE APPLICANT.

IF THE APPLICANT MISSES THE SCHEDULED INTERVIEW, THE WORKER WILL UPDATE THE WORK ITEM TO ‘MISSED INTERVIEW’ STATUS. UPDATING THE WORK ITEM TO ‘MISSED INTERVIEW’ STATUS WILL GENERATE AN AUTOMATED NOTICE OF MISSED INTERVIEW AND MAIL THE NOTICE OF MISSED INTERVIEW TO THE APPLICANT. THIS NOMI INSTRUCTS THE APPLICANT OF THE DATE THAT THEY MUST CONTACT DCFS TO COMPLETE THEIR INTERVIEW TO AVOID DENIAL OF THEIR APPLICATION.

THE APPLICATION WILL REMAIN ON THE WORKER’S DASHBOARD AND IN ‘MISSED APPOINTMENT’ STATUS.

IF THE CLIENT DOES NOT CONTACT THE AGENCY TO CONDUCT THEIR APPLICATION INTERVIEW, NO FURTHER ACTION IS REQUIRED. LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY DENY THE APPLICATION AND GENERATE A NOTICE OF DENIAL ON THE 30TH DAY. THE APPLICATION WILL AUTOMATICALLY DROP OFF THE WORKER’S DASHBOARD.

C-622-FITAP - PO APPLICATION PROCESSING

APPLICANTS WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY SENT A LETTER SCHEDULING AN INTERVIEW WHICH ADVISES THE APPLICANT OF THE DATE AND TIME OF THEIR SCHEDULED INTERVIEW AND THAT AN AGENCY REPRESENTATIVE WILL CONTACT THEM TO CONDUCT THEIR INTERVIEW. APPLICATIONS MUST BE PROCESSED ACCORDING TO DEPARTMENTAL PROCEDURES.

All applicants must be notified of application processing time frames.

C-623-FITAP - PO ADDITIONAL APPLICATION FILED WHILE APPLICATION PENDING

IF AN ADDITIONAL APPLICATION (EITHER PAPER OR ONLINE) IS SUBMITTED WHILE AN APPLICATION IS PENDING, THE APPLICATION RECEIVED MUST BE PROCESSED ACCORDING TO DEPARTMENTAL PROCEDURES.

3 of 9 C-624-FITAP - PO ADDITIONAL APPLICATION RECEIVED AFTER ELIGIBILITY DETERMINED

IF THE HOUSEHOLD WAS DETERMINED ELIGIBLE AND AN ADDITIONAL APPLICATION (EITHER PAPER OR ONLINE) IS SUBMITTED, THE APPLICATION MUST BE INVALIDATED SINCE THE HOUSEHOLD IS ALREADY RECEIVING BENEFTS. THE APPLICATION MUST BE REVIEWED TO DETERMINE IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTED A CHANGE IN CIRCUMSTANCES. IF A CHANGE HAS BEEN REPORTED, REFER TO C-820 FITAP/SNAP.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD WAS DETERMINED INELIGIBLE AND AN ADDITIONAL APPPLICATION IS SUBMITTED, TREAT AS A NEW APPLICATION.

C-625-FITAP - PO RESERVED

C-626-FITAP - PO OBVIOUS DENIALS

AN APPLICATION MAY BE DENIED AT ANY POINT DURING THE ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION WHEN THE WORKER OBTAINS AND RECORDS ENOUGH INFORMATION TO ESTABLISH THAT THE APPLICANT IS INELIGIBLE.

LITE follows a set of rules to determine eligibility. The first eligibility factors to be evaluated are the non-financial requirements (i.e. Age, citizenship, immunizations, time limits, etc.). Next, LITE evaluates the financial requirements (i.e. Income, etc.). If the family group is denied due to one of the non-financial requirements, LITE stops determining eligibility and the financial requirements are not evaluated. The worker must obtain and enter enough data for LITE to set the correct eligibility decision and reason for ineligibility on the Notice of Decision.

For example: The worker may want to deny the application after verifying that the applicant’s income equals or exceeds the flat grant amount; however, the worker fails to evaluate and update the applicant’s time limit data. LITE may incorrectly deny the household for failing to meet the time limit requirements, instead of denying the household for failing to meet income requirements.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS THAT THEIR INCOME equals or EXCEEDS THE flat grant amount FOR THEIR HOUSEHOLD SIZE, THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED BASED SOLELY ON THE CLIENT’S STATEMENT. VERIFICATION OF THE HOUSEHOLD’S INCOME MUST BE REQUESTED IN WRITING AND RECEIVED BEFORE AN ELIGIBILITY DECISION CAN BE MADE ON THE CASE. A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION OF THE HOUSEHOLD’S INCOME MUST BE SENT ALLOWING THE HOUSEHOLD 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE THE REQUESTED VERIFICATION.

• IF THE VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED BY THE DUE DATE, THE APPLICATION MUST BE DENIED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION. A NOTICE OF DECISION MUST BE SENT ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD THAT THEIR APPLICATION WAS DENIED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION.

4 of 9 • IF THE VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED, THE INCOME MUST BE BUDGETED AND THE CASE PROCESSED. IF THE INCOME equals or EXCEEDS THE flat grant amount, THE APPLICATION IS DENIED FOR REASON CODE “Failed Flat Grant Eligibility Test”.

C-627-FITAP - PO WITHDRAWAL

AN APPLICANT MAY VOLUNTARILY WITHDRAW HIS APPLICATION AT ANY POINT PRIOR TO THE ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION BEING MADE.

II. PROCEDURES

C-621-FITAP - PR RECEIPT OF APPLICATION

APPLICATIONS (AND LATE REDETERMINATIONS) RECEIVED THROUGH THE CUSTOMER SELF SERVICE PORTAL (SSP) AND DOCUMENT PROCESSING CENTER (DPC) ARE ASSIGNED TO THE BOT AND REGISTERED, IF THE MPI MATCH RESULT IS 80% OR HIGHER. IF THE MPI MATCH RESULT IS LESS THAN 80%, THE APPLICATION (AND LATE REDETERMINATIONS) ARE ASSIGNED THROUGH ROUND ROBIN TO A USER WITH THE LITE REGISTRATION CHARACTERISTIC TO COMPLETE THE REGISTRATION. THE USER WILL NAVIGATE TO THEIR STAFF SUMMARY TO VIEW THE ASSIGNED PENDING REGISTRATION WORK ITEMS.

TAKE THE FOLLOWING STEPS TO REGISTER AN APPLICATION: • NAVIGATE TO THE USER’S STAFF SUMMARY TO LOCATE APPLICATION WORK ITEMS IN ‘NOT STARTED’ STATUS. • CLICK ON START WORK ITEM TO COMPLETE APPLICATION REGISTRATION. • ON THE LAST SCREEN OF APPLICATION REGISTRATION, CLICK SUBMIT. THIS PROCESS WILL UPDATE THE WORK ITEM TO CONDUCT INTERVIEW STATUS, ROUTE THE APPLICATION TO A WORKER’S DASHBOARD VIA SWRR, AND SEND AN APPOINTMENT LETTER SCHEDULING AN INTERVIEW.

ENSURE ALL MEMBERS ON THE APPLICATION WHO ARE REQUIRED TO BE INCLUDED ARE ENTERED IN LITE AND THE CASE IS REGISTERED. APPLICATIONS MUST BE REGISTERED NO LATER THAN THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY FROM THE DATE OF RECEIPT.

NOTE: IF THE APPLICATION IS REGISTERED ON A FRIDAY OR IT IS MORE THAN ONE WORKDAY OLD, THE STAFF MEMBER WHO REGISTERED THE APPLICATION MUST ACCESS THE PENDING NOTICE AND SELECT LOCAL PRINT AND MANUALLY MAIL THE INTERVIEW NOTICE TO THE HOUSEHOLD THE SAME DAY.

PAPER APPLICATIONS ARE REGISTERED AS RECEIVED BY A WORK ITEM OWNER WITH REGISTRATION CHARACTERISTICS.

5 of 9 A PAPER APPLICATION MUST CONTAIN A NAME, A COMPLETE ADDRESS, AND AN APPROPRIATE SIGNATURE TO BE CONSIDERED VALID. RECORD THE DATE RECEIVED ON THE PAPER APPLICATION FORM SUBMITTED TO THE AGENCY BY USING A DATE STAMP.

IF A PAPER APPLICATION CONTAINS:

• THE APPLICANT’S NAME ONLY, DO NOT REGISTER THE APPLICATION. IF THE APPLICATION IS REGISTERED, MARK AS INVALID.

• THE APPLICANT’S NAME AND SIGNATURE ONLY, DO NOT REGISTER THE APPLICATION. IF THE APPLICATION IS REGISTERED, MARK AS INVALID.

• THE APPLICANT’S NAME AND ADDRESS, AND NO SIGNATURE, SEND BACK THE ENTIRE APPLICATION WITH AN OFS 18C INDICATING THAT IT MUST BE SIGNED TO BE CONSIDERED VALID. IF THE APPLICATION IS REGISTERED, MARK AS INVALID.

• THE APPLICANT’S NAME AND PHONE NUMBER ONLY, CONTACT THE APPLICANT TO OBTAIN AN ADDRESS AND SEND BACK THE ENTIRE APPLICATION WITH A MANUAL OFS 18C INDICATING THAT IT MUST BE SIGNED TO BE CONSIDERED VALID.

IF THE APPLICANT REQUESTS TO HAVE AN INTERVIEW APPOINTMENT RESCHEDULED, THE APPOINTMENT LETTER (FORM OFS 18C-AL) IN LITE MUST BE USED TO CONFIRM THE NEW APPOINTMENT. SUFFICIENT MAIL TIME MUST BE ALLOWED WHEN SCHEDULING AN APPOINTMENT. IF THERE IS NOT SUFFICIENT MAIL TIME FOR A SYSTEM-GENERATED NOTICE TO BE SENT, MAIL A MANUAL APPOINTMENT LETTER THAT SAME DAY.

Although an OFS 18C-AL in LITE may be used to schedule an appointment and request information prior to the interview, the OFS 18C-AL in LITE must be sent to each FITAP/KCSP applicant notifying them of the application processing time frame.

IF THE APPLICANT MISSES THE SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT, ON THE DAY OF THE MISSED INTERVIEW APPOINTMENT, THE APPLICATION MUST BE MARKED AS A MISSED INTERVIEW. AN AUTOMATED NOTICE OF MISSED INTERVIEW (NOMI) WILL BE SENT TO THE APPLICANT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY TO NOTIFY THE APPLICANT THAT THEIR SCHEDULED INTERVIEW APPOINTMENT WAS MISSED AND IT IS THEIR RESPONSIBILITY TO CONTACT THE AGENCY TO COMPLETE THEIR INTERVIEW OR REQUEST TO SCHEDULE ANOTHER APPOINTMENT TO BE INTERVIEWED NO LATER THAN 30 DAYS FROM THE APPLICATION DATE OR THE APPLICATION WILL BE REJECTED. IF NO FURTHER ACTION IS TAKEN, LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY REJECT THE CASE AND GENERATE A NOTICE OF DENIAL ON THE 30TH DAY FOLLOWING THE APPLICATION DATE (OR THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY IF THE 30TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY).

6 of 9 IF THE APPLICANT IS INTERVIEWED OR REQUESTS A SECOND APPOINTMENT WITHIN THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PERIOD, THE APPLICATION’S STATUS MUST BE UPDATED. IF VERIFICATION IS NEEDED, ALLOW 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION. A NOTICE OF AUTOMATED PENDING APPLICATION MUST BE SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD ON THE 30TH DAY TO ADVISE THAT A DECISION HAS NOT BEEN MADE ON THE APPLICATION AND THE REASON FOR THE DELAY, IF THE APPLICATION CANNOT BE PROCESSED BY THE 30TH DAY.

IF THE APPLICANT REQUESTS A SECOND APPOINTMENT DURING THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PERIOD, INCLUDING A REQUEST THROUGH THE DCFS CALL CENTER ON THE 30TH DAY AFTER PARISH OFFICE CLOSURE, A SECOND INTERVIEW MUST BE SCHEDULED NO LATER THAN THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY USING AN OFS 18C-AL IN LITE AND BENEFITS MUST BE ISSUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH C-633-FITAP - PO.

C-622-FITAP - PR APPLICATION PROCESSING

THE FOLLOWING WILL BE COMPLETED BY THE INTAKE WORKER WHEN COMPLETING THE APPLICATION: • REMIND THE APPLICANT THAT THE CALL IS BEING RECORDED. • ASK THE APPLICANT IF THEY HEARD AND UNDERSTOOD THE PRE-RECORDED RIGHTS AND RESPONSIBILITIES (R&Rs). LOCATE A VALID APPLICATION WORK ITEM, CLICK START WORK ITEM. • NAVIGATE THROUGH DATA COLLECTION IN INTAKE MODE. DOCUMENT ALL ACTIVITIES IN LITE. ASK THE APPLICANT THE QUESTIONS AND COMPLETE THE RESPONSES. CLEAR ALL DISCREPANCIES IN DATA COLLECTION IN LITE. DOCUMENT ADDITIONAL INFORMATION AS A CASE NOTE IN LITE AS NEEDED. THE INTERVIEW MAY BE ENDED WHEN THE WORKER OBTAINS AND RECORDS ENOUGH INFORMATION TO ESTABLISH THAT THE APPLICANT IS INELIGIBLE. • CHECK CLEARANCE SUMMARY FOR ALL HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS. WHEN THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY INTERFACE STATUS CHANGES TO COMPLETE, CLEAR ALL HITS ACCORDING TO POLICY IN C-220-FITAP. • IF VERIFICATION IS NEEDED, COMPLETE THE APPROPRIATE PENDING VERIFICATION FIELDS IN LITE. RUN EDBC. LITE WILL SEND A NOTICE REQUESTING THE VERIFICATION. • IF VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED AFTER THE INTERVIEW, ENTER A CASE NOTE DOCUMENTING RECEIPT IN LITE. UPDATE THE PENDING VERIFICATION FIELDS IN DATA COLLECTION. • RUN EDBC TO DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY AND AUTHORIZE THE CASE. • LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY SEND A NOTICE OF DECISION TO THE HOUSEHOLD. • IF DETERMINED ELIGIBLE, A LOUISIANA PURCHASE CARD MUST BE ISSUED AND BENEFITS MUST BE ISSUED.

7 of 9 IF THE APPLICANT IS INTERVIEWED WITHIN THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PERIOD, BUT IS DETERMINED TO BE INELIGIBLE, THE APPROPRIATE DENIAL REASON MUST BE USED TO REFLECT THE ACTUAL REASON FOR THE REJECTION AND A NOTICE OF DECISION SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD NO LATER THAN 30 DAYS AFTER THE APPLICATION DATE.

IF THE APPLICANT REPORTS ON THE APPLICATION OR DURING THE APPLICATION INTERVIEW THAT A CHANGE WILL OCCUR DURING THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PERIOD, THIS CHANGE MUST BE ACTED UPON AS PART OF THE INITIAL CERTIFICATION.

• If the applicant is applying for more than one assistance unit, only one application form is required.

IF THE APPLICATION WAS SUBMITTED THROUGH THE CAFÉ SELF-SERVICE PORTAL AND WAS NOT COMPLETED BY A CSR, ASK THE APPLICANT DURING THE INTERVIEW IF THEY WOULD LIKE A COPY OF THE APPLICATION THAT WAS SUBMITTED AND IN WHAT FORMAT. DOCUMENT THE RESPONSE AS A CASE NOTE. IF THE APPLICATION WAS SUBMITTED BY PAPER AND A REQUEST FOR A COPY OF THE APPLICATION IS MADE, IT IS NOT NECESSARY TO DISCUSS THE RESPONSE WITH THE APPLICANT OR DOCUMENT THE RESPONSE AS A CASE NOTE.

PROVIDE A COPY OF THE APPLICATION IN THE FORMAT REQUESTED WITHIN TWO WORKDAYS.

• IF THE FORMAT REQUESTED IS A PAPER COPY AND THE APPLICATION WAS SUBMITTED: o BY PAPER, PRINT A PDF COPY FROM FILENET AND MAIL. o THROUGH CAFE SELF-SERVICE PORTAL, PRINT THE DOCUMENT SUBMITTED AND MAIL.

• IF THE FORMAT REQUESTED IS AN ELECTRONIC COPY AND THE APPLICATION WAS SUBMITTED: o BY PAPER, SAVE A COPY OF THE PDF FROM FILENET AND EMAIL IT. THE PDF MUST BE ENCRYPTED IF SENT BY EMAIL. o THROUGH CAFÉ CUSTOMER PORTAL, THE APPLICANT MAY BE ADVISED THEY CAN LOG INTO THEIR CAFÉ ACCOUNT AND VIEW AND PRINT A COPY OF THE APPLICATION. IF THE APPLICANT REQUESTS THAT A COPY OF THE ELECTRONIC APPLICATION BE SENT, SAVE A COPY AND EMAIL IT. THE PDF MUST BE ENCRYPTED IF SENT BY EMAIL.

INSTRUCTIONS TO ENCRYPT AN ATTACHMENT TO AN EMAIL ARE AS FOLLOWS:

• OPEN A NEW EMAIL AND ATTACH THE PDF COPY OF THE REQUESTED APPLICATION. • CLICK ON THE ‘ZIP ATTACHMENTS’ BUTTON AND SELECT ‘ENCRYPT’.

8 of 9 • TYPE THE APPLICANT’S EMAIL ADDRESS IN THE ‘TO’ FIELD, ENTER A SUBJECT AND MESSAGE IN THE BODY OF THE EMAIL (DO NOT INCLUDE THE PASSWORD IN THIS EMAIL). THE WORKER WILL NEED TO INFORM THE APPLICANT THAT THE PASSWORD WILL BE SENT IN A SEPARATE EMAIL. • SELECT ‘SEND,’ AND AN ‘ENCRYPT’ POP-UP BOX WILL BE DISPLAYED. • ENTER THE PASSWORD, RE-TYPE THE PASSWORD FOR CONFIRMATION, CHECK THE BOX TO ‘MASK PASSWORD,’ AND THEN CLICK ‘OK.’ THE EMAIL WILL BE SENT TO THE APPLICANT. • SEND A SEPARATE EMAIL WITH THE PASSWORD.

NOTE: THE CONTENTS OF AN EMAIL CANNOT BE ENCRYPTED. THEREFORE, ANY CASE SPECIFIC INFORMATION MUST BE CONTAINED IN THE ENCRYPTED DOCUMENT ONLY.

C-623-FITAP - PR ADDITIONAL APPLICATION FILED WHILE APPLICATION PENDING

IF AN ADDITIONAL APPLICATION (EITHER PAPER OR ONLINE) IS SUBMITTED WHILE AN APPLICATION IS PENDING, THE NEW APPLICATION MUST BE REVIEWED TO DETERMINE IF THERE ARE ANY CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES SINCE THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION WAS SUBMITTED. IF THERE ARE CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES, A REVIEW OF CURRENT HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES MUST BE COMPLETED WITH THE APPLICANT. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION THAT IS SUBMITTED WILL BE USED TO DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFIT LEVEL. RECEIPT OF THE ADDITIONAL APPLICATION MUST BE DOCUMENTED.

C-624-FITAP - PR ADDITIONAL APPLICATION RECEIVED AFTER ELIGIBILITY DETERMINED

IF THE HOUSEHOLD WAS DETERMINED ELIGIBLE AND AN ADDITIONAL APPLICATION (EITHER PAPER OR ONLINE) IS SUBMITTED, THE APPLICATION MUST BE INVALIDATED SINCE THE HOUSEHOLD IS ALREADY RECEIVING BENEFITS. THE APPLICATION MUST BE REVIEWED TO DETERMINE IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTED A CHANGE IN CIRCUMSTANCES. IF A CHANGE HAS BEEN REPORTED, REFER TO C-820 FITAP/SNAP.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD WAS DETERMINED INELIGIBLE AND AN ADDITIONAL APPLICATION IS SUBMITTED, TREAT AS A NEW APPLICATION.

C-625-FITAP - PR RESERVED

C-626-FITAP - PR OBVIOUS DENIALS

A CLIENT CONTACT IS REQUIRED TO ESTABLISH THE CORRECTNESS OF THE INFORMATION. SEND A NOTICE OF DENIAL.

1 of 14 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

C-631-FITAP - PO RESERVED

C-632-FITAP - PO APPLICATION PROCESSING TIME LIMITS

THE APPLICATION MUST BE PROCESSED AND A NOTICE OF DECISION MUST BE SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD NO LATER THAN 30 DAYS AFTER THE APPLICATION DATE. THE APPLICATION DATE IS THE DAY THE AGENCY RECEIVES THE SIGNED APPLICATION. DAY 1 IS THE DAY AFTER THE APPLICATION DATE.

IF CERTIFIED, A LOUISIANA PURCHASE AUTOMATED BENEFIT CARD MUST BE ISSUED AND THE APPLICANT MUST BE ABLE TO ACCESS BENEFITS BY THE 30TH DAY.

C-633-FITAP - PO DELAYS IN PROCESSING APPLICATION

WHEN AN APPLICATION IS NOT APPROVED OR DENIED BY THE 30TH CALENDAR DAY, THIS IS A DELAY IN PROCESSING. AN AUTOMATED NOTICE OF PENDING APPLICATION WILL BE SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD TO ADVISE THAT THE APPLICATION IS STILL PENDING AND THE REASON FOR THE DELAY.

C-633-1-FITAP - PO Original Application Date Must Be Used

THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE MUST BE USED WHEN THE APPLICATION IS DELAYED BEYOND 30 DAYS DUE TO THE FOLLOWING SITUATIONS. THIS INCLUDES BUT IS NOT LIMITED TO:

• AN INTERVIEW WAS NEVER SCHEDULED FOR THE HOUSEHOLD. • THE APPOINTMENT LETTER WAS MAILED TO THE INCORRECT ADDRESS. • THE APPOINTMENT LETTER OR REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION WAS RETURNED AND NO ACTION IS TAKEN ON THE RETURNED MAIL. • THE HOUSEHOLD WAS NOT CONTACTED FOR THE SCHEDULED INTERVIEW OR NOT CONTACTED USING THE PHONE NUMBER PROVIDED ON THE APPLICATION. • THE APPLICANT REQUESTED A SECOND APPOINTMENT DURING THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PERIOD. • THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACTED THE CALL CENTER BY THE 30TH DAY AND THE HOUSEHOLD WAS UNABLE TO BE REACHED BY THE 30TH DAY. • THE HOUSEHOLD MISSED THEIR SCHEDULED INTERVIEW AND CONTACTED THE CALL CENTER BUT A SECOND APPOINTMENT LETTER WAS NOT SENT TO RESCHEDULE THE INTERVIEW OR THE CLIENT WAS NOT OFFERED THE OPPORTUNITY TO CONDUCT THEIR INTERVIEW ON THE INTERVIEW LINE THAT DAY. • THE APPLICATION WAS DENIED IN ERROR. • THE HOUSEHOLD WAS NOT OFFERED ASSISTANCE IN OBTAINING THE VERIFICATION.

NOTE: THE REASON THE INTERVIEW WAS DELAYED IS IRRELEVANT. IF THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED AFTER THE 30TH DAY BUT BY THE DUE DATE, USE THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE.

EXAMPLES FOR DETERMINING IF THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE IS USED OR NOT:

THE HOUSEHOLD IS INTERVIEWED OR CONTACTS THE AGENCY BY THE 30TH DAY TO BE INTERVIEWED BUT DOES NOT PROVIDE THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION BY THE 30TH DAY.

• ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE – SEPTEMBER 1 • 30 DAY PERIOD – SEPTEMBER 1- SEPTEMBER 30 • INTERVIEW CONDUCTED SEPTEMBER 24 • VERIFICATION DUE – OCTOBER 4 • THE 60TH DAY IS OCTOBER 30

VARIATION 1 – ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE MUST BE USED

• VERIFICATION PROVIDED – OCTOBER 3 • ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE MUST BE USED SINCE THE VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED BY THE DUE DATE OF OCTOBER 4.

VARIATION 2 – ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE IS NOT USED

• NO VERIFICATION PROVIDED BY THE DUE DATE OF OCTOBER 4, WHICH IS AFTER THE 30TH DAY. • APPLICATION WAS REQUIRED TO BE DENIED ON OCTOBER 5 AND A NOTICE OF DECISION SENT. • VERIFICATION PROVIDED – OCTOBER 10 WHICH IS AFTER THE 30TH DAY AND THE VERIFICATION DUE DATE. • A NEW APPLICATION DATE IS REQUIRED – OCTOBER 10 • MUST PROCESS WITHIN 30 DAYS FROM THE NEW APPLICATION DATE – THE 30TH DAY IS NOVEMBER 9.

VARIATION 3 – APPLICATION MAY NOT BE REUSED

• APPLICATION WAS REQUIRED TO BE DENIED ON OCTOBER 5 AND A NOTICE OF DECISION SENT. • VERIFICATION PROVIDED NOVEMBER 1 • HOUSEHOLD MUST REAPPLY SINCE THE VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED AFTER THE 60TH DAY.

C-633-2-FITAP - PO Original Application Date Is Not Used

IN THE SITUATIONS DESCRIBED BELOW, THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE IS NOT USED IF THE APPLICATION IS DELAYED BEYOND 30 DAYS FROM THE APPLICATION DATE:

• THE HOUSEHOLD PROVIDES THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION AFTER THE 30TH DAY AND AFTER THE DUE DATE BUT BY THE 60TH DAY. THE NEW APPLICATION DATE IS THE DATE THE VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED. • THE HOUSEHOLD MISSED THEIR SCHEDULED INTERVIEW AND REQUESTS ANOTHER APPOINTMENT AFTER THE 30TH DAY BUT BY THE 60TH DAY. THE NEW APPLICATION DATE IS THE DATE THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACTS THE AGENCY TO REQUEST ANOTHER INTERVIEW.

REFER TO C-638-FITAP-PO REGARDING REUSE OF APPLICATION.

THE APPLICATION MUST BE PROCESSED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE NEW APPLICATION DATE. THE HOUSEHOLD IS NOT ALLOWED A NEW 60-DAY APPLICATION PROCESSING PERIOD FROM THE NEW APPLICATION DATE.

IF THE APPLICATION IS REUSED AND THE HOUSEHOLD FAILS TO PROVIDE THE VERIFICATION BY THE VERIFICATION DUE DATE, THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED UNTIL THE 30TH DAY FOLLOWING THE NEW APPLICATION DATE. IF THE VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED BY THE 30TH DAY FOLLOWING THE NEW APPLICATION DATE, THE HOUSEHOLD MUST BE NOTIFIED THAT THE HOUSEHOLD MUST REAPPLY SINCE THE VERIFICATION WAS NOT PROVIDED. LITE WILL SEND A NOTICE OF DECISION. FOLLOW PROCEDURES AT C-633-2-FITAP-PR.

EXAMPLES:

THE HOUSEHOLD MISSED THE SCHEDULED INTERVIEW AND REQUESTS AN INTERVIEW AFTER THE 30TH DAY BUT BY THE 60TH DAY.

C-634-FITAP - PO MISSED APPOINTMENT

THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE REJECTED PRIOR TO THE 30TH DAY. IF THE 30TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, TREAT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY AS THE 30TH DAY. AN AUTOMATED NOTICE OF MISSED INTERVIEW (NOMI) WILL BE GENERATED IN LITE AND MAILED TO APPLICANTS WHO MISSED THEIR SCHEDULED INTERVIEW. THE APPLICATION WILL REMAIN ON THE WORKER’S DASHBOARD IN ‘MISSED APPOINTMENT’ STATUS. IF THE CLIENT DOES NOT CONTACT THE AGENCY TO CONDUCT THEIR APPLICATION INTERVIEW OR TO REQUEST A RESCHEDULED APPOINTMENT, NO FURTHER ACTION IS REQUIRED BY THE STAFF. LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY DENY THE APPLICATION * AND GENERATE A NOTICE OF DENIAL ** ON THE 30TH DAY FOLLOWING THE APPLICATION DATE (OR THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY IF THE 30TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY). 5 of 14 IF THE APPLICANT REQUESTS A SECOND APPOINTMENT DURING THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PERIOD, INCLUDING A REQUEST THROUGH THE CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER ON THE 30TH DAY AFTER PARISH OFFICE CLOSURE, A SECOND INTERVIEW MUST BE SCHEDULED IMMEDIATELY USING AN OFS 18C-AL IN LITE AND BENEFITS MUST BE ISSUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH C-633-FITAP-PO.

C-635-FITAP - PO PENDING INFORMATION

IF THE APPLICANT CANNOT FURNISH ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION DURING THE INTERVIEW, A LIST OF ITEMS OR ACTIONS NEEDED TO COMPLETE THE APPLICATION PROCESS MUST BE GIVEN OR MAILED TO THE APPLICANT. IF REQUESTED, ASSISTANCE MUST BE PROVIDED TO HELP THE APPLICANT OBTAIN THE NEEDED INFORMATION. THE APPLICANT MUST BE ALLOWED AT LEAST 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE INFORMATION NEEDED TO COMPLETE THE APPLICATION. IF THE 10TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, THE DUE DATE BECOMES THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY.

WHEN THERE ARE LESS THAN 10 DAYS LEFT IN THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PROCESSING PERIOD, THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED ON THE 30TH DAY FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION BUT MUST REMAIN IN PENDING STATUS. THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION PRIOR TO THE DUE DATE.

IF DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE IS DIFFICULT OR IMPOSSIBLE TO OBTAIN IN A TIMELY FASHION, THE WORKER MUST ASSIST THE HOUSEHOLD IN OBTAINING THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION.

IF THE APPLICANT DOES NOT PROVIDE THE INFORMATION BY THE DATE NOTED ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION AND DOES NOT REQUEST ADDITIONAL TIME IN WHICH TO FURNISH THE INFORMATION, THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED PRIOR TO THE 30TH DAY. LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY DENY THE APPLICATION ON THE 30TH DAY FOLLOWING THE APPLICATION DATE (OR THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY IF THE 30TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY).

NOTE: IF THE HOUSEHOLD IS NOT ELIGIBLE DUE TO AN ELIGIBILITY FACTOR WHICH CAN BE DETERMINED WITHOUT THE VERIFICATION, THE APPLICATION MUST BE REJECTED FOR THE ELIGIBILITY FACTOR NOT MET. THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE REJECTED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION IN THESE INSTANCES. For example, failure to meet citizenship-alien status or relationship.

If the household fails to provide verification of relationship, the worker must determine if the household meets the three conditions in B-840-FITAP (Temporary Certification Pending Verification of Relationship) prior to denying the application for failure to provide relationship verification.

HELP THE APPLICANT OBTAIN THE INFORMATION IF REQUESTED.

• PROVIDE A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION FORM TO EVERY APPLICANT TO REQUEST NEEDED VERIFICATION AND TO ADVISE OF THE PROCESSING TIME FRAMES. IF THE APPLICANT PROVIDES PARTIAL VERIFICATION, A SECOND REQUEST IS NOT NECESSARY.

10 of 14 • IF IT IS DISCOVERED AFTER THE INTERVIEW THAT ADDITIONAL VERIFICATION IS NEEDED OR INFORMATION NEEDS TO BE CLARIFIED, USE A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION FORM OFS 18C TO REQUEST THE ADDITIONAL VERIFICATION.

EXAMPLE: THE APPLICATION DATE IS JUNE 1. AN OFS 18C AND OFS 87 ARE SENT TO THE APPLICANT ON JUNE 3. ON JUNE 10, ALL VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED, HOWEVER, WAS NOT ACCEPTABLE. THE OFS 87 WAS COMPLETED BY THE APPLICANT AND NOT THE EMPLOYER. AN OFS 18C MUST BE SENT REQUESTING ADDITIONAL VERIFICATION.

IF THE APPLICANT DOES NOT PROVIDE THE INFORMATION BY THE DATE NOTED ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION, OFS 18C, AND DOES NOT REQUEST ADDITIONAL TIME IN WHICH TO FURNISH THE INFORMATION, THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED PRIOR TO THE 30TH DAY. LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY DENY THE APPLICATION ON THE 30TH DAY FOLLOWING THE APPLICATION DATE (OR THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY IF THE 30TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY).

SEND A NOTICE OF DECISION IN LITE ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD OF THE 30TH AND 60TH DAY FROM THE APPLICATION DATE.

IF THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED TAKE THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS:

• CLICK ON THE ‘START WORK ITEM’ ICON OF THE APPLICATION WITH PENDING VERIFICATION, • SELECT ‘CONTINUE PREVIOUSLY SELECTED ACTION FOR’ FROM THE DROPDOWN, “WHAT ACTION DO YOU WANT TO PERFORM?” AND CLICK THE ‘NEXT’ BUTTON. THE SYSTEM WILL NAVIGATE YOU TO THE FINALIZE ELIGIBILITY SCREEN, • CLICK ON THE BLUE ARROWS ON THE LEFT NAVIGATION AND SELECT ‘ELIGIBILITY SUMMARY’, • CLICK ON THE EYEGLASSES ICON, • CLICK ON THE HYPERLINK FOR THE MISSING VERIFICATION, • UPDATE THE VERIFICATION CODE FROM ‘PENDING’ TO THE INFORMATION RECEIVED FROM THE CLIENT, • REPEAT THIS FOR ALL VERIFICATIONS NEEDED, • CLICK ON ‘OTHERS’, ‘WRAP UP’, ‘RUN ELIGIBILITY’ AND CLICK THE ‘RUN EDBC’ BUTTON, • CHECK THE CASE FOR ACCURACY BY CLICKING ON THE HYPERLINK MONTH, • CLICK THE ‘NEXT’ BUTTON, AND • AUTHORIZE THE CASE.

IF THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS NOT RECEIVED AND THE ‘PENDING VERIFICATION’ HAS NOT BEEN UPDATED, LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY CLOSE THE CASE ON THE NIGHT OF THE 30TH DAY FROM THE APPLICATION RECEIVED DATE.

• IN THE SITUATIONS DESCRIBED BELOW, THE APPLICATION WILL BE REUSED WITHOUT THE REQUIREMENT OF AN ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW OR REVIEW OF HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES. EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT FAILED TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION NEEDED TO COMPLETE A JUNE REDETERMINATION AND THE CASE WAS CLOSED ON THE LAST DAY OF JUNE. A REVIEW OF HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES WOULD BE REQUIRED ONLY IF THE HOUSEHOLD INDICATES THAT THERE HAS BEEN A CHANGE SINCE THE REDETERMINATION INTERVIEW.

1 of 16 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

C-631-SNAP - PO EXPEDITED SERVICES

An expedited application must be processed and a Notice of Decision must be sent to the household no later than the seventh calendar day following the application date.

Benefits are available the same day the case is certified when certified on the seventh calendar day.

LITE determines if the verification requested is required or may be postponed, based on the information entered into LITE.

• LITE will send a Request for Verification notice to the household when verification is postponed. • If no verification is postponed, the case can be authorized. Upon authorization, a Notice of Decision will be automatically sent to the household.

C-632-SNAP - PO APPLICATION PROCESSING TIME LIMITS

THE APPLICATION MUST BE PROCESSED AND A NOTICE OF DECISION MUST BE SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD NO LATER THAN 30 DAYS AFTER THE APPLICATION DATE. THE APPLICATION DATE IS THE DAY THE AGENCY RECEIVES THE SIGNED APPLICATION. DAY 1 IS THE DAY AFTER THE APPLICATION DATE.

For residents of institutions who apply for benefits prior to their release, the application date is the date of their release from the institution.

IF CERTIFIED, A LOUISIANA PURCHASE AUTOMATED BENEFIT CARD MUST BE ISSUED AND THE APPLICANT MUST BE ABLE TO ACCESS BENEFITS BY THE 30TH DAY.

C-633-SNAP - PO DELAYS IN PROCESSING APPLICATION

WHEN AN APPLICATION IS NOT APPROVED OR DENIED BY THE 30TH CALENDAR DAY, THIS IS A DELAY IN PROCESSING. AN AUTOMATED NOTICE OF PENDING APPLICATION WILL BE SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD TO ADVISE THAT THE APPLICATION IS STILL PENDING AND THE REASON FOR THE DELAY.

C-633-1-SNAP - PO Original Application Date Must Be Used

THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE MUST BE USED WHEN THE APPLICATION IS DELAYED BEYOND 30 DAYS DUE TO THE FOLLOWING SITUATIONS. THIS INCLUDES BUT IS NOT LIMITED TO:

• AN INTERVIEW WAS NEVER SCHEDULED FOR THE HOUSEHOLD.

C-636-SNAP - PO WORK REGISTRATION

A mandatory work registrant must register for work before the SNAP case is certified. Failure to register for work with LWC at application, will result in the rejection of the SNAP case or exclusion of the household member who failed to register for work. The mandatory work registrant must be allowed until 3:00 pm on the 30th day to register for work with LWC. If the 30th day falls on a weekend or holiday, treat the following workday as the 30th day.

An application may not be reused if the application was rejected for failure to have an active work registration in HiRE.

C-637-SNAP - PO RESERVED

C-638-SNAP - PO REUSE OF APPLICATION AFTER DENIAL AT APPLICATION OR CLOSURE AT REDETERMINATION

IN CERTAIN SITUATIONS, APPLICATIONS WILL BE REUSED WITHOUT THE REQUIREMENT OF AN ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW OR REVIEW OF HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES. HOWEVER, IF THE HOUSEHOLD INDICATES THAT THERE HAS BEEN A CHANGE IN CIRCUMSTANCES SINCE THE LAST INTERVIEW, A REVIEW OF CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES WILL BE NECESSARY.

II. PROCEDURES

C-631-SNAP - PR EXPEDITED SERVICES

Process the expedited application and send a Notice of Decision to the household no later than the seventh calendar day following the application date.

The following procedures must be followed to authorize an expedited application with postponed verification, while in Data Collection:

• Click on the “Run EDBC” button. The system will navigate you to the Eligibility Summary Screen in LITE.

o For expedited households with an application date before the 15th of the month, the month of the application will display with an Eligibility Status of “Eligible” and the month after the application month will display with an Eligibility Status of “Pending”. The eyeglasses icon will be displayed in the column for Pending Reasons-Verifications.

7 of 16 o For expedited households with an application date after the 15th of the month, the “Eligible” months will be the month of the application and the following month and the third month will display with an Eligibility Status of “Pending”.

• Click the “Next” button to navigate to the Finalize Eligibility Screen, • Select the checkbox for the months that are eligible, in the Authorize column, and • Click the “Authorize” button.

The expedited months the household is eligible for will authorize. The Notice of Decision letter will be sent informing the household that the case is approved but with postponed verification. The Notice of Decision will display the verifications requested from the client and the due date the verifications are due.

The system will create a task on the owner’s dashboard titled, ‘SNAPX Postponed Verification’. The due date for the task is 30 days from the application received date.

When the postponed verification is received, navigate to the SNAPX Postponed verification task that was created when the case was authorized and take the following actions:

• Click on the ‘Start Work Item’ and you will be navigated to the “Initiate Data Screen”. • Select “Continue previously selected action for” from the dropdown, “What action do you want to perform?” • Click the ‘Next’ button. You will be navigated to the “Finalize Eligibility Screen”. • Click on the blue arrows in the left navigation and select ‘Eligibility Summary’. • Click on the Eyeglasses icon. • Click on the hyperlink for the ‘Missing Verification’. • Update the verification code from ‘Pending’ to the type of verification received from the client • Repeat the above for all verifications received. • Click on ‘Others-Wrap Up-Run Eligibility’. • Review the case for accuracy by clicking on the hyperlink month. • Click the ‘Next’ button and ‘Authorize’ the case.

Refer to C-660-SNAP for further information on Expedited Services.

C-632-SNAP - PR APPLICATION PROCESSING TIME LIMITS

PROCESS THE APPLICATION AND SEND A NOTICE OF DECISION TO THE HOUSEHOLD NO LATER THAN 30 DAYS AFTER THE APPLICATION DATE.

LITE WILL AUTHORIZE INITIAL BENEFITS ON THE FIRST DAY FOLLOWING AUTHORIZATION OF THE APPROVED APPLICATION.

C-633-SNAP - PR DELAYS IN PROCESSING APPLICATION

WHEN AN APPLICATION IS NOT APPROVED OR DENIED BY THE 30TH CALENDAR DAY, AN AUTOMATED NOTICE OF PENDING APPLICATION, OFS 16P WILL BE SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD TO ADVISE THAT THE APPLICATION IS STILL PENDING AND THE REASON FOR THE DELAY.

C-633-1-SNAP - PR Original Application Date Must Be Used

THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE MUST BE USED WHEN AN APPLICATION IS DELAYED BEYOND 30 DAYS AS DESCRIBED IN THE SITUATIONS LISTED IN C-633-1-SNAP - PO.

IF THE CASE IS CERTIFIED, BENEFITS MUST BE ISSUED FROM THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE AND AN APPROVAL NOTICE SENT.

FOR CASES DENIED IN ERROR, STAFF MUST:

• CLICK ON DATA COLLECTION TAB IN THE TOP NAVIGATION PANEL, • CLICK ON THE INITITATE DATA TAB AND

o ENTER THE CASE ID (CID), o SELECT ‘REVERT TO OPEN’ FOR “WHAT ACTION DO YOU WANT TO PERFORM?”, AND o NAVIGATE TO THE PROGRAM REQUEST SUMMARY SCREEN.

• CLICK ON THE PENCIL ICON, • SELECT ‘REVERT TO OPEN’ FOR THE TYPE OF ACTION, • SELECT ‘DENIED IN ERROR’ FOR THE ‘REINSTATE/REVERT TO OPEN REASON, • ENTER THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE AS SHOWN FOR THE REINSTATE/REVERT TO OPEN DATE AND CLICK ‘NEXT’, • NAVIGATE THROUGH DATA COLLECTION AND UPDATE ALL INFORMATION IN THE CASE, • RUN ELIGIBILITY, AND • AUTHORIZE THE CASE.

LITE CREATES A TASK WHEN A CASE IS DENIED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION. THE WORK ITEM TYPE TASK IS ‘CASE DENIED’ AND THE WORK ITEM NAME IS ‘DENIED APPLICATION’.

REFER TO C-638-SNAP - PR REGARDING REUSE OF APPLICATION.

IF THE APPLICATION IS REUSED AND THE CASE IS CERTIFIED, FOLLOW PROCEDURES IN C- 638-SNAP - PR REGARDING REUSE OF APPLICATION.

APPLICATION DENIED – VERIFICATION NOT PROVIDED

IF THE APPLICATION IS REUSED AND VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE NEW APPLICATION DATE, THE APPLICATION MUST BE DENIED ON THE 30TH DAY AND A NOTICE OF DECISION MUST BE SENT IN LITE.

APPLICATION DENIED - NO INTERVIEW HELD

IF THE APPLICATION IS REUSED AND THE APPLICANT MISSES THE RESCHEDULED INTERVIEW WITHIN THE NEW 30-DAY APPLICATION PERIOD, the application must be denied the following workday and a Notice of Decision must be sent.

Note: A Notice of Missed Interview (SNAP 13M) must not be sent in this instance since the SNAP 13M would automatically populate the original 30th day from the application date.

IF THE APPLICANT IS INTERVIEWED WITHIN 60 DAYS OF THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE, THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION MAY BE REUSED.

APPLICATION DENIED – OTHER REASON

IF THE APPLICATION IS REUSED AND THE CASE IS DENIED FOR ANY OTHER REASON, SEND THE APPROPRIATE DENIAL NOTICE.

C-634-SNAP - PR MISSED APPOINTMENT

IF THE APPLICANT REQUESTED A SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT, THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE REJECTED PRIOR TO THE 30TH DAY. IF THE 30TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, TREAT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY AS THE 30TH DAY. IF THE APPLICANT REQUESTS A SECOND APPOINTMENT DURING THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PERIOD, INCLUDING A REQUEST THROUGH THE CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER ON THE 30TH DAY AFTER PARISH OFFICE CLOSURE, A SECOND INTERVIEW MUST BE SCHEDULED IMMEDIATELY USING AN OFS 18C-AL IN LITE AND BENEFITS MUST BE ISSUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH C-633-SNAP - PO.

IF THE APPLICANT MISSED THE SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT, FOLLOW THESE STEPS:

• CLICK ON ‘OTHERS’ IN THE TOP NAVIGATION BAR, • CLICK ON ‘SCHEDULING’,

WHEN THERE ARE LESS THAN 10 DAYS LEFT IN THE 30-DAY APPLICATION PROCESSING PERIOD, THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED ON THE 30TH DAY FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION BUT MUST REMAIN IN PENDING STATUS. THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION PRIOR TO THE DUE DATE.

HELP THE APPLICANT OBTAIN THE INFORMATION IF REQUESTED.

IF DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE IS DIFFICULT OR IMPOSSIBLE TO OBTAIN IN A TIMELY FASHION, THE WORKER MUST ASSIST THE HOUSEHOLD IN OBTAINING THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION.

• PROVIDE A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION FORM TO EVERY APPLICANT TO REQUEST NEEDED VERIFICATION AND TO ADVISE OF THE PROCESSING TIME FRAMES. IF THE APPLICANT PROVIDES PARTIAL VERIFICATION, A SECOND REQUEST IS NOT NECESSARY.

Note: If a SNAP case is expedited and verification is postponed, send a Notice of Decision to the client listing the postponed verification. It is not necessary to send an OFS 18C .

• IF IT IS DISCOVERED AFTER THE INTERVIEW THAT ADDITIONAL VERIFICATION IS NEEDED OR INFORMATION NEEDS TO BE CLARIFIED, USE A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION FORM, OFS 18C, TO REQUEST THE ADDITIONAL VERIFICATION.

EXAMPLE: THE APPLICATION DATE IS JUNE 1. AN OFS 18C AND OFS 87 ARE SENT TO THE APPLICANT ON JUNE 3. ON JUNE 10, ALL VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED, HOWEVER, WAS NOT ACCEPTABLE. THE OFS 87 WAS COMPLETED BY THE APPLICANT AND NOT THE EMPLOYER. AN OFS 18C MUST BE SENT REQUESTING ADDITIONAL VERIFICATION.

IF THE APPLICANT DOES NOT PROVIDE THE INFORMATION BY THE DATE NOTED ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION, OFS 18C, AND DOES NOT REQUEST ADDITIONAL TIME IN WHICH TO FURNISH THE INFORMATION, THE APPLICATION MUST NOT BE DENIED PRIOR TO THE 30TH DAY. LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY DENY THE APPLICATION ON THE 30TH DAY FOLLOWING THE APPLICATION DATE (OR THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY IF THE 30TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY).

Send a Notice of Decision in LITE advising the household of the 30th and 60th day from the application date.

Exception: Expedited Services. Refer to C-660-SNAP.

C-636-SNAP - PR WORK REGISTRATION

LITE automatically determines who is an MWR and if the MWR failed to register for work with LWC. LITE determines this through an interface with LWC when the Clearance Summary is run. Staff must not access HIRE directly.

If the MWR did not register for work by 3:00 pm on the 30th day, the MWR will be excluded from the SNAP case. Follow procedures listed in B-1434-SNAP - PR. If the 30th day falls on a weekend or holiday, treat the following workday as the 30th day.

IF THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION IS REUSED, REVERT TO OPEN MUST BE USED FOR THE APPLICATION TO BE PROCESSED IN LITE.

TAKE THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS TO REVERT TO OPEN THE APPLICATION IN LITE:

• CLICK ON DATA COLLECTIONS IN THE TOP NAVIGATION, • CLICK THE INITIATE DATA TAB, • ENTER CASE ID (CID), • SELECT ‘REVERT TO OPEN’ FROM THE DROPDOWN FOR “WHAT ACTION DO YOU WANT

THE APPLICATION MUST BE PROCESSED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE NEW APPLICATION DATE. THE HOUSEHOLD IS NOT ALLOWED A NEW 60-DAY APPLICATION PROCESSING PERIOD FROM THE NEW APPLICATION DATE.

• IN THE SITUATIONS DESCRIBED BELOW, THE APPLICATION WILL BE REUSED WITHOUT THE REQUIREMENT OF AN ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW OR REVIEW OF HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES. HOWEVER, IF THE HOUSEHOLD INDICATES THAT THERE HAS BEEN A CHANGE IN CIRCUMSTANCES SINCE THE LAST INTERVIEW, A REVIEW OF CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES WILL BE NECESSARY.

REUSE THE APPLICATION IF:

o THE CASE WAS CLOSED AT REDETERMINATION FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION, AND THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. THE CASE MUST BE REOPENED AND IF ELIGIBLE, BENEFITS WILL NOT BE PRORATED. THE APPLICATION DATE WILL NOT CHANGE. THE CASE MUST BE PROCESSED WITHIN 5 WORKDAYS OF RECEIPT OF THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT FAILED TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION NEEDED TO COMPLETE A JUNE REDETERMINATION AND THE CASE WAS CLOSED ON THE LAST DAY OF JUNE. THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED WITH A DOCUMENT DATE OF JULY 2 (THE DUE DATE). THE CASE MUST BE REOPENED AND CERTIFIED EFFECTIVE JULY BECAUSE THE VERIFICATION WAS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE OF THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. A REVIEW OF HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES WOULD BE REQUIRED ONLY IF THE HOUSEHOLD INDICATES THAT THERE HAS BEEN A CHANGE SINCE THE REDETERMINATION INTERVIEW.

NOTE: IF PARTIAL VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED, A SECOND REQUEST IS NOT NECESSARY.

• IN THE SITUATIONS DESCRIBED BELOW, THE WORKER MUST CONTACT THE HOUSEHOLD TO REVIEW CURRENT HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES. AN INTERVIEW WOULD BE CONDUCTED IF NECESSARY.

REUSE THE APPLICATION IF:

o THE APPLICATION WAS DENIED IN ERROR. USE THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE.

IF THE 60TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, TREAT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY AS THE 60TH DAY. THE NEW APPLICATION DATE IS THE DATE THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED. REQUEST CURRENT VERIFICATION OF EARNED INCOME AND ANY OTHER CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES WHICH AFFECT ELIGIBILITY.

EXAMPLE: AN APPLICATION DATED JUNE 1 IS REJECTED ON JULY 1 FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE REQUESTED VERIFICATION. THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED WITH A DOCUMENT DATE OF JULY 14. THE APPLICATION DATE WOULD BE JULY 14 BECAUSE THE INFORMATION WAS RECEIVED WITHIN 60 DAYS OF THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION DATE.

IF PARTIAL VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED, SEND A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION/OFS 18C TO ADVISE THE CLIENT THAT THE CASE CANNOT BE REOPENED BECAUSE ALL OF THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION HAS NOT BEEN RECEIVED AND THE DATE BY WHICH THE MISSING VERIFICATION MUST BE PROVIDED FOR THE CASE TO BE REOPENED WITHOUT SUBMITTING A NEW APPLICATION FORM.

o THE CASE WAS CLOSED AT REDETERMINATION FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION AND THE CLIENT PROVIDES THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. IF THE 30TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, TREAT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY AS THE 30TH DAY. THE NEW APPLICATION DATE IS THE DATE THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED. IF THE CLIENT PROVIDES THE VERIFICATION WHICH WAS ORIGINALLY REQUESTED, DO NOT REQUEST ADDITIONAL VERIFICATION UNLESS THE CLIENT'S CIRCUMSTANCES HAVE CHANGED. IF THE MISSING INFORMATION WAS VERIFICATION OF FLUCTUATING EARNED INCOME, ACCEPT THE INFORMATION WHICH WAS ORIGINALLY REQUESTED UNLESS THE CLIENT PROVIDES MORE RECENT INFORMATION.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT FAILED TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION NEEDED TO COMPLETE A JUNE REDETERMINATION AND THE CASE WAS CLOSED ON THE LAST DAY OF JUNE. THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED WITH A DOCUMENT DATE OF JULY 20. THE CASE MUST BE REOPENED WITH AN APPLICATION DATE OF JULY 20 BECAUSE THE VERIFICATION WAS RECEIVED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

o THE CASE WAS CLOSED AT REDETERMINATION BECAUSE THE HOUSEHOLD FAILED TO KEEP SCHEDULED APPOINTMENTS AFTER TIMELY REAPPLYING AND THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACTS THE AGENCY AND IS INTERVIEWED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

1 of 4 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

C-651-FITAP - * PO DATE ELIGIBILITY BEGINS

DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY FOR THE MONTH OF APPLICATION AND SUBSEQUENT MONTHS.

C-652-FITAP - PO PRORATION

BENEFITS FOR THE INITIAL MONTH OF CERTIFICATION ARE PRORATED FROM THE DATE OF APPLICATION.

THE INITIAL MONTH IS THE FIRST MONTH A HOUSEHOLD IS ELIGIBLE FOLLOWING ANY PERIOD DURING WHICH THE HOUSEHOLD WAS NOT CERTIFIED.

DO NOT AUTHORIZE PRORATED BENEFITS OF LESS THAN $10. ELIGIBILITY BEGINS THE INITIAL MONTH EVEN IF BENEFITS FOR THE INITIAL MONTH PRORATE TO LESS THAN $10.

C-652-1-FITAP - PO Calculating the Prorated Amount

In the month of application, benefits are prorated from the date of application. The assistance unit’s initial month, grant amount is the prorated budgetary deficit rounded down to the nearest dollar. (LITE will drop off any cents.)**

Refer to *** policy C-920-FITAP.

C-653-FITAP - * PO RESERVED

C-654-FITAP - PO LENGTH OF CERTIFICATION

AT THE EXPIRATION OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, ENTITLEMENT TO BENEFITS ENDS AND THE CLIENT MUST REAPPLY AND BE DETERMINED ELIGIBLE IN ORDER TO CONTINUE RECEIVING BENEFITS. THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD BEGINS WITH THE EFFECTIVE MONTH OF THE CERTIFICATION.

Process a complete redetermination every twelve months.

LITE will determine the date that the first redetermination is due by counting twelve months beginning with the effective month of certification, unless a shorter certification period is required.

EXCEPTIONS:

● Pregnant Woman Case (No Other Children) ** - The redetermination date must be no later than the month following the expected date of delivery. *** *A redetermination is not required when adding the newborn. **

● * 24 Month Certifications - Certain cases may be certified for a period not to exceed 24 months. The following conditions must be met in order to assign a 24-month period of eligibility:

o the payee is not a parent, and

o there is no qualified relative in the income and/or assistance unit.

● The redetermination date may be less than the maximum allowable for the case in order for the FITAP redetermination to occur in the same month that the next SNAP redetermination is due.

FITAP and SNAP certification periods should coincide/align when possible. Certification periods are established by LITE.

FITAP certification periods will be aligned to SNAP’s certification period and KCSP’s certification period to FITAP.

C-651-SNAP - PO DATE ELIGIBILITY BEGINS

C-652-SNAP - PO PRORATION

BENEFITS FOR THE INITIAL MONTH OF CERTIFICATION ARE PRORATED FROM THE DATE OF APPLICATION. THE INITIAL MONTH IS THE FIRST MONTH A HOUSEHOLD IS ELIGIBLE FOLLOWING ANY PERIOD DURING WHICH THE HOUSEHOLD WAS NOT CERTIFIED.

EXCEPTION: Do not prorate benefits if a household member is a migrant or seasonal farm worker who has received SNAP benefits within the last 30 days.

Do not authorize prorated benefits of less than $10. Eligibility begins the initial month even if benefits for the initial month prorate to less than $10.

C-652-1-SNAP - PO Calculating the Prorated Amount

To calculate the prorated benefit amount for the initial month of the certification period, the following formula should be used:

EXAMPLE 1: The full month benefit amount is $280, the month has 31 days, and the application date is the 5th of the month.

CALCULATION: 31 (days in month) + (plus) 1 = 32 - (minus) 5 (application date) = 27/ (divided by) 31 (days in month) = 0.87 multiplied by $280 (full month of benefits) = $243.87 (prorated amount if application date was the 5th of the month) $243. Prorated benefit amounts are rounded down to the nearest dollar.

EXAMPLE 2: The full month benefit amount is $280, the month has 30 days, and the application date is the 5th of the month.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-600-FITAP-SNAP Application Processing Document No./Name C-660-SNAP Expedited Service Effective Date July 1, 2024

1 of 10 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

An applicant who meets the test for expedited service is entitled to faster services and postponement of certain verifications until after receiving the initial month's benefits. Expedited households that apply after the 15th day of the month are entitled to the initial and second month's benefits.

The eligibility for expedited services is determined based on the household’s circumstances in the month of application as reported when the application is filed.

If the applicant is not identified as being entitled to expedited service when the application is filed because the application contains incorrect or incomplete information, expedited processing begins on the day the agency receives the information that indicates that the applicant is entitled to this service. This is considered a late determination.

Example 1: A household applies on June 25, reporting no income. The household received benefits for the month of June, but the case is now closed. The household does not qualify for expedited services because benefits have already been received in the month of application.

Example 2: Household applies on July 15, reporting the loss of a job. The household’s countable gross income for July exceeds the income limit for the household size. The household will not have income in the month of August. The household does not qualify for expedited services because the household was not eligible for benefits in the month of application.

NOTE: When a household is determined to be eligible for expedited service but fails to complete the application process (i.e. complete the application, be interviewed, verify identity) within the 7-day timeframe, the household will lose its entitlement to expedited service. The application will be processed within the normal application processing time of 30 days from the date of the application. A late determination cannot be made in these instances since the household lost the entitlement to expedited service.

C-661-SNAP - PO ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Applicants are entitled to expedited service if:

• Their countable gross monthly income is less than $150, and their countable liquid resources are $100 or less;

• They are migrant or seasonal farm workers who are destitute (Refer to C-667-SNAP), and their countable liquid resources are $100 or less; or

• The household's combined monthly gross income and liquid resources are less than the household's monthly rent or mortgage including all escrow payments, and appropriate utility standard.

2 of 10 Only countable income *** received or expected to be received during the month of application is included when determining if a household is entitled to expedited service ***.

If countable income is expected to be received, only count income that there is a reasonable certainty of when the income will be received and the amount of the income. * When determining eligibility and benefits, use the appropriate conversion factor to determine the monthly income amount. Use actual income or the best estimate of anticipated actual income when less than a full month’s income was received because:

• the income terminates during the month, or • the income begins during the month, or • the income is interrupted during the month.

Refer to B-662-SNAP-PR for budgeting procedures.

If you cannot determine both when and how much income is expected to be received, the income ** must not be included when determining if the household is eligible for expedited service.

Non-countable income such as educational assistance, loans, non-recurring lump-sum payments (since these are considered as resources) are not included when determining the household’s countable gross monthly income.

Countable liquid resources that are available as of the date of the interview are included when determining if a household is entitled to expedited service. If the household expects to receive a non- recurring lump sum that would be counted as a resource, but has not actually been received as of the date of the interview, this is not included when determining countable liquid resources.

C-662-SNAP - PO LIMIT ON EXPEDITED CERTIFICATION

There is no limit to the number of times a household can be certified under expedited procedures as long as the household:

• completes the verification requirements that were postponed at the last expedited certification, or

• was certified under normal 30-day processing standards since the last expedited certification.

Exception: If the last expedite certification was over one year ago and the postponed verification was not received, the household can be certified under expedited procedures.

C-663-SNAP – PO TIME LIMITS

Applicants eligible for expedited service must receive their initial benefits timely. Benefits must be received no later than the 7th calendar day following the application date.

3 of 10 C-663-1-SNAP - PO Initial Month's Benefits

Process the application no later than the 7th calendar day following the day the application was filed. Count weekends and holidays when determining the 7 calendar days. If the case is certified on the 7th calendar day, benefits must be issued the same day certified.

EXCEPTIONS: Late determination: If the applicant is not identified as being entitled to expedited service when the application is filed because the application contains incorrect or incomplete information, expedited processing begins on the day the agency receives the information that indicates that the applicant is entitled to this service.

C-663-2-SNAP - PO Second Month's Benefits for Households Who Apply After the 15th of the Month

Expedited households that apply after the 15th of the month must have the second month's benefits issued simultaneously with the initial month's benefits regardless of whether verification is postponed. The third month's benefits must be issued using normal issuance time frames. Postponed verification must be received prior to issuance of the third month's benefits. (See C-930-SNAP.)

C-664-SNAP - PO POSTPONED VERIFICATIONS

Applicants entitled to expedited services must verify their identity before receiving their initial benefits unless an authorized representative applies for the applicant. When an authorized representative applies,

• verify the authorized representative's identity, and

• postpone verification of the applicant's identity if necessary to meet expedited time limits.

If an expedited application is postponed for proof of identity and other required verification, and the household does not provide the verification of identity within the 7-day expedite timeframe, the household loses its eligibility for expedite service on the 8th day.

If the household provides proof of identity after the 7-day expedited timeframe, but fails to provide the other required verification by the 10th day, do not run eligibility on the case since the due date for all the other required verification is not until the 30th day. LITE will close the case automatically on the 30th day for failure to provide verification.

If an expedited application is received from a household that contains a MWR who is sanctioned for failure to register for work, verification that the MWR became exempt after non-compliance may be postponed. Registering for work with the Louisiana Workforce Commission by creating a HiRE account may be postponed for the other household members who are MWRs. The applicant must register for work unless exempt or unless the household has designated an authorized representative

4 of 10 to apply on its behalf. The application may be expedited if the household reports that the MWR became exempt after non-compliance.

If a household member is a MWR and reports an exemption, it must be explored and verification requested, if necessary. The worker must send a Request for Verification to request the verification of the questionable exemption and allow at least 10 days for the MWR to provide the verification. The exemption verification may be postponed. The application may be processed if an individual is claiming an exemption to SNAP work registration requirements and the exemption is questionable. The reason the exemption is questionable must be thoroughly documented. Verification of a questionable exemption may be postponed to meet expedited time limits. Refer to C-664-SNAP-PR.

Verify all other eligibility factors if possible, but do not delay benefits past the expedited time limits for verification of eligibility factors other than identity. If necessary, postpone other verification. LITE will send an automated notice of decision listing the postponed verification.

When there are less than 10 days left in the 30-day application processing time period, allow the household at least 10 days to provide required verification. If the tenth day falls on a weekend or holiday, verification must be provided by the first workday after the weekend or holiday. Follow the procedures outlined in C-664-SNAP PR.

C-664-1-SNAP - PO Households Applying On or Before the 15th of the Month

Applicants who apply on or before the 15th of the month who postpone verification and other program requirements must furnish the required proof before receiving the second month's benefits.

LITE will send an automated notice of decision stating what information is needed, the date it is needed, and that benefits for the second month will not be issued until the information is received. If the client furnishes the information, update the verification and run eligibility on the case. Once the case is authorized, benefits will be automatically issued by LITE on the appropriate date.

If the client does not furnish the needed proof within 30 days of the application date or by the due date, no further benefits will be issued. LITE will close the case automatically on the 30th day. No notice is required to be sent upon closure.

Households closed for failure to furnish postponed verification must provide the postponed verification within 60 days from the original application date or must submit a new application if they want benefits.

If the postponed verification is received after the case has been closed and after the due date on the request for verification but within 60 days of the original application date, the original application may be reused. If the 60th day falls on a weekend or holiday, treat the following workday as the 60th day. The application date remains the same. The case will be reinstated. The reinstatement date is the date the verification is received. The original certification period must be used. Benefits will be prorated from the reinstatement date.

Example: Household applies on March 30. The case is certified on April 2, effective March with postponed verification of the SSN for a household member. The first full month of benefits is April. If SSN verification requirements are not met by April 30, the worker would give Advance Notice of Adverse Action to remove the member effective June.

Assign usual certification periods.

C-667-SNAP - PO DESTITUTE MIGRANT AND SEASONAL FARM WORKER HOUSEHOLDS

Migrant and seasonal farm worker households are destitute if they meet one of the following criteria:

• The household's only income for the month of application is from a terminated source, and the household received the last payment from that source before the application date.

• The household's only income for the month of application is from a new source, and $25 or less is all that will be received from the date of application up to and including the tenth day after the application date.

• The household's only income for the month of application is from a combination of a terminated source and a new source as described above.

Any income which is anticipated to be received from the new source shall be disregarded when determining eligibility and benefit level for the month of application.

Follow the procedures outlined below when processing SNAPx cases in LITE at Application Registration.

Determining SNAPx on the Register Program - Expedited Screening Screen in Application Registration

• Enter the gross of income reported by the client. If the application was submitted via SSP, the gross income reported by the client may be pre-populated. If the income field is blank, the client reported no income in SSP and 0.00 must be entered.

• Enter the liquid resources reported by the client. If the application was submitted via SSP, the resources reported by the client may be pre-populated. If the resource field is blank, the client reported no resources and 0.00 must be entered.

• Review the answer to the question, “Does the household have countable gross income less than $150 AND countable liquid resources of $100 or less?” LITE will automatically populate the answer to this question.

o If the answer is ‘Yes’, do not answer the expense questions. o If the answer is ‘No’, continue to the expense questions.

• Enter the monthly rent/mortgage reported by the client. If the application was submitted via SSP, the monthly rent/mortgage reported by the client may be pre-populated. If the rent/mortgage field is blank, the client reported no rent/mortgage in SSP and 0.00 must be entered.

• Select the utility deduction reported by the client. If the application was submitted via SSP, the client reported no utility deduction in SSP and ‘None’ must be selected.

• Review the Migrant/Seasonal Farmworker section. LITE will automatically determine if this section must be completed.

o If ‘Yes’ is selected to the question, “Does the household contain a migrant/seasonal farm worker, the remaining questions in the section will be enabled.

• Review the answer in the “Household Meets Expedited criteria” section. LITE will automatically determine the expedited status of the case. ‘Yes’ or ‘No’ will be populated.

The following procedures must be followed to authorize an expedited application with postponed verification, while in Data Collection:

• Click on the “Run EDBC” button. The system will navigate you to the Eligibility Summary Screen in LITE.

o For expedited households with an application date before the 15th of the month, the month of the application will display with an Eligibility Status of “Eligible” and the month after the application month will display with an Eligibility Status of “Pending”. The Eyeglasses Icon will be displayed in the column for Pending Reasons-Verifications.

• Click the “Next” button to navigate to the Finalize Eligibility Screen, • Select the checkbox for the months that are eligible, in the Authorize column, and • Click the “Authorize” button.

The expedited months the household is eligible for will authorize. The Notice of Decision letter will be sent informing the household that the case is approved but with postponed verification. The Notice of Decision will display the verifications requested from the client and the due date the verifications are due.

The system will create a task on the owner’s dashboard titled, ‘SNAPX Postponed Verification’. The due date for the task is 30 days from the application received date.

When the postponed verification is received, navigate to the SNAPx Postponed verification task that was created when the case was authorized and take the following actions:

• Click on the ‘Start Work Item’ and you will be navigated to the “Initiate Data Screen”. • Select “Continue previously selected action for” from the dropdown, “What action do you want to perform?” • Click the ‘Next’ button. You will be navigated to the “Finalize Eligibility Screen”. • Click on the blue arrows in the left navigation and select ‘Eligibility Summary’. • Click on the Eyeglass Icon. • Click on the hyperlink for the ‘Missing Verification’. • Update the verification code from ‘Pending’ to the type of verification received from the client • Repeat the above for all verifications received.
