Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-600-FITAP-SNAP Application Processing Document No./Name C-690-FITAP Application Processing-Reminders Effective Date May 1, 2023

1 of 4 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

BEFORE CERTIFYING THE APPLICANT, WORKERS MUST COMPLETE PROCEDURAL TASKS ASSOCIATED WITH THE RECEIPT OF AN APPLICATION THAT INCLUDES THE OFS 1VR, VOTER REGISTRATION DECLARATION STATEMENT AND THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPPLICATION FORM.

II. PROCEDURES

BEFORE CERTIFYING THE APPLICANT:

 ENSURE THAT EACH ITEM ON THE APPLICATION FORM HAS BEEN COMPLETED OR CLEARED AND THAT THE APPLICATION FORM HAS BEEN CORRECTLY SIGNED AND DATED. AN ONLINE APPLICATION THAT WAS SUBMITTED ELECTRONICALLY THROUGH THE DCFS WEB PORTAL CONTAINS AN ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE. AN APPLICATION TAKEN OVER THE TELEPHONE WILL HAVE A TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE.

 ASK THE APPLICANT IF THEY HEARD AND UNDERSTOOD THE PRE-RECORDED RIGHTS AND RESPONSIBILITIES (R&Rs). IF NOT, REVIEW THE CLIENT’S RIGHTS AND RESPONSIBILITIES AND DOCUMENT IN LITE. RESPOND TO ANY QUESTIONS THE APPLICANT HAS.

 For change reporting households document and create a task to follow-up on any expected changes the applicant indicates on the application form or during the interview.

 MAKE REFERRALS TO ANY PROGRAMS FOR WHICH THE APPLICANT MIGHT BE ELIGIBLE SUCH AS, BUT NOT LIMITED TO HEALTHY LOUISIANA (formerly BAYOU HEALTH), LaHIPP, SSI, WIC, AND SOCIAL SECURITY.

 INFORM THE APPLICANT OF THEIR RIGHT TO APPEAL ANY ACTION BY THE DEPARTMENT.

 Explain the reporting requirements which are applicable to the household circumstances.

 EXPLAIN TO THE APPLICANT THAT THEY WILL BE NOTIFIED OF THE LENGTH OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD AND THAT THEY WILL RECEIVE A NOTICE OF EXPIRATION (OFS 18MR) BEFORE THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

 Explore the availability of health insurance coverage for the family at the custodial and non- custodial parents’ places of employment and, if such is available, provide the BHSF Flyer LaHIPP. Document that LaHIPP was discussed.

 Tell the FITAP applicant that a referral is being made to BHSF for a Medicaid eligibility determination.

 Inform applicants about Healthy Louisiana (formerly Bayou Health). LDH has contracted with five different health plans from which a Medicaid recipient can choose: Aetna Better Health of Louisiana, AmeriHealth Caritas Louisiana, Healthy Blue, Louisiana Healthcare Connections, and UnitedHealthcare Community Plan. For information about any of these programs, applicants may call the Louisiana Medicaid Customer Service Hotline at 1.888.342.6207.

 Review the Notice of Cooperation with Support Enforcement Program and Agreement to Relinquish Child Support Payments (OFS Flyer 6) with each applicant that applies for FITAP or KCSP. Failure to sign the OFS Flyer 6 will result in ineligibility for the applicant and rejection of the application. * If a manual form is required, request through LITE. Once the signed ** form is *** * received, update LITE to reflect the date of receipt. **

Note: Completion is required at each application even if a completed form is already on file for this payee and child(ren).

 Review the Notice of Assignment of Rights to State of Louisiana for Medical Support and Payments (OFS Flyer 7) with each applicant that applies for FITAP and KCSP. Failure to sign the OFS Flyer 7 will result in ineligibility for the applicant and rejection of the application. *** * If a manual form is required, request through LITE. Once the signed form is received, update LITE to reflect the date of receipt. **

Note: Completion is required at each application even if a completed form is already on file for this payee and child(ren).

 Review non-custodial parent information with each applicant that applies for FITAP and KCSP:

o Complete Non-Custodial Parent screens in LITE regarding all absent non-custodial parents during the interview with the applicant, with the exception of those absent parents listed in B-1231-1-FITAP - PO, o After completing the Non-Custodial Parent screens with the applicant, generate the OFS 4NCP and OFS 4NCP Supplement form(s), when required according to B-1230-FITAP, by selecting “No – Pending signature” to the following questions: “OFS 4 NCP Signature Received?” and “OFS 4 NCP Supplement Signature Received?” o Mail completed form(s) to the applicant for signature, o Once the applicant returns form(s), review the form(s) for signature, o Scan the form(s) into OnBase, and o Enter the date the signature(s) is received in LITE.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Independence (EI) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-600-FITAP-SNAP Application Processing Document No./Name C-690-SNAP Application Processing-Reminders Effective Date September 1, 2026

2 of 2

o REVIEW THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION FOR LEGIBILITY AND COMPLETENESS.

o VERIFY THAT THE APPLICANT SIGNED THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION IN THE APPROPRIATE BOX.

▪ IF THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION IS RETURNED UNSIGNED, SEND THE FORM BACK TO THE CLIENT WITH AN OFS 18C ADVISING THE CLIENT THAT THEY MUST SIGN THE FORM BEFORE IT CAN BE SUBMITTED TO THE REGISTRAR OF VOTERS’ OFFICE FOR PROCESSING.

o COMPLETE THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION LOCATED AT THE BOTTOM OF THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION UNDER “OFFICIAL USE ONLY”:

▪ SIGN ON THE LINE “RECEIVED BY:” AND WRITE THE MONTH, DAY, AND YEAR OF THE DATE YOU SIGNED THE APPLICATION ON THE LINE MARKED “DATE.” ▪ CIRCLE “PA” AS THE VOTER REGISTRATION AGENCY, AND ▪ MAIL THE COMPLETED LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION TO THE APPROPRIATE PARISH REGISTRAR OF VOTERS.

• REFER TO CHAPTER 7, C-200 FOR MORE INFORMATION ON VOTER REGISTRATION.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

Louisiana Voter Registration Application OFS 1VR Form / Instructions Voter Registration Declaration Statement OFS 18C form / Instructions Client Contact Letter OFS 18MR Form / Instructions Notice of Expiration

IV. REFERENCES

7 CFR 273.2 7 CFR 273.10 LAC 67:III.Subpart 1, Chapter 2 Voter Registration Services The National Voter Registration Act of 1993

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-700 FITAP-SNAP Redeterminations Document No./Name C-710-FITAP Notice of Expiration Effective Date October 1, 2024

1 of 3 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

AN OFS 18MR, NOTICE OF EXPIRATION, WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE SENT TO THE CLIENT ON THE 16TH OF THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE LAST MONTH OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. IF SENT MANUALLY, THE NOTICE MUST BE SENT IN SUFFICIENT TIME TO BE RECEIVED BY THE HOUSEHOLD PRIOR TO THE FIRST DAY OF THE LAST MONTH OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. ALLOW AT LEAST 4 DAYS MAIL TIME FOR THE HOUSEHOLD TO RECEIVE THE NOTICE.

THE NOTICE OF EXPIRATION ADVISES THE CLIENT:

● THAT THEIR CERTIFICATION PERIOD IS EXPIRING,

● TO COMPLETE AN APPLICATION FOR CONTINUED ASSISTANCE TO DETERMINE THEIR CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY,

● THAT THE APPLICATION FOR CONTINUED ASSISTANCE CAN BE COMPLETED OVER THE TELEPHONE BY CALLING, * 1-888-LAHELPU, ONLINE, AT A DCFS OFFICE OR COMMUNITY PARTNER SITE IN THEIR AREA, OR BY COMPLETING AND SUBMITTING A PAPER REDETERMINATION APPLICATION,

● TO CALL THE ON-DEMAND INTERVIEW LINE AT 1-888-LAHELPU TO COMPLETE AN INTERVIEW ONCE THEIR ** APPLICATION FOR CONTINUED ASSISTANCE HAS BEEN SUBMITTED, AND

● OF THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE.

THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE IS THE 15TH DAY OF THE LAST MONTH OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. IF THE 15TH FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE IS THE NEXT WORKDAY. THE CLIENT HAS TIMELY REAPPLIED IF THE APPLICATION CONTAINING THE NAME, ADDRESS, AND SIGNATURE OF THE HEAD OF HOUSEHOLD, or someone acting responsibly for the household IS RECEIVED ON OR BEFORE THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE. IF THE *** * CLIENT APPLIES OVER THE TELEPHONE, THE APPLICATION ** IS CONSIDERED SIGNED WHEN THEY COMPLETE THE TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE.

REDETERMINATION INTERVIEWS:

● WILL BE COMPLETED WHEN THE CLIENT CALLS IN TO COMPLETE THEIR INTERVIEW THROUGH THE ON DEMAND INTERVIEW LINE.

● SHOULD BE COMPLETED AT THE SAME TIME THE REDETERMINATION APPLICATION IS BEING TAKEN OVER THE TELEPHONE.

2 of 3 ● MAY NOT BE CONDUCTED EARLIER THAN THE 16TH OF THE MONTH IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE LAST MONTH OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. Exception: FITAP redeterminations may be completed prior to the redetermination month to match the SNAP certification period. The FITAP redetermination interview may also be conducted during the month prior to the redetermination month if an interview is being conducted for a SNAP application. *** * IF THE CLIENT REQUESTS A SCHEDULED INTERVIEW, IT SHOULD BE SCHEDULED SO THAT THE INTERVIEW WILL BE COMPLETED PRIOR TO THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE. ALLOW SUFFICIENT MAIL TIME BEFORE SCHEDULING THE INTERVIEW DATE AND TIME.

II. PROCEDURES

THE NOTICE OF EXPIRATION IS SENT THROUGH AN AUTOMATED PROCESS THROUGH LITE OR MANUALLY.

● IF A CLIENT CONTACTS THE AGENCY FOR AN APPLICATION, STAFF SHOULD ADVISE THE CLIENT TO COMPLETE THE REDETERMINATION ONLINE VIA THE DCFS WEBSITE, OR BY CALLING 1-888-LAHELPU (1-888-524-3578). **

● IF THE CLIENT STATES THEY PREFER A PAPER APPLICATION, ADVISE THE CLIENT THEY MAY PICK UP A PAPER FORM OR WE WILL MAIL ONE UPON REQUEST.

● IF A CLIENT REQUESTS A PAPER REDETERMINATION APPLICATION, *** PARISH OFFICE STAFF MUST PROVIDE ONE IN ENOUGH TIME FOR THE CLIENT TO SUBMIT BY THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE.

● IF A CLIENT INDICATES ON THE APPLICATION THAT THEY DO NOT UNDERSTAND ENGLISH AND WOULD LIKE TO RECEIVE CORRESPONDENCE IN A LANGUAGE OTHER THAN ENGLISH (SPANISH OR VIETNAMESE), STAFF MUST ENSURE THE OFS * 4MR SP OR 4MR VN, WHICH CONTAINS THE NOTICE OF EXPIRATION, ** IS SENT OUT IN THE APPROPRIATE LANGUAGE.

IF THE OFS 18MR IS RETURNED FROM THE U. S. POSTAL SERVICE AS UNDELIVERABLE THAT INCLUDES A FORWARDING ADDRESS, MAIL ANOTHER OFS 18MR TO THE FORWARDING ADDRESS IDENTIFIED ON THE RETURNED MAIL. LITE MUST BE UPDATED WITH THE FORWARDING ADDRESS IDENTIFIED ON THE RETURNED MAIL.

IF THE OFS 18MR IS RETURNED FROM THE U. S. POSTAL SERVICE AS UNDELIVERABLE WITH NO FORWARDING ADDRESS, DOUBLE CHECK TO BE SURE THE ADDRESS IS CORRECT. IF THE ADDRESS IS CORRECT, NO ACTION IS REQUIRED.

AN OFS 18MR, NOTICE OF EXPIRATION, WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE SENT TO THE CLIENT ON THE 16th OF THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE LAST MONTH OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. IF SENT MANUALLY, THE NOTICE MUST BE SENT IN SUFFICIENT TIME TO BE RECEIVED BY THE HOUSEHOLD PRIOR TO THE FIRST DAY OF THE LAST MONTH OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. ALLOW AT LEAST 4 DAYS MAIL TIME FOR THE HOUSEHOLD TO RECEIVE THE NOTICE.

THE NOTICE OF EXPIRATION ADVISES THE CLIENT:

• THAT THEIR CERTIFICATION PERIOD IS EXPIRING,

• TO COMPLETE AN APPLICATION FOR CONTINUED ASSISTANCE TO DETERMINE THEIR CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY,

• THAT THE APPLICATION FOR CONTINUED ASSISTANCE CAN BE COMPLETED ONLINE, AT AN LDH OFFICE OR COMMUNITY PARTNER SITE IN THEIR AREA, OR BY COMPLETING AND SUBMITTING A PAPER REDETERMINATION APPLICATION, AND

• OF THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE.

THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE IS THE 15TH DAY OF THE LAST MONTH OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. IF THE 15TH FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE IS THE NEXT WORKDAY. IF THE CLIENT APPLIES OVER THE TELEPHONE, THE APPLICATION IS CONSIDERED SIGNED WHEN THEY COMPLETE THE TELEPHONIC SIGNATURE.

Exception: The SNAP interview may be conducted during the month prior to the redetermination month if an interview is being conducted for a FITAP or KCSP application.

IF THE CLIENT REQUESTS A SCHEDULED INTERVIEW, IT SHOULD BE SCHEDULED SO THAT THE INTERVIEW WILL BE COMPLETED PRIOR TO THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE. ALLOW SUFFICIENT MAIL TIME BEFORE SCHEDULING THE INTERVIEW DATE AND TIME.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-700-FITAP-SNAP Redeterminations Document No./Name C-720-FITAP Processing Redeterminations Effective Date May 1, 2023

1 of 5 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

There are no policy statements associated with these procedures.

II. PROCEDURES

ACCEPT THE APPLICATION IF IT CONTAINS THE NAME, ADDRESS, AND SIGNATURE OF THE HEAD OF HOUSEHOLD OR someone acting responsibly for the household.

IF A MANUAL APPLICATION IS SUBMITTED AND DOES NOT CONTAIN THIS INFORMATION, THE ENTIRE APPLICATION MUST BE RETURNED TO THE HOUSEHOLD WITH A MANUAL OFS 18C ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD OF THE MISSING REQUIRED INFORMATION AND THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE FOR RETURNING THE APPLICATION.

APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED THROUGH CAFÉ CONTAIN THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS TO ESTABLISH THE APPLICATION INCLUDING AN ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE.

*** Household Timely Reapplies

IF THE HOUSEHOLD TIMELY REAPPLIES:

● * UPON RECEIPT OF AN APPLICATION IN THE CAFÉ SELF-SERVICE PORTAL, THE APPLICATION IS ROUTED VIA A STATEWIDE ROUND ROBIN TO A MEMBER OF THE APPOINTMENTS TEAM.

● THE APPLICATION IS THEN AUTO-SCHEDULED THROUGH LITE AND AN APPOINTMENT IS ENTERED ON THE WORKER’S CALENDAR ON ONE OF THE THEIR AVAILABLE APPOINTMENT TIME SLOTS.

● AN INTERVIEW NOTICE (OFS 18C-AL) ** WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY SENT ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD OF THE DAY AND TIME OF THEIR SCHEDULED INTERVIEW. ***

○ * IF THE HOUSEHOLD MISSES THE SCHEDULED INTERVIEW, A NOTICE OF MISSED INTERVIEW (NOMI) WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY SENT INFORMING THE HOUSEHOLD TO CALL THE MISSED INTERVIEW LINE BY THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD TO AVOID CASE CLOSURE. ** IF AN INTERVIEW IS NOT COMPLETED BY THE LAST WORKDAY OF THE REDETERMINATION MONTH, LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY CLOSE THE CASE.

○ IF THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACTS THE AGENCY FOR AN INTERVIEW, THE REDETERMINATION INTERVIEW WILL BE CONDUCTED AT THAT TIME TO DETERMINE CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY. IF AN INTERVIEW IS UNABLE TO BE COMPLETED THAT DAY, THE HOUSEHOLD WILL *** * HAVE THEIR INTERVIEW RESCHEDULED. **

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-700-FITAP-SNAP Redeterminations Document No./Name C-720-FITAP Processing Redeterminations Effective Date May 1, 2023

2 of 5 ● ***

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD IS INTERVIEWED, CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY MUST BE DETERMINED IN LITE.

● Check the case during the interview for any instances of non-compliance that have been received but not yet imposed due to the pending reapplication.

Failure to comply with a FITAP eligibility requirement or STEP requirement without good cause at redetermination will result in case closure.

Discuss the instance of non-compliance during the interview and advise the household that compliance is required for continued assistance. Use * the Pending Verification – Details screen to generate the Request for Verification correspondence in LITE.

Note: The Request for Verification notice mailed to the client is not automated to attach the OFS 53, Requirement to Cooperate with CSE. The worker must locally print the Request for Verification and attach a manual OFS 53 prior to mailing to the client.

If the client does not become compliant by the due date, the case must be closed.

LITE will send a concurrent notice of adverse action ** the same day the redetermination is processed.

If an instance of non-compliance occurs after the redetermination interview but prior to the last workday of the redetermination month, send an OFS 18C to advise the family of the non- compliance and allow 10 days for the household to comply.

Do not close a case for non-compliance before the due date. The case will be suspended.

For STEP non-compliances, contact the STEP Coach after the due date to verify the client’s compliance prior to case closure

If the client is in compliance by the due date and all eligibility requirements are met, reinstate benefits.

● SEND AN AUTOMATED REQUEST FOR REQUIRED VERIFICATION (OFS 18C) ALLOWING AT LEAST 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE THE VERIFICATION. WHEN THERE ARE LESS THAN 10 DAYS LEFT IN THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, THE DUE DATE MUST STILL BE 10 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF THE REQUEST.

● CLEAR DISCREPANCIES ON THE APPLICATION AS FOLLOWS:

○ ONLINE APPLICATIONS

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-700-FITAP-SNAP Redeterminations Document No./Name C-720-FITAP Processing Redeterminations Effective Date May 1, 2023

3 of 5

DOCUMENT INFORMATION AS A DETAILED CASE NOTE IN LITE. IF VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED AFTER THE INTERVIEW, DOCUMENT RECEIPT IN A CASE NOTE AND UPDATE THE APPLICABLE VERIFICATION CODING IN LITE.

○ PAPER APPLICATIONS

THE APPLICATION MUST BE REGISTERED IN LITE AND UPLOADED TO ONBASE. ALL INFORMATION MUST BE DOCUMENTED IN LITE. IF VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED AFTER THE INTERVIEW, DOCUMENT RECEIPT IN A CASE NOTE AND UPDATE THE APPLICABLE VERIFICATION CODING IN LITE.

*** ● IF THE APPLICATION INCLUDES A REQUEST FOR ASSISTANCE IN COMPLETING THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION, THE WORKER SHALL PROVIDE THE REQUESTED ASSISTANCE.

● IF AN APPLICATION IS RECEIVED IN THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE REDETERMINATION MONTH AND A CHANGE IS REPORTED, FOLLOW POLICY IN C-820-FITAP.

○ IF THE CHANGE RESULTS IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS AND VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION, THE CHANGE IS EFFECTIVE THE REDETERMINATION MONTH. AUTHORIZE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS IF NECESSARY.

○ IF THE CHANGE RESULTS IN A DECREASE IN BENEFITS, ADVANCE NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION IS REQUIRED TO REDUCE BENEFITS.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS ON THE APPLICATION OR DURING THE INTERVIEW THAT A CHANGE WILL OCCUR BEFORE THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, THIS CHANGE MUST BE ACTED UPON AS PART OF THE REDETERMINATION. THE REPORTED CHANGE WOULD NOT BE CONSIDERED REPORTED OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTED AN INTERIM CHANGE OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS AND ACTION WAS NOT TAKEN TO PROCESS THE CHANGE, THE CHANGE MUST BE REVIEWED AND DISCUSSED WITH THE HOUSEHOLD WHEN COMPLETING THE REDETERMINATION INTERVIEW.

● CHECK THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY FOR ALL HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS included in the Assistance Unit. WHEN THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY INTERFACE STATUS CHANGES TO COMPLETE, CLEAR ALL HITS ACCORDING TO POLICY IN C-220-FITAP.

● DOCUMENT ALL ACTIVITIES AS A CASE NOTE IN LITE.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-700-FITAP-SNAP Redeterminations Document No./Name C-720-FITAP Processing Redeterminations Effective Date May 1, 2023

4 of 5

● COMPLETE THE REDETERMINATION BY THE CUTOFF DATE FOR THE REDETERMINATION MONTH IN ORDER TO ASSURE THAT:

○ ELIGIBLE RECIPIENTS CONTINUE TO RECEIVE BENEFITS WITHOUT INTERRUPTION OF THE NORMAL ISSUANCE CYCLE, AND

○ INELIGIBLE RECIPIENTS DO NOT RECEIVE BENEFITS BEYOND THEIR CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

EXCEPTION: DO NOT CLOSE A CASE FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION OR FOR FAILURE TO COMPLETE AN INTERVIEW AFTER TIMELY REAPPLYING UNTIL THE LAST WORKDAY OF THE MONTH. HOWEVER, THE CASE MAY NOT BE CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE REQUIRED VERIFICATION BEFORE THE DUE DATE ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. THE CASE WILL BE SUSPENDED. IF THE CASE IS CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION, AND ALL ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS ARE MET, REINSTATE BENEFITS WITHIN FIVE WORKDAYS FROM THE DATE THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED. BENEFITS MUST NOT BE PRORATED. ISSUE MANUAL BENEFITS, IF NECESSARY.

● SEND A CONCURRENT NOTICE ONCE AN ELIGIBILITY DECISION HAS BEEN MADE. IF THE CASE IS CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION, LITE WILL SEND A SEMI- AUTOMATED NOTICE OF DECISION TO THE HOUSEHOLD LISTING THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION THAT IS NEEDED TO REOPEN THE CASE.

● REUSE THE APPLICATION FOLLOWING CLOSURE AT REDETERMINATION IN THE FOLLOWING CIRCUMSTANCES:

○ A HOUSEHOLD THAT FAILED TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION PROVIDES THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, OR

○ A HOUSEHOLD THAT FAILED TO COMPLETE AN INTERVIEW AFTER TIMELY REAPPLYING CONTACTS THE AGENCY AND IS INTERVIEWED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

REFER TO C-630-FITAP / SNAP, SECTION C-638-FITAP/SNAP FOR FURTHER INFORMATION REGARDING REUSE OF THE APPLICATION FORM.

NOTE: IF PARTIAL VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED, A SECOND REQUEST IS NOT NECESSARY.

HOUSEHOLD FAILS TO TIMELY REAPPLY

IF THE HOUSEHOLD FAILS TO TIMELY REAPPLY:

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Independence (EI) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-700-FITAP-SNAP Redeterminations Document No./Name C-720-SNAP Processing Redeterminations Effective Date May 15, 2026

1 of 7 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

Elderly Simplified Application Project (ESAP) Households

Interview requirements shall be waived for ESAP households at redetermination. However, an interview is required in the following instances:

• Prior to closing or denying an ESAP case; • If information on the application is questionable, incomplete, or contradictory; or • The household requests an interview.

II. PROCEDURES

ACCEPT THE APPLICATION IF IT CONTAINS THE NAME, ADDRESS, AND SIGNATURE OF THE HEAD OF HOUSEHOLD or other responsible household member, or authorized representative.

IF A MANUAL APPLICATION IS SUBMITTED AND DOES NOT CONTAIN THIS INFORMATION, THE ENTIRE APPLICATION MUST BE RETURNED TO THE HOUSEHOLD WITH A MANUAL OFS 18C ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD OF THE MISSING REQUIRED INFORMATION AND THE TIMELY REAPPLICATION DATE FOR RETURNING THE APPLICATION.

APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED THROUGH CAFÉ CONTAIN THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS TO ESTABLISH THE APPLICATION INCLUDING AN ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE.

ESAP Household Timely Reapplies – Interview Waived.

An interview is required and must be scheduled timely if any one of the above instances exists. When an ESAP household submits a redetermination application, LITE will place the case in ‘Waived Appointment’ status.

When a signed and completed application for an ESAP household that has no earned income is received timely, staff must review the information on the form to determine if the interview can be waived as follows:

• If the household appears eligible for recertification and all verification is received, process the redetermination without an interview.

• If mandatory verifications are missing or information provided is questionable, schedule an interview appointment with the household through LITE.

o If the household misses the scheduled interview, send a Notice of Missed Interview (NOMI) to the household. If the household does not complete the interview, close the case for “failed to keep interview appointment”.

2 of 7

• If the information provided on the application indicates the household may be ineligible for benefits, no longer meets the ESAP criteria (for example, the household reports an adult household member is working), or the household requests an interview, schedule an interview appointment. The interview cannot be waived.

o If the household misses the scheduled interview, send a Notice of Missed Interview (NOMI) to the household. If the household does not complete the interview, close the case for “failed to keep interview appointment”.

• If the household fails to complete a question on a non-eligibility factor (deductible expenses, voter registration, etc.) contact the household to obtain clarifying information. If the household cannot be reached by telephone, send an OFS 18C to request the client to return a call within 10 days to clarify missing information. However, if the household does not contact the agency within the given time frame, a NOMI must not be sent and the case must not be closed. All deductible expenses previously budgeted must be ended.

• If the application includes a request for assistance in completing the Louisiana voter registration application, the worker shall contact the household by telephone and provide the requested assistance.

• A scheduled interview is not required to verify shelter expenses unless the reported expenses are questionable. If the expenses are not questionable, send an OFS 18C to the household requesting verification. If verification is provided, update the shelter expenses accordingly. If the verification is not provided, remove the shelter expenses and proceed with processing the case. The case must not be closed or denied for failure to verify shelter expenses as deductions are not an eligibility factor.

Regular Household Timely Reapplies

IF THE HOUSEHOLD TIMELY REAPPLIES:

• UPON RECEIPT OF AN APPLICATION IN THE CAFÉ SELF-SERVICE PORTAL, THE APPLICATION IS ROUTED VIA STATEWIDE ROUND ROBIN TO A MEMBER OF THE APPOINTMENTS TEAM. • THE APPLICATION IS THEN AUTO-SCHEDULED THROUGH LITE AND AN APPOINTMENT IS ENTERED ON THE WORKER’S CALENDAR ON ONE OF THEIR AVAILABLE APPOINTMENT TIME SLOTS. • AN INTERVIEW NOTICE (OFS 18C-AL) WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY SENT ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD OF THE DAY AND TIME OF THEIR SCHEDULED INTERVIEW.

o IF THE HOUSEHOLD MISSES THE SCHEDULED INTERVIEW, A NOTICE OF MISSED INTERVIEW (NOMI) WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY SENT INFORMING THE HOUSEHOLD TO

3 of 7 CONTACT THE AGENCY BY THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD AND SCHEDULE ANOTHER INTERVIEW APPOINTMENT TO AVOID CASE CLOSURE. IF AN INTERVIEW IS NOT COMPLETED BY THE LAST WORKDAY OF THE REDETERMINATION MONTH, LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY CLOSE THE CASE.

o IF THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACTS THE AGENCY FOR AN INTERVIEW, THE REDETERMINATION INTERVIEW WILL BE CONDUCTED AT THIS TIME TO DETERMINE CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY. IF AN INTERVIEW IS UNABLE TO BE COMPLETED THAT DAY, THE HOUSEHOLD WILL HAVE THEIR INTERVIEW RESCHEDULED.

o IF THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACTS THE AGENCY AND REQUESTS A SCHEDULED INTERVIEW, A SEMI-AUTOMATED APPOINTMENT LETTER 18C-AL MUST BE SENT NO LATER THAN THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY TO CONFIRM THE SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT.

• IF THE HOUSEHOLD IS INTERVIEWED, CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY MUST BE DETERMINED IN LITE.

• SEND AN AUTOMATED REQUEST FOR REQUIRED VERIFICATION (OFS 18C) ALLOWING AT LEAST 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE THE VERIFICATION. WHEN THERE ARE LESS THAN 10 DAYS LEFT IN THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, THE DUE DATE MUST STILL BE 10 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF THE REQUEST.

• CLEAR DISCREPANCIES ON THE APPLICATION AS FOLLOWS:

o ONLINE APPLICATIONS

DOCUMENT INFORMATION AS A DETAILED CASE NOTE IN LITE. IF VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED AFTER THE INTERVIEW, DOCUMENT RECEIPT IN A CASE NOTE AND UPDATE THE APPLICABLE VERIFICATION CODING IN LITE.

o PAPER APPLICATIONS

THE APPLICATION MUST BE REGISTERED IN LITE AND UPLOADED IN FILENET. ALL INFORMATION MUST BE DOCUMENTED IN LITE. IF VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED AFTER THE INTERVIEW, DOCUMENT RECEIPT IN A CASE NOTE AND UPDATE THE APPLICABLE VERIFICATION CODING IN LITE.

In LITE, an automated interface is run to check the work registration of all MWRs in HIRE. Use the results displayed in the Clearance Summary to determine if the MWR has a HIRE account. Another SNAP 4RW does not have to be sent to any MWR who has already been identified as a MWR and notified of the requirement.

4 of 7 Failure to register for work with LWC, without good cause, at redetermination will result in a SNAP work registration sanction. Only SNAP recipients whose case was active when the non-compliance occurred can be sanctioned for failure to comply with SNAP work registration requirements. The disqualification period is the same as all other work registration sanctions.

If the MWR has not registered for work with LWC, discuss if good cause exists during the interview.

If the household reports an exemption or good cause for not complying with LWC, which is questionable, send an OFS 18C or semi-automated FFCCL – Client Contact Letter (18C-FF) in LITE to request verification of the questionable information and allow 10 days for the household to provide the requested verification. The reason the information is questionable must be thoroughly documented.

If the household misses the redetermination interview, contact the household to determine if good cause exists. If the household is reached, also conduct the interview at that time. Refer to B-1440- SNAP for good cause determination.

If good cause does not exist for failure to register for work, the sanction must be imposed at the same time action on the redetermination is completed. A concurrent Notice of Adverse Action must be sent the same day the redetermination is processed. Follow procedures listed in B-1434 SNAP-PR.

Example: The household was interviewed for an October redetermination. Good cause did not exist for failure to register for work with LWC. The redetermination, sanction, and concurrent Notice of Adverse Action are completed on October 30th. The sanction is effective November with the new certification period.

If the redetermination is not extended due to a procedural reason and the case contains a MWR who failed to register for work with LWC and good cause does not exist, close the case the last workday of the redetermination month. Send a concurrent Notice of Adverse Action to impose a sanction on all MWRs who failed to register with HiRE effective the month following the redetermination month. Follow procedures listed in B-1434 SNAP-PR.

Example: The household was interviewed for an October redetermination but failed to provide verification. The case was closed on October 31st for that reason. Good cause did not exist for failure to register for work with LWC. Concurrent Notice of Adverse Action must be sent listing the effective month of the sanction as November. The notice must indicate that the case was closed for failure to provide the required verification (listing the verification) and include the sanction for failure to register for work – HiRE.

• IF THE APPLICATION INCLUDES A REQUEST FOR ASSISTANCE IN COMPLETING THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION, THE WORKER SHALL PROVIDE THE REQUESTED ASSISTANCE.

5 of 7 • IF AN APPLICATION IS RECEIVED IN THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE REDETERMINATION MONTH AND A CHANGE IS REPORTED, FOLLOW POLICY IN C-820-SNAP.

o IF THE CHANGE RESULTS IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS AND VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION, THE CHANGE IS EFFECTIVE THE REDETERMINATION MONTH. AUTHORIZE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS IF NECESSARY.

o IF THE CHANGE RESULTS IN A DECREASE IN BENEFITS, ADVANCE NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION IS REQUIRED TO REDUCE BENEFITS.

• IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS ON THE APPLICATION OR DURING THE INTERVIEW THAT A CHANGE WILL OCCUR BEFORE THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, THIS CHANGE MUST BE ACTED UPON AS PART OF THE REDETERMINATION. THE REPORTED CHANGE WOULD NOT BE CONSIDERED REPORTED OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS.

Example: A May redetermination application is received in the office on April 22. On April 26 the client is interviewed and she reports that her 17year old son, who turns 18 on May 20, is still in high school and is still employed part-time at Walmart. Verification of school attendance and earnings is provided on May 24. The worker processes the recertification on May 29 budgeting the child’s earnings effective June.

• IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTED AN INTERIM CHANGE OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS AND ACTION WAS NOT TAKEN TO PROCESS THE CHANGE, THE CHANGE MUST BE REVIEWED AND DISCUSSED WITH THE HOUSEHOLD WHEN COMPLETING THE REDETERMINATION INTERVIEW.

• CHECK THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY FOR ALL HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS. WHEN THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY INTERFACE STATUS CHANGES TO COMPLETE, CLEAR ALL HITS ACCORDING TO POLICY IN C-220-SNAP.

• DOCUMENT ALL ACTIVITIES AS A CASE NOTE IN LITE.

• COMPLETE THE REDETERMINATION BY THE CUTOFF DATE FOR THE REDETERMINATION MONTH IN ORDER TO ASSURE THAT:

o ELIGIBLE RECIPIENTS CONTINUE TO RECEIVE BENEFITS WITHOUT INTERRUPTION OF THE NORMAL ISSUANCE CYCLE, AND

o INELIGIBLE RECIPIENTS DO NOT RECEIVE BENEFITS BEYOND THEIR CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Independence (EI) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-700-FITAP-SNAP Redeterminations Document No./Name C-720-SNAP Processing Redeterminations Effective Date May 15, 2026

6 of 7 EXCEPTION: DO NOT CLOSE A CASE FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION OR FOR FAILURE TO COMPLETE AN INTERVIEW AFTER TIMELY REAPPLYING UNTIL THE LAST WORKDAY OF THE MONTH. HOWEVER, THE CASE MAY NOT BE CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE REQUIRED VERIFICATION BEFORE THE DUE DATE ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. THE CASE WILL BE SUSPENDED. IF THE CASE IS CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION, AND ALL ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS ARE MET, REINSTATE BENEFITS WITHIN FIVE WORKDAYS FROM THE DATE THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED. BENEFITS MUST NOT BE PRORATED. ISSUE MANUAL BENEFITS, IF NECESSARY.

• SEND A CONCURRENT NOTICE ONCE AN ELIGIBILITY DECISION HAS BEEN MADE. IF THE CASE IS CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION, LITE WILL SEND A NOTICE OF DECISIONTO THE HOUSEHOLD LISTING THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION THAT IS NEEDED TO REOPEN THE CASE.

• REUSE THE APPLICATION FOLLOWING CLOSURE AT REDETERMINATION IN THE FOLLOWING CIRCUMSTANCES:

o A HOUSEHOLD THAT FAILED TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION PROVIDES THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, OR

o A HOUSEHOLD THAT FAILED TO COMPLETE AN INTERVIEW AFTER TIMELY REAPPLYING CONTACTS THE AGENCY AND IS INTERVIEWED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

REFER TO C-630-FITAP/SNAP, FOR FURTHER INFORMATION REGARDING REUSE OF THE APPLICATION FORM.

NOTE: IF PARTIAL VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED, A SECOND REQUEST IS NOT NECESSARY.

HOUSEHOLD FAILS TO TIMELY REAPPLY

IF THE HOUSEHOLD FAILS TO TIMELY REAPPLY:

• LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY CLOSE THE CASE.

• No action is taken on the Mandatory Work Registrant (MWR) who failed to register for work with Louisiana Workforce Commission (LWC) since the household is not requesting benefits.

• SEND ADVANCE NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION TO CLOSE IF THE NOTICE OF EXPIRATION WAS NOT PROPERLY COMPLETED OR WAS NOT SENT TIMELY.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4-Economic Support (ES) Part No./Name C-Case Processing (FITAP) Section No./Name C-700 FITAP Redeterminations (FITAP) Document No./Name C-750-FITAP Setting The Next Redetermination Date Effective Date November 1, 2014

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

Determine the date of the next redetermination by counting twelve or 24 months including the effective month of redetermination.

The redetermination period for FITAP * must ** be shortened to coincide with the SNAP redetermination.

II. PROCEDURES

C-751-FITAP * -PR ** COORDINATING SNAP AND FITAP CERTIFICATION PERIODS

FITAP REDETERMINATIONS MAY BE COMPLETED PRIOR TO THE REDETERMINATION MONTH TO MATCH THE SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

EXAMPLES:

THERE IS AN EXISTING FITAP CASE WITH A REDETERMINATION DUE IN JULY. THE CLIENT APPLIES FOR SNAP IN JANUARY. THE SNAP CASE WILL BE INCLUDED IN SR AND THEREFORE CERTIFIED FOR 12 MONTHS WITH THE REDETERMINATIONS DUE IN DECEMBER. ELIGIBILITY SHOULD BE REDETERMINED FOR FITAP USING THE * CURRENT APPLICATION ** AND THE FITAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD WOULD BE EXTENDED TO MATCH THE SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

THERE IS AN EXISTING SNAP CASE WITH A REDETERMINATION DUE IN JULY. THE CLIENT APPLIES FOR FITAP IN JANUARY. THE FITAP CASE SHOULD BE CERTIFIED THRU JULY TO MATCH THE SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

THERE IS A FITAP CASE WITH A REDETERMINATION DUE IN APRIL. THE ASSOCIATED SNAP CASE IS CERTIFIED THRU NOVEMBER. IN APRIL RECERTIFY THE FITAP CASE THRU NOVEMBER TO MATCH THE SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

THERE IS AN EXISTING SNAP CASE WITH A REDETERMINATION DUE IN FEBRUARY. THE ASSOCIATED FITAP CASE IS CERTIFIED THRU JULY. REVIEW BOTH SNAP AND FITAP ELIGIBILITY WHEN COMPLETING THE REDETERMINATION. THE NEW CERTIFICATION PERIOD FOR BOTH PROGRAMS WOULD BE MARCH THRU FEBRUARY OF THE FOLLOWING YEAR.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

* OFS 004APP Form/Instructions Application for Assistance **

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

Assign a 12-month certification period except in the following circumstances:

● Assign a 36-month certification period to Elderly Simplified Application Project (ESAP) households.

***

II. PROCEDURES

C-751-SNAP - PR COORDINATING SNAP AND FITAP CERTIFICATION PERIODS

FITAP REDETERMINATIONS MAY BE COMPLETED PRIOR TO THE REDETERMINATION MONTH TO MATCH THE SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD. The certification period must not be adjusted on SNAP cases.

EXAMPLES:

THERE IS AN EXISTING FITAP CASE WITH A REDETERMINATION DUE IN JULY. THE CLIENT APPLIES FOR SNAP IN JANUARY. THE SNAP CASE WILL BE INCLUDED IN SR AND CERTIFIED FOR 12 MONTHS WITH THE REDETERMINATION DUE IN DECEMBER. ELIGIBILITY SHOULD BE REDETERMINED FOR FITAP USING THE CURRENT APPLICATION AND THE FITAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD WOULD BE EXTENDED TO MATCH THE SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

THERE IS AN EXISTING SNAP CASE WITH A REDETERMINATION DUE IN JULY. THE CLIENT APPLIES FOR FITAP IN JANUARY. THE FITAP CASE SHOULD BE CERTIFIED THRU JULY TO MATCH THE SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

THERE IS A FITAP CASE WITH A REDETERMINATION DUE IN APRIL. THE ASSOCIATED SNAP CASE IS CERTIFIED THRU NOVEMBER. IN APRIL RECERTIFY THE FITAP CASE THRU NOVEMBER TO MATCH THE SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD.

THERE IS AN EXISTING SNAP CASE WITH A REDETERMINATION DUE IN FEBRUARY. THE ASSOCIATED FITAP CASE IS CERTIFIED THRU JULY. REVIEW BOTH SNAP AND FITAP ELIGIBILITY WHEN COMPLETING THE REDETERMINATION. THE NEW CERTIFICATION PERIOD FOR BOTH PROGRAMS WOULD BE MARCH THRU FEBRUARY OF THE FOLLOWING YEAR.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

OFS 4APP Form / Instructions Application for Assistance

Divison/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-800 FITAP-SNAP Changes Document No./Name C-810-FITAP Reporting Requirements Effective Date July 1, 2023

1 of 3 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

Change Reporting Households

FITAP households must report changes that affect benefits and eligibility within 10 days of knowledge of the change with the exceptions noted below. If the 10th day falls on a weekend or holiday, treat the following workday as the 10th day.

Change reporting households must report changes in:

● Source of income.

● Household composition.

● Residence.

● The amount of the household's gross monthly income of more than $100.00 for unearned income and $100.00 for earned income.

● School attendance of any child age 18.

● Marital status of any household member.

Exceptions to reporting within 10 days of knowledge:

● Increases in income due to new employment within 10 days of the date the individual starts the new job.

● Applicants who have changes which occur after the application interview and before the date of the notice of eligibility, must report these changes within 10 days of the date of the notice.

Simplified Reporting Households

FITAP applicants who are included in a SNAP Simplified Reporting household ARE REQUIRED TO REPORT IF ONE OF THE FOLLOWING CHANGES OCCURS AFTER THE APPLICATION INTERVIEW OR DURING THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. THE CHANGE MUST BE REPORTED BY THE 10TH OF THE MONTH FOLLOWING THE MONTH THE CHANGE OCCURED. IF THE 10TH DAY OF THE MONTH FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, TREAT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY AS THE 10TH DAY.

● INCREASE IN INCOME THAT CAUSES THE HOUSEHOLD INCOME TO EXCEED 130% OF THE FEDERAL POVERTY LEVEL (FPL) FOR THE HOUSEHOLD SIZE. THIS INCLUDES THE INCOME OF NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS.

2 of 3 The FITAP household must also follow the reporting requirements explained in the Family Success Agreement and report these changes within 10 days of knowledge of the change. Report within 10 days if the only child in the home moves out of the home.

Post-FITAP Reporting

The Post-FITAP participant must report within 10 days if the only child in the home moves out of the home, if they move out of state, and when their employment ends.

II. PROCEDURES

FOLLOW PROCEDURES IN C-820-SNAP/FITAP WHEN AN INTERIM CHANGE IS REPORTED BY THE CLIENT.

NOTE: WHEN EVALUATING A CHANGE, ALWAYS CONSIDER THE INCOME OF ALL REQUIRED HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS. THIS INCLUDES PREVIOUSLY REPORTED INCOME THAT DID NOT RESULT IN TERMINATION OF BENEFITS.

C-811-FITAP HOW TO REPORT

Change Reporting households may report changes by mail, fax, e-mail, telephone, in person, via the CAFÉ Self Service portal, or through someone acting on their behalf.

SIMPLIFIED REPORTING HOUSEHOLDS ARE REQUIRED TO REPORT CHANGES THROUGH THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS. REFER TO CHAPTER 4, PART S, SIMPLIFIED REPORTING. INTERIM CHANGES THAT SIMPLIFIED REPORTING HOUSEHOLDS ARE REQUIRED TO REPORT MAY BE REPORTED BY MAIL, FAX, E-MAIL, * TELEPHONE **, IN PERSON, VIA THE CAFÉ SELF SERVICE PORTAL, OR THROUGH SOMEONE ACTING ON BEHALF OF THE HOUSEHOLD.

C-812-FITAP NOTIFYING HOUSEHOLDS OF REPORTING REQUIREMENTS

For change reporting households, the worker must advise the client of his responsibility to report changes and the types of changes he must report.

FOR SIMPLIFIED REPORTING HOUSEHOLDS, THE WORKER MUST EXPLAIN THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REQUIREMENTS IN ACCORDANCE WITH, PART S, SIMPLIFIED REPORTING.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

There are no forms and instructions associated with this policy.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-800-FITAP-SNAP Changes Document No./Name C-810-SNAP Reporting Requirements Effective Date October 1, 2024

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY SIMPLIFIED REPORTING HOUSEHOLDS ARE REQUIRED TO REPORT IF ONE OF THE FOLLOWING CHANGES OCCURS AFTER THE APPLICATION INTERVIEW OR DURING THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD. THE CHANGE MUST BE REPORTED BY THE 10th OF THE MONTH FOLLOWING THE MONTH THE CHANGE OCCURED. IF THE 10TH DAY OF THE MONTH FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, TREAT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY AS THE 10th DAY. ● AN INCREASE IN INCOME THAT CAUSES THE HOUSEHOLD INCOME TO EXCEED 130% OF THE FEDERAL POVERTY LEVEL (FPL) FOR THE HOUSEHOLD SIZE. THIS INCLUDES THE INCOME OF NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS. Do not consider ineligible or disqualified persons in determining the household size. NOTE: A household that is exempt from the 130% of the FPL income eligibility standard that remains eligible after reporting income that exceeds the FPL has met the income reporting requirement until the next SR or redetermination, whichever comes first. Example 1: A household of two includes a mother and child. The father of the child, who has income, moves into the home. The client must report if the amount of all sources of income, including the income of the father, exceeds 130% of the FPL under which her household was certified. (In this situation that would be a household of two). Example 2: A household of two includes a 65-year-old man and his 63-year-old wife. The household has reported that the husband receives SSA benefits of $850 and his wife receives SSA benefits of $668. The income exceeds 130% of the FPL. The household’s income, with allowable shelter expenses, is below the net income level. The household has no further reporting requirements until the next recertification or SR, whichever comes first. Example 3: A household of two includes a 66-year-old man and his 64-year-old wife. The husband receives VA benefits of $750 and his wife receives SSA benefits of $325. The income does not exceed 130% of the FPL. During the certification period the household reports new unearned income in the amount of $600. A manual budget shows the total household income exceeds 130% of the FPL. However, after all allowable deductions, income is below the net income limit. The household remains eligible and has no further reporting requirements until the next recertification or SR, whichever comes first. ● Households that include an ABAWD must report changes in work or training hours of ABAWDS who are subject to the SNAP time limit if the change results in the ABAWD working or participating in training an average of less than 20 hours per week or 80 hours per month.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-800-FITAP-SNAP Changes Document No./Name C-820-FITAP Actions On Changes Effective Date September 1, 2022

1 of 12 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

C-821-FITAP - PO ACTION ON REPORTED CHANGES

CHANGES REPORTED AFTER THE APPLICATION INTERVIEW OR THE REDETERMINATION INTERVIEW OR AFTER A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED ARE CONSIDERED CHANGES OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS.

CHANGES ARE CONSIDERED VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT IF:

 THE CHANGE IS REPORTED BY OR RECEIVED DIRECTLY FROM THE SOURCE OF THE INFORMATION, AND

 THE INFORMATION IS NOT QUESTIONABLE AND DOES NOT REQUIRE FURTHER INFORMATION OR VERIFICATION.

EXAMPLES OF PRIMARY SOURCE OF THE INFORMATION INCLUDE:

o BENDEX OR SDX FROM THE SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION (SSA)

NOTE: ACTION ON INFORMATION FROM BENDEX OR SDX SHOULD BE TAKEN ONLY IF SSA IS THE PRIMARY SOURCE OF THE INFORMATION. (FOR EXAMPLE, INFORMATION REGARDING VA BENEFITS OR EARNED INCOME SHOWN ON SOLQ WOULD NOT BE CONSIDERED VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT SINCE THE INCOME SOURCE IS OTHER THAN SSA. INFORMATION ABOUT SSI FROM BENDEX OR SDX WOULD BE CONSIDERED VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT SINCE SSA IS THE SOURCE OF THIS INCOME.)

o SAVE FROM THE BUREAU OF CITIZENSHIP AND IMMIGRATION SERVICES (USCIS)

o UNEMPLOYMENT COMPENSATION BENEFITS VERIFIED BY THE LOUISIANA WORKFORCE COMMISSION (LWC) RECORDS

o LASES

o E&T NON-COMPLIANCE INFORMATION IS RECEIVED REGARDING ABAWD PARTICIPATION

o STEP non-compliance information received from STEP

o INTENTIONAL PROGRAM VIOLATION (IPV) DISQUALIFICATION DECISION RECEIVED FROM FRAUD AND RECOVERY

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-800-FITAP-SNAP Changes Document No./Name C-820-FITAP Actions On Changes Effective Date September 1, 2022

3 of 12

C-829-FITAP - PO MASS CHANGES

THE STATE OR FEDERAL GOVERNMENT INITIATES CHANGES THAT CAN AFFECT ALL OR A LARGE NUMBER OF CLIENTS.

MASS CHANGES WILL BE MADE WHEN THERE ARE CHANGES IN:

 COST-OF-LIVING ADJUSTMENTS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY, SSI, AND OTHER FEDERAL BENEFITS.

 ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA BASED ON LEGISLATIVE OR REGULATORY ACTIONS.

II. PROCEDURES

C-821-FITAP - PR ACTION ON REPORTED CHANGES

THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS MUST BE TAKEN WITHIN 10 DAYS WHEN CHANGES ARE REPORTED BY THE CLIENT, ANOTHER DEPARTMENT, ANOTHER PERSON, THE FRAUD HOTLINE, OR ANOTHER ENTITY WITHIN DCFS OUTSIDE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS (SEE S-110-SNAP/FITAP, REGARDING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS):

 DOCUMENT THE REPORTED CHANGE AND THE DATE OF THE REPORT.

 DETERMINE THE EFFECT OF THE REPORTED CHANGE ON THE HOUSEHOLD’S ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFITS BASED ON THE STATEMENT RECEIVED.

 IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS, FOLLOW PROCEDURES IN C-821-2-FITAP - PR.

 IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN A DECREASE IN BENEFITS, DO NOT REQUEST VERIFICATION OR TAKE ACTION TO REDUCE BENEFITS UNLESS: o THE HOUSEHOLD HAS VOLUNTARILY REQUESTED CLOSURE; o SUFFICIENT VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED; o THE CHANGE MEETS THE DEFINITION OF VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT. REFER TO C- 821-FITAP-PO; OR o The decrease is due to reported employment or self-employment income. A Request For Verification of the household’s income must be sent allowing the household 10 days to provide the requested verification and the verification must be received before an eligibility decision can be made on the case.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-800-FITAP-SNAP Changes Document No./Name C-820-FITAP Actions On Changes Effective Date September 1, 2022

4 of 12  WHEN A HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A CHANGE IN HOUSEHOLD COMPOSITION, REFER TO C- 840-FITAP.

 WHEN A HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS NOT DECEASED OR INCARCERATED, THAT HOUSEHOLD MEMBER MUST APPEAR IN PERSON AT A LOCAL DCFS OFFICE WITH VALID IDENTIFICATION TO PROVE THEY ARE NOT DECEASED OR INCARCERATED.

Change Reporting Households

Take action within 10 days to request necessary verification, make the changes and notify the household, if it is a change reporting household.

If the change reporting household does not provide verification by the due date given on the Request For Verification, send a Notice of Decision proposing closure.

Exception: Do not close the case if the missing verification is for a deductible expense. If there are other changes which have been verified, process the verified changes without allowing deductions for the unverified expenses.

C-821-1-FITAP - PR Changes Resulting in Ineligibility

IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN INELIGIBILITY DUE TO INCOME that equals or exceeds the flat grant amount for their household size, VERIFICATION OF THE HOUSEHOLD’S INCOME MUST BE REQUESTED IN WRITING AND RECEIVED BEFORE AN ELIGIBILITY DECISION CAN BE MADE ON THE CASE. SEND A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION ALLOWING THE HOUSEHOLD 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE THE REQUESTED VERIFICATION.

IF THE VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED BY THE DUE DATE, THE *** * APPLICATION MUST BE DENIED OR CLOSED ** FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION. A NOTICE OF DECISION MUST BE SENT ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD THAT THEIR *** * FITAP APPLICATION WAS DENIED OR CASE CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION.

IF THE VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED, BUDGET THE INCOME AND PROCESS THE CASE. IF THE INCOME equals or exceeds the flat grant amount for their household size, THE APPLICATION WILL BE DENIED OR THE ** CASE WILL BE CLOSED FOR REASON CODE “Failed Flat Grant Eligibility Test”. THE HOUSEHOLD MAY BE VERBALLY INFORMED THAT THE HOUSEHOLD’S REPORTED INCOME EXCEEDS *** * flat grant amount for their household size ** AND VERIFICATION OF THE INCOME MUST BE REQUESTED AND PROVIDED. IF THE HOUSEHOLD WISHES TO WITHDRAW THEIR APPLICATION, THE APPLICATION MUST BE DENIED WITH REASON CODE, “APPLICATION WITHDRAWN”.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-800-FITAP-SNAP Changes Document No./Name C-820-FITAP Actions On Changes Effective Date September 1, 2022

5 of 12 DOCUMENT THE CASE WITH A CASE NOTE INDICATING THAT THE HOUSEHOLD REQUESTED WITHDRAWAL OF THE APPLICATION AND ALL OTHER CASE ACTIVITY.

C-821-2-FITAP - PR Increasing Benefits

IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS, REQUEST VERIFICATION, IF NECESSARY. ALLOW THE HOUSEHOLD 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION. IF THE 10TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, THE DUE DATE BECOMES THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY.

 IF THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE THE MONTH AFTER THE CHANGE WAS REPORTED. AUTHORIZE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS IF NECESSARY. SEND CONCURRENT NOTICE.

 IF VERIFICATION IS NOT RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE, BUT IS LATER PROVIDED, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE THE MONTH AFTER THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED. SEND CONCURRENT NOTICE.

 IF THE HOUSEHOLD DOES NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION, DO NOT TAKE ACTION TO INCREASE BENEFITS. NO FURTHER ACTION WILL BE REQUIRED.

 A NOTE SHOULD BE INCLUDED IN THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION, THAT BENEFITS CANNOT BE INCREASED UNTIL THE VERIFICATION HAS BEEN PROVIDED.

IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS AND IS REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IN THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE REPORT MONTH, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE THE MONTH AFTER THE CHANGE IS REPORTED IF THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. AUTHORIZE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS, IF NECESSARY.

(SEE C-850-SNAP/FITAP FOR PROCEDURES TO DETERMINE IF THE FIRST MONTH BENEFITS ARE AFFECTED.)

A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION SHOULD NOT BE SENT TO REQUEST VERIFICATION FOR INFORMATION REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS CONSIDERED THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT. THE 5TH OF THE SR MONTH IS THE DUE DATE FOR THE REQUESTED VERIFICATION.

EXAMPLE: A JUNE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN THE OFFICE ON MAY 30. THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED CONTRIBUTIONS HAVE DECREASED FROM $350 PER MONTH TO $100 PER MONTH. NO VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED.

EXAMPLE 5: A MAY REDETERMINATION APPLICATION IS RECEIVED IN THE OFFICE ON APRIL 26 REPORTING A CHANGE THAT WILL RESULT IN A DECREASE IN BENEFITS. THE WORKER PROCESSES THE CASE IN THE REDETERMINATION MONTH ON MAY 15. THE CHANGE IS EFFECTIVE JUNE AND THE CASE IS RECERTIFIED EFFECTIVE JUNE.

C-821-3-FITAP - PR Information Insufficient to Determine Eligibility and Benefit Level

IF THE REPORTED INFORMATION IS INSUFFICIENT TO DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFIT LEVEL, DO NOT CLEAR INFORMATION ON SIEVS, LDET, THE WORK NUMBER, OR BENDEX. CONTACT THE HOUSEHOLD BY TELEPHONE TO DISCUSS THE REPORTED CHANGE. IF THE HOUSEHOLD CANNOT BE REACHED, *** * SEND A SEMI-AUTOMATED FFCCL - CLIENT CONTACT LETTER (18C-FF) IN LITE **, REQUESTING THAT THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACT THE DEPARTMENT TO DISCUSS THE REPORTED CHANGE. ALLOW TEN CALENDAR DAYS FOR THE HOUSEHOLD TO CONTACT THE DEPARTMENT. IF THE 10th DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, THE DUE DATE BECOMES THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACTS THE DEPARTMENT, OBTAIN THE INFORMATION NECESSARY TO DETERMINE THE EFFECT OF THE CHANGE ON THE BENEFITS.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD FAILS TO RESPOND TO THE ** * SEMI-AUTOMATED FFCCL - CLIENT CONTACT LETTER (18C-FF) ** OR REFUSED TO PROVIDE SUFFICIENT INFORMATION TO DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY OR BENEFIT LEVEL, SEND ADVANCE NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION TO CLOSE THE CASE.

C-822-FITAP - PR ADDRESS/NAME CHANGES

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A CHANGE OF ADDRESS OR NAME IN PERSON OR BY PHONE, ASK “DO YOU WANT YOUR CHANGE OF ADDRESS/NAME TO BE USED FOR VOTER REGISTRATION PURPOSES”?

IF A CLIENT REPORTS THE CHANGE IN PERSON, PROVIDE THE VOTER REGISTRATION DECLARATION STATEMENT – CHANGE OF ADDRESS/NAME (OFS 1VR) ALONG WITH THE ATTACHED LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION FOR THE CLIENT TO COMPLETE. IF THE OFS 1VR AND LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION ARE COMPLETED IN PERSON, ACCEPT THE COMPLETED FORMS. IF THE CLIENT RETURNS THE OFS 1VR INDICATING “YES” THEY WOULD LIKE ASSISTANCE WITH COMPLETING THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION, A WORKER SHALL ASSIST THE CLIENT WITH COMPLETING THE FORM UNLESS ASSISTANCE IS REFUSED. FILE ALL COMPLETED OFS 1VRs IN ONBASE AND RETAIN FOR AT LEAST 36 MONTHS. PROCESS THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION IN ACCORDANCE WITH CHAPTER 7, C-200.

IF, IN PERSON OR ON THE PHONE, THE CLIENT STATES “NO” THEY WOULD NOT LIKE TO CHANGE THEIR NAME OR ADDRESS FOR VOTER REGISTRATION PURPOSES, PROVIDE THE OFS 1VR ALONG WITH THE ATTACHED LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION TO THE CLIENT. HAVE THE CLIENT COMPLETE THE OFS 1VR. IF THE OFS 1VR IS RETURNED, FILE THE FORM IN ONBASE.

IF THE CHANGE OF ADDRESS OR NAME WAS PROVIDED THROUGH CAFÉ, BY PHONE, MAIL, FAX, OR EMAIL, PROVIDE THE OFS 1VR ALONG WITH THE ATTACHED LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION TO THE CLIENT. IF THE CLIENT RETURNS THE OFS 1VR INDICATING “YES” THEY NEED ASSISTANCE IN COMPLETING THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION, THE WORKER SHALL CONTACT THE CLIENT BY TELEPHONE AND PROVIDE THE REQUESTED ASSISTANCE. UPON RECEIPT, FILE ALL COMPLETED OFS 1VRs IN ONBASE AND RETAIN FOR AT LEAST 36 MONTHS. PROCESS THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION IN ACCORDANCE WITH CHAPTER 7, C-200.

IF THE PERSON DOES NOT WISH TO REGISTER OR DOES NOT CHECK A BOX ON THE OFS 1VR, THE PERSON IS CONSIDERED TO HAVE DECLINED TO REGISTER TO VOTE. IF A PERSON DOES NOT SIGN THE OFS 1VR, IT STILL MAY BE PROCESSED. THE WORKER MUST INDICATE IN THE COMMENT/REMARKS SECTION THAT THE PERSON REFUSED TO SIGN THE FORM. THE WORKER MUST DOCUMENT IN CAFÉ THAT THE DECLARATION FORM WAS PROVIDED.

REFER TO CHAPTER 7, C-200 FOR MORE INFORMATION ON VOTER REGISTRATION.

C-822-1-FITAP - PR Returned Mail

IF MAIL IS RETURNED FROM THE U.S. POSTAL SERVICE AS UNDELIVERABLE THAT INCLUDES A FORWARDING ADDRESS, CONTACT THE HOUSEHOLD TO CONFIRM THAT THE MAILING ADDRESS ON THE RETURNED MAIL IS CORRECT. NO OTHER QUESTIONS MUST BE ASKED. UPDATE * LITE ** WITH THE CORRECT MAILING ADDRESS. IF THE HOUSEHOLD CANNOT BE REACHED BY TELEPHONE, MAIL A *** * SEMI-AUTOMATED FFCCL - CLIENT CONTACT LETTER (18C-FF) TO THE FORWARDING ADDRESS REQUESTING THAT THE HOUSEHOLD CONTACT THE DEPARTMENT WITHIN 10 DAYS REGARDING THE RETURNED MAIL. IF THE HOUSEHOLD FAILS TO RESPOND BY THE DUE DATE AND THE SEMI- AUTOMATED FFCCL - CLIENT CONTACT LETTER (18C-FF) IS NOT RETURNED, UPDATE LITE ** WITH THE NEW FORWARDING MAILING ADDRESS. FOLLOW UP WITH THE HOUSEHOLD AT THE NEXT SR OR REDETERMINATION.

IF MAIL IS RETURNED FROM THE U.S. POSTAL SERVICE AS UNDELIVERABLE WITH NO FORWARDING ADDRESS, DOUBLE CHECK TO BE SURE THE ADDRESS IS CORRECT. IF THE ADDRESS IS CORRECT, NO ACTION IS REQUIRED. DO NOT CONTACT THE HOUSEHOLD REGARDING THE RETURNED MAIL. FOLLOW UP WITH THE HOUSEHOLD AT THE NEXT SR OR REDETERMINATION.

C-825-2-FITAP - PR Department of Corrections (DOC)

A MATCH WILL BE PERFORMED WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS THAT WILL IDENTIFY HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS WHO ARE INCARCERATED AND WHO ARE INCLUDED IN A SNAP CASE AND THE ASSOCIATED FITAP OR KCSP CASE. THIS WILL BE COMPLETED IN A WEEKLY BATCH PROCESS. INFORMATION RECEIVED FROM THE DOC MATCH IS CONSIDERED VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT.

LITE

IF A MEMBER HAS BEEN IDENTIFIED BY THE DOC MATCH AS BEING INCARCERATED, AN INTERFACE TASK WILL BE GENERATED. STAFF MUST ATTEMPT TO CONTACT THE CLIENT BY PHONE TO DISCUSS THE INCARCERATION TASK.

 IF THE WORKER IS ABLE TO REACH THE CLIENT:

o STEP 1 - OBTAIN THE FACILITY NAME, FACILITY PHONE NUMBER, INCARCERATION DATE AND RELEASE DATE, o STEP 2 - CONTACT THE FACILITY TO CONFIRM THE DATES PROVIDED BY THE CLIENT AND VERIFY THEY ARE NO LONGER INCARCERATED, o STEP 3 - MAKE A DETAILED CASE NOTE INCLUDING ALL THE INFORMATION OBTAINED AS WELL AS THE NAME OF THE PERSON SPOKEN TO, ETC, o STEP 4 - ONCE VERIFIED WITH THE FACILITY, UPDATE THE WORK ITEM FOR THE INTERFACE TASK TO A STATUS OF ‘COMPLETE’ IN LITE.

 IF THE WORKER IS UNABLE TO REACH THE CLIENT BY TELEPHONE:

o GENERATE A SEMI-AUTOMATED * FFCCL CLIENT CONTACT LETTER (18C-FF) ** *** IN THE CORRESPONDENCE MODULE OF LITE AND REQUEST THE CLIENT TO CONTACT THE AGENCY TO DISCUSS THEIR CASE WITHIN 10 DAYS.

o IF THE CLIENT CONTACTS THE AGENCY, FOLLOW STEPS 1-4 LISTED ABOVE.

C-825-5-FITAP - PR Fraud Hotline Reports

INFORMATION RECEIVED FROM THE FRAUD HOTLINE MUST BE INVESTIGATED. THE WORKER SHOULD CONTACT THE CLIENT REGARDING THE FRAUD HOTLINE REPORT. THIS SHOULD BE TREATED AS IF THE CLIENT HAD REPORTED THE CHANGE. A DECISION MUST BE MADE BASED UPON THE CLIENT’S STATEMENT AS THIS INFORMATION IS NOT CONSIDERED VERIFIED AT THIS POINT.

C-825-6-FITAP - PR Failure to Comply

IF THE REPORTED CHANGE IS A DECREASE, SUSPENSION, OR TERMINATION OF FITAP, KCSP, OR SSI BENEFITS DUE TO FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THAT PROGRAM’S REQUIREMENTS, DO NOT INCREASE SNAP BENEFITS. (SEE CHAPTER 4, E-400 SNAP, FOR PROCEDURES RELATED TO FAILURE TO COMPLY).

C-825-7-FITAP – PR Louisiana Department of Health (LDH)

THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILY SERVICES (DCFS) RECEIVES DAILY FILES FROM THE LOUISIANA DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH (LDH), LOUISIANA VITAL RECORDS REGISTRY (VRR) OF DECEASED INDIVIDUALS VIA LITE. DCFS RUNS A MATCH BETWEEN DECEASED INDIVIDUALS AND INDIVIDUALS WHO RECEIVE SNAP AND THE ASSOCIATED FITAP OR KCSP.

LITE WILL AUTOMATICALLY UPDATE THE CASE OF EACH DECEASED INDIVIDUAL REPORTED THROUGH THE MATCH, EXCLUDE THE MEMBER, SEND THE APPROPRIATE NOTICE TO THE HOUSEHOLD, IF REQUIRED, AND GENERATE AN AUTOMATED CASE NOTE IN LITE.

C-826-FITAP - PR RESERVED

C-827-FITAP - PR SHORTENING THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD

LITE may shorten a FITAP certification period in some instances to match the * SNAP ** certification period so that the FITAP redetermination will occur in the same month that the next SNAP Redetermination is due.

C-828-FITAP - PR CHANGES LEARNED OUTSIDE COURSE OF EMPLOYMENT

DO NOT INVESTIGATE OR ACT UPON A CHANGE LEARNED OUTSIDE THE COURSE OF EMPLOYMENT. A TASK SHOULD BE SET TO MAKE SURE THAT THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS THE CHANGE AT THE NEXT SR OR REDETERMINATION.

C-829-FITAP - PR MASS CHANGES

THE FOLLOWING PROCEDURES SHOULD BE FOLLOWED WHEN MASS CHANGES ARE MADE:

 THE AFFECTED HOUSEHOLD MUST BE SENT A CONCURRENT NOTICE.

 IF THE CLIENT APPEALS WITHIN 13 DAYS OF THIS NOTICE, BENEFITS ARE REINSTATED ONLY IF THE ISSUE IN THE APPEAL IS INDIVIDUAL ELIGIBILITY OR BENEFITS WERE IMPROPERLY COMPUTED.

 WHEN SUCH CHANGES OCCUR, THE DEPARTMENT MAY AUTOMATICALLY ADJUST ELIGIBILITY OR BENEFITS FOR CLIENTS. IN THIS SITUATION, NOTICES WILL BE SENT FROM STATE OFFICE.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-800 FITAP-SNAP Changes Document No./Name C-830-FITAP Adverse Action On Certified Cases Effective Date July 1, 2021

1 of 3 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

IN SOME ADVERSE ACTION SITUATIONS, THE CLIENT IS ENTITLED TO 13-DAY ADVANCE NOTICE. THIS PERIOD IS DETERMINED BY COUNTING 13 DAYS FROM THE DATE THE NOTICE IS MAILED, CONSIDERING THE DAY AFTER THE DATE THE NOTICE IS MAILED AS THE FIRST DAY. THE ACTION MUST NOT BE TAKEN DURING THE ADVANCE NOTICE PERIOD WHICH EXPIRES AT 4:30 P.M. ON THE 13TH DAY. IF THE 13TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, TREAT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY AS THE 13TH DAY. OTHER ADVERSE ACTIONS ARE EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY.

C-831-FITAP - PO ADVERSE ACTIONS THAT REQUIRE ADVANCE NOTICE

EXCEPT AS SPECIFIED IN C-832 BELOW, SEND 13-DAY ADVANCE NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION TO REDUCE BENEFITS OR CLOSE A CASE.

C-832-FITAP - PO ADVERSE ACTIONS THAT ARE EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY

IN THE FOLLOWING SITUATIONS, 13-DAY ADVANCE NOTICE IS NOT REQUIRED. A CONCURRENT NOTICE IS SENT TO THE CLIENT WHEN:

1. THE AGENCY DISQUALIFIES A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER BECAUSE OF AN INTENTIONAL PROGRAM VIOLATION AND THE BENEFITS OF THE REMAINING HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS ARE REDUCED OR ENDED BECAUSE OF THE DISQUALIFICATION. FORM FR 15A IS SENT BY THE FRAUD AND RECOVERY UNIT AND A CONCURRENT NOTICE OF REDUCTION IS SENT BY LITE.

2. THE WORKER REDUCES OR ENDS BENEFITS AT THE END OF A NORMAL PERIOD OF CERTIFICATION WHEN THE HOUSEHOLD TIMELY REAPPLIES.

3. A CLIENT HAS BEEN CERTIFIED IN ANOTHER STATE AND THAT FACT HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED.

4. THE CLIENT SIGNS A STATEMENT REQUESTING CLOSURE OR REDUCTION IN BENEFITS AND WAIVING THE RIGHT TO ADVANCE NOTICE.

5. BENEFITS ARE REDUCED OR TERMINATED EFFECTIVE THE MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH AS A RESULT OF CHANGES REPORTED THROUGH THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS.

EXCEPTION: ADVANCE NOTICE IS REQUIRED PRIOR TO IMPOSING A SANCTION FOR FLEEING FELON RESTRICTIONS, PROBATION/PAROLE VIOLATIONS, AND FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS, SUCH AS *** VOLUNTARY QUIT.

THE AGENCY RECEIVES A WRITTEN REPORT SIGNED BY THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD OR OTHER RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER WHICH PROVIDES SUFFICIENT INFORMATION FOR THE AGENCY TO DETERMINE THE HOUSEHOLD’S BENEFIT AMOUNT OR INELIGIBILITY. E-MAIL CORRESPONDENCE IS CONSIDERED A SIGNED, WRITTEN REPORT IF IT IS SENT BY THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD OR OTHER RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER FROM THE E-MAIL ADDRESS THAT THE HOUSEHOLD HAS PREVIOUSLY REPORTED AS THEIR E-MAIL ADDRESS.

7. MASS CHANGES.

8. The client’s whereabouts are unknown and agency mail directed to the client has been returned by the Post Office indicating no known forwarding address.

9. The agency has factual information confirming the death of the FITAP payee.

10. A child is removed from the home as a result of a judicial determination, or voluntarily placed in foster care by his legal guardian.

11. The client has been admitted or committed to an institution, or placed in skilled nursing care, intermediate care or long-term hospitalization.

12. The case is closed due to the amount of child support collected through CSE.

13. The client has been certified for Supplemental Security Income or Foster Care Payments Income and that fact has been established.

14. The grant is being reduced or closed because a child is being certified for KCSP.

C-833-FITAP – PO CONTINUATION OF BENEFITS AFTER AN APPEAL REQUEST

C-833-1-FITAP - PO Advance Notice of Adverse Action

DO NOT TAKE THE ACTION TO REDUCE OR TERMINATE BENEFITS IF THE CLIENT REQUESTS A FAIR HEARING DURING THE 13-DAY ADVANCE NOTICE PERIOD UNLESS THE HOUSEHOLD WAIVES ITS RIGHT TO CONTINUED BENEFITS. IF THE REQUEST FOR A FAIR HEARING IS SUBMITTED BY MAIL, IT MUST BE POSTMARKED BY THE 13TH DAY GIVEN ON THE NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD DOES NOT WAIVE ITS RIGHT TO CONTINUED BENEFITS, BENEFITS SHALL CONTINUE AT THE SAME LEVEL UNTIL THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD OR UNTIL THE RESOLUTION OF THE HEARING, WHICHEVER IS FIRST.

3 of 3 IF THE CLIENT REQUESTS A FAIR HEARING WITHIN 13 DAYS OF THE MAILING DATE OF A NOTICE WHICH WAS SENT CONCURRENT WITH THE ACTION, REINSTATE BENEFITS TO THE PREVIOUS LEVEL WITHIN 5 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF RECEIPT OF THE HOUSEHOLD'S REQUEST FOR A FAIR HEARING UNLESS THE CLIENT WAIVES HIS RIGHT TO CONTINUED BENEFITS. IF THE REQUEST FOR A FAIR HEARING IS SUBMITTED BY MAIL, IT MUST BE POSTMARKED BY THE 13TH DAY AFTER THE CONCURRENT NOTICE WAS SENT. IF THE 13TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, TREAT THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY AS THE 13TH DAY.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD DOES NOT WAIVE ITS RIGHT TO CONTINUED BENEFITS, BENEFITS WILL BE REINSTATED AT THE PRIOR LEVEL AND CONTINUE UNTIL THE END OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD OR UNTIL THE RESOLUTION OF THE HEARING, WHICHEVER IS FIRST.

THIS APPLIES IF ACTION WAS TAKEN TO REDUCE OR END BENEFITS BASED SOLELY ON WRITTEN INFORMATION FROM THE HOUSEHOLD.

NOTE: REINSTATEMENT OF BENEFITS IS NOT APPLICABLE FOR CHANGES OR CLOSURES MADE AT THE END OF A NORMAL PERIOD OF CERTIFICATION.

A Manual *** or Automated Notice of Decision *** may be sent.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name C – Case Processing Section No./Name C-800 FITAP-SNAP Changes Document No./Name C-840-FITAP Changes in Household Composition Effective Date July 1, 2021

1 of 5 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

FOR HOUSEHOLD COMPOSITION CHANGES REPORTED OUTSIDE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS, MAKE THE CHANGE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE TIMEFRAMES EXPLAINED IN C-841-FITAP-PR.

C-841-FITAP – PO ADDITION OF A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS AN ADDITIONAL HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, DETERMINE IF THE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS REQUIRED TO BE INCLUDED.

C-842-FITAP - PO REMOVAL OF A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER

WHEN A MEMBER OF THE HOUSEHOLD IS NO LONGER ELIGIBLE TO BE INCLUDED, THE PERSON SHOULD BE REMOVED EFFECTIVE THE FIRST POSSIBLE MONTH AFTER THE EXPIRATION OF ADVANCE NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION, IF APPROPRIATE. A CHANGE IN HOUSEHOLD COMPOSITION REPORTED BY A RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS CONSIDERED VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT, THEREFORE MUST BE ACTED UPON.

C-843-FITAP - PO PAYEE LEAVES THE HOME

* If the qualified relative payee leaves the home for any reason other than an allowable temporary absence, send appropriate notice and close the case. ** Another qualified relative may apply for benefits for the children.

For situations in which the payee can be changed to a third party, see E-320-FITAP.

II. PROCEDURES

C-841-FITAP - PR ADDITION OF A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER

At each addition of a household member:

● Determine if the household member is required to be included.

● Check the *** Clearance Summary for the new household member. Refer to C-220-FITAP.

● DOCUMENT ALL ACTIVITIES * AS A CASE NOTES IN LITE.

IF THE NEW MEMBER WAS NOT REPORTED ON THE CAFÉ SELF SERVICE PORTAL, DOCUMENT THE NEW MEMBER’S ELIGIBILITY AS A CASE NOTE ** OR COMPLETE THE ADDITION OF THE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER FORM OFS 12. THE REQUIRED INFORMATION MAY BE OBTAINED OVER THE TELEPHONE OR DURING A FACE-TO-FACE INTERVIEW.

Examples of Action Required for Household Composition Changes:

Example: The current household consists of a woman and her child. The woman got married and her husband, who has income, moves into the home. This is reported to the agency by a responsible household member. The agency must determine the new household size, the new gross income limit for the new household size, and if the household remains eligible.

A change in household composition reported by a responsible household member is considered verified upon receipt; therefore, he should be removed following expiration of Notice of Adverse Action.

Example: The client’s landlord, who is not a household member, reports that the client’s children are no longer living with the client. It is determined that removal of the children would result in a reduction in benefits. Action must not be taken because the change was not reported by a responsible household member. The change is not considered verified upon receipt.

Example: A household member is disqualified. When a household member is disqualified, the action must be taken, regardless of whether the benefits are reduced or the case closes. Disqualifications are actions that are required to be acted upon.

IF THE CHANGE RESULTS IN INELIGIBILITY OR DECREASED BENEFITS, THE CLOSURE OR REDUCTION SHALL BE EFFECTIVE THE EARLIEST POSSIBLE MONTH AFTER EXPIRATION OF ADVANCE NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION, IF REQUIRED.

IF THE CHANGE RESULTS IN INCREASED BENEFITS, THE INCREASE SHALL BE EFFECTIVE:

● THE MONTH AFTER THE ADDITION OF A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS REPORTED AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION AND THE NEW MEMBER IS NOT INCLUDED IN ANOTHER CERTIFIED CASE. IF THE NEW MEMBER IS INCLUDED IN ANOTHER CERTIFIED CASE, THE INCREASE SHALL BE EFFECTIVE THE FIRST MONTH THE NEW MEMBER IS REMOVED FROM THE OTHER CERTIFICATION.

● The month after *** the person complied when adding a person who was sanctioned for failure to comply with enumeration.

● The month after *** the person complied when adding a person who was sanctioned for failure to comply with parenting skills and immunizations to a KCSP case.

● THE MONTH AFTER *** THE CHANGE WAS REPORTED IF THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. ALLOW THE HOUSEHOLD 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION. IF THE 10TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, THE DUE DATE BECOMES THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY.

EXAMPLE 1: ON JUNE 6 A HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A $100 DECREASE IN INCOME WHICH OCCURRED ON MAY 30. VERIFICATION OF THE CHANGE IS RECEIVED ON JUNE 14. BENEFITS SHOULD BE INCREASED EFFECTIVE JULY.

EXAMPLE 2: ON JUNE 26 A HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A $100 DECREASE IN INCOME WHICH OCCURRED ON JUNE 20. VERIFICATION OF THE CHANGE IS RECEIVED ON JULY 5. BENEFITS SHOULD BE INCREASED EFFECTIVE JULY.

EXAMPLE 3: ON JUNE 27 A HOUSEHOLD REPORTS THE LOSS OF A JOB WHICH OCCURRED ON JUNE 26. VERIFICATION WAS REQUESTED ON JULY 1. THE VERIFICATION WAS RECEIVED WITH A DOCUMENT DATE OF JULY 10. BENEFITS SHOULD BE INCREASED EFFECTIVE JULY.

2 of 3 NOTE: INTERIM CHANGES REPORTED BY A SIMPLIFIED REPORTING HOUSEHOLD ARE CONSIDERED TIMELY REPORTS UNLESS THE HOUSEHOLD FAILS TO REPORT THAT INCOME EXCEEDED THE GROSS INCOME LIMIT FOR THE HOUSEHOLD SIZE WHICH WOULD HAVE RESULTED IN THE HOUSEHOLD'S INELIGIBILITY.

When a change which occurred in a prior month is not reported and verified timely by a change reporting household, determine whether supplemental benefits should be issued by determining the first month that benefits would have increased if the client had reported the change timely and provided verification by the due date. If benefits would have been increased effective the month in which verification is actually received, issue supplemental benefits. The amount of the supplement is the difference between the amount the client actually received and the amount the client could have received if the change had been reported and verified timely. Do not prorate based on the date the verification is received.

Example 1: On May 5 a household reports a $100 decrease in income which occurred on April 2. Verification of the change is received on May 10. Benefits should be increased effective May because May is the month the change would have been effective had it been reported and verified timely. Issue a supplement for May.

Example 2: On July 28 the household reports a decrease in income which occurred on June 15. Verification of the reported change was provided on August 2. If the household had timely reported and verified the change, benefits would have been increased effective July. Since verification was provided in August, a supplement should be issued for August.

CHANGES THAT RESULT IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS THAT ARE REPORTED AS A PART OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS IN THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE REPORT MONTH ARE EFFECTIVE THE MONTH AFTER THE CHANGE IS REPORTED IF THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. AUTHORIZE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS IF NECESSARY.

EXAMPLE 1: A CLIENT SUBMITS HER FEBRUARY SIMPLIFIED REPORT WHICH IS RECEIVED ON JANUARY 25. SHE REPORTS THAT SHE HAD A BABY ON DECEMBER 15 AND PROVIDED VERIFICATION THAT SHE HAD APPLIED FOR A SOCIAL SECURITY CARD. BENEFITS SHOULD BE INCREASED EFFECTIVE FEBRUARY. IF THE CHANGE IS NOT MADE PRIOR TO CUTOFF IN JANUARY, SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS WOULD BE ISSUED FOR FEBRUARY.

***

CHANGES THAT RESULT IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS THAT ARE REPORTED AS A PART OF THE REDETERMINATION PROCESS IN THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE REDETERMINATION MONTH ARE EFFECTIVE THE REDETERMINATION MONTH IF THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. AUTHORIZE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS IF NECESSARY.

C-821-SNAP - PO ACTION ON REPORTED CHANGES

CHANGES REPORTED AFTER THE APPLICATION INTERVIEW OR THE REDETERMINATION INTERVIEW OR AFTER A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED, ARE CONSIDERED CHANGES OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS.

CHANGES ARE CONSIDERED VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT IF:

• THE CHANGE IS REPORTED BY OR RECEIVED DIRECTLY FROM THE SOURCE OF THE INFORMATION, AND

• THE INFORMATION IS NOT QUESTIONABLE AND DOES NOT REQUIRE FURTHER INFORMATION OR VERIFICATION.

EXAMPLES OF PRIMARY SOURCE OF THE INFORMATION INCLUDE:

o BENDEX OR SDX FROM THE SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION (SSA)

NOTE: ACTION ON INFORMATION FROM BENDEX OR SDX SHOULD BE TAKEN ONLY IF SSA IS THE PRIMARY SOURCE OF THE INFORMATION. (FOR EXAMPLE, INFORMATION REGARDING VA BENEFITS OR EARNED INCOME SHOWN ON SOLQ WOULD NOT BE CONSIDERED VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT SINCE THE INCOME SOURCE IS OTHER THAN SSA. INFORMATION ABOUT SSI FROM BENDEX OR SDX WOULD BE CONSIDERED VERIFIED UPON RECEIPT SINCE SSA IS THE SOURCE OF THIS INCOME.)

o SAVE FROM THE BUREAU OF CITIZENSHIP AND IMMIGRATION SERVICES (USCIS)

o UNEMPLOYMENT COMPENSATION BENEFITS VERIFIED BY THE LOUISIANA WORKFORCE COMMISSION (LWC) RECORDS

o LASES

o E&T NON-COMPLIANCE INFORMATION IS RECEIVED REGARDING ABAWD PARTICIPATION

o INTENTIONAL PROGRAM VIOLATION (IPV) DISQUALIFICATION DECISION RECEIVED FROM FRAUD AND RECOVERY

o Notice of non-cooperation with Quality Control (QC) received from QC

C-827-SNAP - PO HOUSEHOLD ELIGIBLE FOR 36-MONTH CERTIFICATION PERIOD REPORTS A CHANGE IN CIRCUMSTANCES

If a household assigned a 36-month certification period under Elderly Simplified Application Project (ESAP) rules has a change in circumstances, the certification period must not be shortened. The case will remain open and a Simplified Report (SR) will be due every six months until the end of the certification period. THE STATE OR FEDERAL GOVERNMENT INITIATES CHANGES THAT CAN AFFECT ALL OR A LARGE NUMBER OF CLIENTS.

• COST-OF-LIVING ADJUSTMENTS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY, SSI, AND OTHER FEDERAL BENEFITS.

• ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA BASED ON LEGISLATIVE OR REGULATORY ACTIONS.

II. PROCEDURES

C-821-SNAP - PR ACTION ON REPORTED CHANGES

For changes reported on LaCAP cases, follow procedures in K-510-LaCAP.

THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS MUST BE TAKEN WITHIN 10 DAYS WHEN CHANGES ARE REPORTED BY THE CLIENT, ANOTHER DEPARTMENT, ANOTHER PERSON, THE FRAUD HOTLINE, OR ANOTHER ENTITY WITHIN LDH OUTSIDE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS (SEE S-110-SNAP/FITAP, REGARDING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS):

• DOCUMENT THE REPORTED CHANGE AND THE DATE OF THE REPORT.

• DETERMINE THE EFFECT OF THE REPORTED CHANGE ON THE HOUSEHOLD’S ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFITS BASED ON THE STATEMENT RECEIVED.

Do not ask questions about other changes that were not reported. Do not clear information on SIEVS, BENDEX, LWC or Experian based on the reported change. Do not request verification unless it is needed to increase benefits.

If it is not obvious whether the reported change will result in an increase or decrease, a manual budget will be necessary. The form SNAP 1W, SNAP Application Worksheet, and the Basis of Issuance Tables in Chapter 4, Section J, can be used for this process. A copy of the budget calculations must be retained in document repository system as documentation of the action taken on the change.

• IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS, FOLLOW PROCEDURES IN C-821-2-SNAP-PR.

• IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN A DECREASE IN BENEFITS do not request verification or take action to reduce benefits unless:

o An ABAWD, subject to the SNAP time limit, is no longer meeting the ABAWD work requirement and/or no longer eligible to receive benefits;

• If the change does not affect the household’s eligibility or benefits, notify the household that the change did not affect the allotment. If the household did not report the change a notice to the household is not required.

• WHEN A HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A CHANGE IN HOUSEHOLD COMPOSITION, REFER TO C-840-SNAP.

• WHEN A HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS NOT DECEASED OR INCARCERATED, THAT HOUSEHOLD MEMBER MUST APPEAR IN PERSON AT A LOCAL LDH OFFICE WITH VALID IDENTIFICATION TO PROVE THEY ARE NOT DECEASED OR INCARCERATED.

C-821-1-SNAP - PR Changes Resulting in Ineligibility

IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN INELIGIBILITY DUE TO INCOME EXCEEDING 130% OF THE FEDERAL POVERTY LEVEL FOR THE HOUSEHOLD’S SIZE, VERIFICATION OF THE HOUSEHOLD’S INCOME MUST BE REQUESTED IN WRITING AND RECEIVED BEFORE AN ELIGIBILITY DECISION CAN BE MADE ON THE CASE. SEND A REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION ALLOWING THE HOUSEHOLD 10 DAYS TO PROVIDE THE REQUESTED VERIFICATION.

IF THE VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED BY THE DUE DATE, THE APPLICATION MUST BE DENIED OR CASE CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION. A NOTICE OF DECISION MUST BE SENT ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD THAT THEIR SNAP APPLICATION WAS DENIED OR CASE CLOSED FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION.

IF THE VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED, BUDGET THE INCOME AND PROCESS THE CASE. IF THE INCOME EXCEEDS 130% OF THE FEDERAL POVERTY LEVEL FOR THE HOUSEHOLD’S SIZE, THE APPLICATION WILL BE DENIED OR THE CASE WILL BE CLOSED FOR REASON CODE “FAILED GROSS INCOME TEST”. THE HOUSEHOLD MAY BE VERBALLY INFORMED THAT THE HOUSEHOLD’S REPORTED INCOME EXCEEDS 130% OF THE FEDERAL POVERTY LIMIT FOR THE HOUSEHOLD’S SIZE AND VERIFICATION OF THE INCOME MUST BE REQUESTED AND PROVIDED. IF THE HOUSEHOLD WISHES TO WITHDRAW THEIR APPLICATION, THE APPLICATION MUST BE DENIED WITH REASON CODE, “APPLICATION WITHDRAWN”.
