II. PROCEDURES

WHEN A CASE IS ENTERING SIMPLIFIED REPORTING THE WORKER MUST EXPLAIN THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REQUIREMENTS.

EXPLAIN:

● THAT THE HOUSEHOLD WILL BE CERTIFIED FOR 12 OR 24 MONTHS AND WILL BE REQUIRED TO SUBMIT A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AT THE MIDPOINT OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, ● IF CERTIFIED FOR A 24-MONTH SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD AND THE HOUSEHOLD LOSES THEIR ELIGIBILITY FOR A 24-MONTH SNAP CERTIFICATION PERIOD, A SIMPLIFIED REPORT WILL BE REQUIRED EVERY 6 MONTHS, ● * IF CERTIFIED UNDER SNAP ESAP RULES, COMPLETING AN SR IS NOT REQUIRED, ● IF THE HOUSEHOLD LOST ELIGIBILITY FOR SNAP ESAP, A SIMPLIFIED REPORT WILL BE REQUIRED EVERY 6 MONTHS, ** ● THAT A SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM (OFS 4SR) WILL BE MAILED THE MONTH BEFORE THE REPORT IS DUE TO THE HEAD OF THE SNAP HOUSEHOLD NOTIFYING THE HOUSEHOLD TO COMPLETE THEIR SIMPLIFIED REPORT ONLINE, COMPLETE, SIGN, AND RETURN A PAPER SIMPLIFIED REPORT, OR CALL TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT OVER THE TELEPHONE, ● WHAT MUST BE REPORTED AND WHAT VERIFICATION MUST BE SUBMITTED WITH THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, ● HOW TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT ONLINE, HOW TO REQUEST A PAPER SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM, AND HOW TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT OVER THE TELEPHONE,

S-311-SNAP ENTERING SIMPLIFIED REPORTING AT CERTIFICATION AND REDETERMINATION

For households entering SR at certification or redetermination, the report month will be at the mid- point of the certification period, with the exception of Elderly Simplified Application Project (ESAP) households. Refer to the chart in section S-312-SNAP.

Example 1: A household with earned income is certified effective January with a redetermination date of December. The Simplified Report date will be June.

Example 2: A household is redetermined in January. The new certification period is February through January of the next year. The Simplified Report date will be July.

***

ESAP eligible households are * assigned a 36-month certification period and are ** not required to complete a Simplified Report. Households that lose eligibility under ESAP rules will be required to submit a Simplified Report every 6 months.

2 of 3 II. PROCEDURES

WHEN A CASE IS ENTERING SIMPLIFIED REPORTING THE WORKER MUST EXPLAIN THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REQUIREMENTS.

EXPLAIN:

• THAT THE HOUSEHOLD WILL BE CERTIFIED FOR 12 OR * 36 ** MONTHS, *** • * IF CERTIFIED FOR A 12-MONTH CERTIFICATION PERIOD, THE HOUSEHOLD WILL BE REQUIRED TO SUBMIT A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AT THE MIDPOINT OF THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD, ** *** • IF CERTIFIED UNDER ESAP RULES, * THE HOUSEHOLD WILL BE CERTIFIED FOR A 36- MONTH CERTIFICATION, AND COMPLETING AN SR IS NOT REQUIRED, • IF THE HOUSEHOLD LOST ELIGIBILITY FOR ESAP, A SIMPLIFIED REPORT WILL BE REQUIRED EVERY 6 MONTHS, • THAT THE ** SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM (OFS 4SR) WILL BE MAILED THE MONTH BEFORE THE REPORT IS DUE TO THE HEAD OF THE SNAP HOUSEHOLD NOTIFIYING THE HOUSEHOLD TO COMPLETE THEIR SIMPLIFIED REPORT ONLINE, COMPLETE, SIGN, AND RETURN A PAPER SIMPLIFIED REPORT, OR CALL TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT OVER THE TELEPHONE. • WHAT MUST BE REPORTED AND WHAT VERIFICATION MUST BE SUBMITTED WITH THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, • HOW TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT ONLINE, HOW TO REQUEST A PAPER SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM, AND HOW TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT OVER THE TELEPHONE. • THAT FAILURE TO RETURN THE COMPLETED SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND PROVIDE REQUIRED VERIFICATION WILL RESULT IN CASE CLOSURE, if they are the head of the SNAP household, AND • THAT THE HOUSEHOLD IS REQUIRED TO REPORT IF THERE IS A CHANGE IN THE HOUSEHOLD'S TOTAL MONTHLY INCOME WHICH RESULTS IN THE HOUSEHOLD'S INCOME EXCEEDING 130% OF THE FEDERAL POVERTY LEVEL FOR THEIR HOUSEHOLD SIZE. THIS INCLUDES REPORTING THE INCOME OF A PERSON WHO MOVES INTO THE HOME IF THEIR INCOME COMBINED WITH THE CURRENT SNAP HOUSEHOLD’S INCOME EXCEEDS MORE THAN 130% OF THE FEDERAL POVERTY LEVEL FOR THEIR HOUSEHOLD. HOUSEHOLDS ARE NOTIFIED OF THE AMOUNT FOR THEIR HOUSEHOLD ON THE AUTOMATED NOTICE OF DECISION SENT CONCERNING EACH CASE ACTION. OTHER CHANGES NEED NOT BE REPORTED UNTIL THE NEXT REDETERMINATION OR SIMPLIFIED REPORT DATE, WHICHEVER OCCURS EARLIER.

1 of 9 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A CHANGE OF ADDRESS ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, DETERMINE IF THE HOUSEHOLD WANTS TO CHANGE THE ADDRESS FOR VOTER REGISTRATION PURPOSES. REFER TO CHAPTER 7, C-220 FOR MORE INFORMATION ON VOTER REGISTRATION.

DETERMINE WHETHER THE REPORT IS COMPLETE BASED ON VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS LISTED BELOW AND POLICY S-510-FITAP.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS AN INTERIM CHANGE * OR AN NDNH HIT WAS RECEIVED OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS AND ACTION WAS NOT TAKEN TO PROCESS THE CHANGE AND THE HOUSEHOLD DID NOT REPORT THE CHANGE ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, THE CHANGE MUST BE REVIEWED AND DISCUSSED WITH THE HOUSEHOLD WHEN COMPLETING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. CASE NOTES MUST BE REVIEWED TO DETERMINE IF AN INTERIM CHANGE OR JOB REPORTED AS AN NDNH HIT NEEDS TO BE PROCESSED. **

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES THAT THEY WERE NOT REQUIRED TO REPORT AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT, ACTION MUST BE TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGES. FOR EXAMPLE, THE CLIENT REPORTED A CHANGE IN SHELTER EXPENSES EVEN THOUGH THEY DID NOT CHANGE RESIDENCES, OR THE CLIENT REPORTED THAT A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS NOW A STUDENT. ACTION MUST BE TAKEN AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT TO PROCESS THESE REPORTED CHANGES.

MAKE NECESSARY CHANGES TO THE CASE BASED ON INFORMATION REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

S-411-FITAP - PO FORMS USED IN LIEU OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM

A COMPLETED APPLICATION (OFS 4APP OR OFS 4MR) OR ONLINE APPLICATION FOR SNAP, FITAP, OR KCSP MAY BE ACCEPTED IN PLACE OF A SIMPLIFIED REPORT, AS LONG AS THE CASE IS ACTIVE WHEN THE APPLICATION IS SUBMITTED. AN INTERVIEW IS NOT REQUIRED.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD APPLIES OR SUBMITS A REDETERMINATION APPLICATION FOR FITAP OR KCSP BY THE 12TH CALENDAR DAY OF THE SNAP SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH OR WITHIN TWO WEEKS PRIOR TO THE REPORT MONTH AND FAILS TO SUBMIT THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT FOR REVIEW OF THE SNAP CASE, USE THE APPLICATION SUBMITTED TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT PROCESS. DOCUMENT THE ACTIVITY BY ENTERING A CASE NOTE TO INDICATE THAT AN APPLICATION OR REDETERMINATION APPLICATION WAS USED IN THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT PROCESS RATHER THAN THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

2 of 9 IF AN APPLICATION IS RECEIVED IN AN OFFICE OTHER THAN WHERE THE ACTIVE CASE IS BEING PROCESSED FOR SIMPLIFIED REPORT, THE APPLICATION ASSIGNMENT MUST BE ROUTED TO THE WORKER WHO IS ASSIGNED THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT SO THAT THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MAY BE PROCESSED. DOCUMENT WHO THE APPLICATION WAS ROUTED TO BY ENTERING A CASE NOTE.

S-412-FITAP - PO VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR PROCESSING AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT ARE THE SAME AS WHEN A SNAP HOUSEHOLD REPORTS AN INTERIM CHANGE. HOWEVER, ACTION ON THE CHANGES REPORTED IS DIFFERENT THAN ACTION ON AN INTERIM CHANGE.

● IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS AND IS REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IN THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE REPORT MONTH, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE THE MONTH AFTER THE CHANGE IS REPORTED IF THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. AUTHORIZE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS, IF NECESSARY.

(SEE C-850-SNAP/FITAP FOR PROCEDURES TO DETERMINE THE FIRST MONTH BENEFITS ARE AFFECTED).

AN OFS 18C SHOULD NOT BE SENT TO REQUEST VERIFICATION FOR INFORMATION REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. THE *** SIMPLIFIED REPORT * FORM (OFS 4SR) IS CONSIDERED THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT. THE 5TH OF THE SR MONTH IS THE DUE DATE FOR THE REQUESTED VERIFICATION.

EXAMPLE: A JUNE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN THE OFFICE ON MAY 30TH. THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED CONTRIBUTIONS HAVE DECREASED FROM $350 PER MONTH TO $100 PER MONTH. NO VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED.

● IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN MAY AND VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED IN MAY OR NO LATER THAN JUNE 5TH, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE JULY. ISSUE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS FOR JUNE.

● IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN MAY AND VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED IN JUNE, BUT AFTER THE 5TH OF THE MONTH, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE JULY. NO SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS ARE ISSUED FOR JUNE.

● IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN MAY AND VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, DO NOT REQUEST VERIFICATION. THE $350 CONTRIBUTIONS WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

● IF THE CHANGE WILL RESULT IN DECREASED SNAP BENEFITS, THE HOUSEHOLD’S STATEMENT MAY BE USED TO TAKE ACTION ON THE REPORTED CHANGE.

3 of 9 Note: For work eligible FITAP households included in Simplified Reporting, these households must comply with their Family Success Agreement requirements and action must be taken in accordance with change processing procedures as defined in C-820 FITAP/SNAP, C-830 FITAP/SNAP, and C-840 FITAP/SNAP.

The following examples are for those households who are identified as Simplified Reporting households who are not work eligible and do not have a Family Success Agreement.

AN OFS 13SI MUST NOT BE SENT:

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS AN INCREASE IN PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED INCOME AND DOES NOT PROVIDE THE VERIFICATION. USE THE HOUSEHOLD'S STATEMENT TO BUDGET THE INCREASE IN INCOME.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT WORKS AT SHOE STATION AND REPORTS THAT SHE HAD AN INCREASE IN HER WAGES BY $200 A MONTH. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. SINCE THIS EMPLOYMENT WAS PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED AND WILL RESULT IN A DECREASE IN BENEFITS, NO REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION IS NEEDED. USE THE CLIENT’S STATEMENT TO BUDGET THE INCREASE.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A DECREASE IN PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED INCOME AND DOES NOT PROVIDE THE VERIFICATION. NO ACTION IS TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGE. THE INCOME CURRENTLY BUDGETED WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT HER MOTHER NOW GIVES HER CONTRIBUTIONS OF $150 PER MONTH INSTEAD OF $250 PER MONTH. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. SINCE THE CONTRIBUTIONS WERE PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, NO REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION IS NEEDED. CONTINUE TO BUDGET THE $250 PER MONTH IN CONTRIBUTIONS.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS THE TERMINATION OF A JOB, IS EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS, AND DOES NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION, NO ACTION IS TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGE. THE INCOME CURRENTLY BUDGETED WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT HAS A TWO-YEAR OLD CHILD AND REPORTS THAT SHE LOST HER JOB AND DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION. DO NOT REQUEST VERIFICATION. CONTINUE TO BUDGET THE PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED EARNINGS.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS LEGALLY OBLIGATED CHILD SUPPORT PAYMENTS HAVE DECREASED AND DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION, USE THE HOUSEHOLD’S STATEMENT TO BUDGET THE DECREASE IN PAYMENTS.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A NEW SOURCE OF INCOME, SUCH AS A NEW JOB OR NEW UNEARNED INCOME, AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS A NEW JOB AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND DOES NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION. SINCE THIS IS A NEW SOURCE AND NOT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, VERIFICATION IS NEEDED TO PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

● IF THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY SHOWS WAGES ON LWC QUARTERLY WAGE (LDET) AND THE HOUSEHOLD DID NOT REPORT THE JOB ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT SUBMITS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND DOES NOT REPORT EMPLOYMENT. REVIEW OF THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY INDICATES NEW EMPLOYMENT WITH WENDY’S. SINCE THIS IS A NEW SOURCE OF INCOME AND NOT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, VERIFICATION IS NEEDED TO PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

● IF THE NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS REPORTED AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND VERIFICATION IS NEEDED FOR THE NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED. THE HOUSEHOLD MUST BE CONTACTED TO DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY FOR THE NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER AND ADDITIONAL QUESTIONS MUST BE ASKED. THE OFS 12 (ADDITION OF A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER FORM) SHOULD BE USED AS A GUIDE FOR ASKING QUESTIONS ABOUT THE NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT HER BROTHER MOVED IN THE HOME. THE CLIENT REPORTED EARNINGS FOR HER BROTHER AND DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION. THE CLIENT MUST BE CONTACTED TO DISCUSS THE NEW MEMBER’S ELIGIBILITY. VERIFICATION OF THE BROTHER’S INCOME MUST BE REQUESTED. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS MULTIPLE CHANGES AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, OR THE INFORMATION PROVIDED IS INSUFFICIENT TO DETERMINE CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY OR BENEFIT LEVEL.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT, WHO IS EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION, REPORTED THE TERMINATION OF A JOB. THE CLIENT ALSO REPORTED RECEIVING CONTRIBUTIONS FROM HER MOTHER. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. THE BENEFIT LEVEL CANNOT BE DETERMINED WITHOUT THE VERIFICATION. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

S-412-1-FITAP - PO Multiple Changes

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS MULTIPLE CHANGES AND PROVIDES SOME BUT NOT ALL OF THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION, DETERMINE IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MAY BE PROCESSED USING THE HOUSEHOLD’S STATEMENT AND VERIFIED INFORMATION.

● IF THE UNVERIFIED CHANGE RESULTS IN INCREASED SNAP BENEFITS, VERIFICATION IS REQUIRED TO PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

● IF THE UNVERIFIED CHANGE RESULTS IN DECREASED SNAP BENEFITS AND INCOME WAS PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, USE THE HOUSEHOLD’S STATEMENT TO PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT WHO IS EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS REPORTS THE TERMINATION OF A JOB. THE CLIENT ALSO REPORTS RECEIVING AN INCREASE IN THE AMOUNT OF CONTRIBUTIONS FROM HER MOTHER. SHE PROVIDES PROOF THAT SHE IS NO LONGER WORKING BUT DID NOT VERIFY THE INCREASE IN CONTRIBUTIONS. SINCE THE JOB LOSS WAS VERIFIED AND CONTRIBUTIONS FROM HER MOTHER WERE PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, WE CAN TAKE THE CLIENT'S STATEMENT ABOUT THE NEW AMOUNT OF CONTRIBUTIONS AND PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT WHO IS EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS REPORTS THE TERMINATION OF A JOB. THE CLIENT ALSO REPORTS THAT SHE STARTED RECEIVING CONTRIBUTIONS FROM HER MOTHER. SHE VERIFIED THE JOB LOSS BUT NOT THE NEW SOURCE OF INCOME (CONTRIBUTIONS). AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT TO REQUEST VERIFICATION OF CONTRIBUTIONS SINCE THEY WERE NOT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS A DECREASE IN WAGES AND AN INCREASE IN CHILD SUPPORT INCOME RECEIVED (NOT ON LASES), WHICH WAS PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED. VERIFICATION OF THE DECREASED WAGES WAS PROVIDED BUT NOT THE INCREASE IN

S-413-FITAP - PO COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT NOT RECEIVED

IF A COMPLETE REPORT IS NOT RECEIVED BY THE DEADLINE ON THE *** * OFS 4SR ** , A REMINDER NOTICE MUST BE SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD. AN AUTOMATED SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REMINDER NOTICE (OFS 13SN) WILL BE SENT TO HOUSEHOLDS THAT HAVE NOT SUBMITTED A SIMPLIFIED REPORT BY THE DUE DATE ON THE *** * OFS 4SR **. IF THE HEAD OF THE SNAP HOUSEHOLD IS THE PAYEE FOR THE FITAP OR KCSP CASE, THE FITAP OR KCSP CASE WILL ALSO BE CLOSED.

A MANUAL OR SEMI-AUTOMATED SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REMINDER NOTICE OF INCOMPLETE FILING (OFS 13SI) MUST BE SENT TO HOUSEHOLDS THAT SUBMITTED AN INCOMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT TO INFORM THE HOUSEHOLD OF WHAT INFORMATION IS NEEDED TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. THE DUE DATE MUST BE COMPLETED ALLOWING THE HOUSEHOLD 10-DAYS TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION. IF THE 10TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, THE DUE DATE WOULD BE THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY.

II. PROCEDURES

IF THE CHANGE OF ADDRESS OR NAME WAS PROVIDED THROUGH CAFÉ SSP, BY PHONE, MAIL, FAX, OR EMAIL, PROVIDE THE OFS 1VR ALONG WITH THE ATTACHED LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION TO THE CLIENT. IF THE CLIENT RETURNS THE OFS 1VR INDICATING “YES” THEY NEED ASSISTANCE IN COMPLETING THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION, THE WORKER SHALL CONTACT THE CLIENT BY TELEPHONE AND PROVIDE THE REQUESTED ASSISTANCE. UPON RECEIPT, FILE ALL COMPLETED OFS 1VRs IN ONBASE AND RETAIN FOR AT LEAST 36 MONTHS.

IF THE APPLICANT RETURNS THE FORM LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION TO THE PARISH OFFICE:

● REVIEW THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION FOR LEGIBILITY AND COMPLETENESS.

● VERIFY THAT THE APPLICANT SIGNED THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION IN THE APPROPRIATE BOX.

● PROVIDE ASSISTANCE WITH COMPLETING THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION UNLESS ASSISTANCE IS REFUSED.

● COMPLETE THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION LOCATED AT THE BOTTOM OF THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION UNDER “OFFICIAL USE ONLY”:

● MAIL THE COMPLETED LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION FORM TO THE APPROPRIATE PARISH REGISTRAR OF VOTERS OFFICE.

COMPLETE THE FOLLOWING ACTION IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS COMPLETE:

● CHECK THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY FOR ALL HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS. WHEN THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY INTERFACE STATUS CHANGES TO COMPLETE, CLEAR ALL HITS ACCORDING TO POLICY IN C-220-FITAP.

● DOCUMENT ALL ACTIVITY IN LITE.

● FILE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM, IF SUBMITTED MANUALLY, IN ONBASE.

● MAKE NECESSARY CHANGES TO THE CASE BASED ON INFORMATION REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

● RUN ELIGIBILITY AND AUTHORIZE THE CASE. IF BENEFITS DO NOT CHANGE OR NO CHANGES WERE REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, ELIGIBILITY MUST STILL BE RAN AND THE CASE MUST STILL BE AUTHORIZED.

● SEND CONCURRENT NOTICE IF REQUIRED. CONCURRENT NOTICE MUST BE SENT IF BENEFITS CHANGE AS A RESULT OF INFORMATION REPORTED THROUGH THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS. A NOTICE IS NOT REQUIRED IF BENEFITS DO NOT CHANGE.

EXCEPTION: ADVANCE NOTICE IS REQUIRED PRIOR TO IMPOSING A SANCTION FOR FLEEING FELON RESTRICTIONS, PROBATION/PAROLE VIOLATIONS, AND FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS, SUCH AS STEP OR VOLUNTARY QUIT.

1 of 10 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A CHANGE OF ADDRESS ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, DETERMINE IF THE HOUSEHOLD WANTS TO CHANGE THE ADDRESS FOR VOTER REGISTRATION PURPOSES. REFER TO CHAPTER 7, C-220 FOR MORE INFORMATION ON VOTER REGISTRATION.

If the household reports a change of residential address, they must also report any resulting changes in shelter costs.

IF A HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A CHANGE IN SHELTER EXPENSE, THEY MUST PROVIDE VERIFICATION OF THE EXPENSE.

DETERMINE WHETHER THE REPORT IS COMPLETE BASED ON VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS LISTED BELOW AND POLICY S-510-SNAP.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS AN INTERIM CHANGE OR A NATIONAL DIRECTORY OF NEW HIRE (NDNH) HIT WAS RECEIVED OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS AND ACTION WAS NOT TAKEN TO PROCESS THE CHANGE AND THE HOUSEHOLD DID NOT REPORT THE CHANGE ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, THE CHANGE MUST BE REVIEWED AND DISCUSSED WITH THE HOUSEHOLD WHEN COMPLETING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. CASE NOTES MUST BE REVIEWED TO DETERMINE IF AN INTERIM CHANGE OR JOB REPORTED AS AN NDNH HIT NEEDS TO BE PROCESSED.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES THAT THEY WERE NOT REQUIRED TO REPORT AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT, ACTION MUST BE TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGES. FOR EXAMPLE, THE CLIENT REPORTED A CHANGE IN SHELTER EXPENSES EVEN THOUGH THEY DID NOT CHANGE RESIDENCES, OR THE CLIENT REPORTED THAT A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS NOW A STUDENT. ACTION MUST BE TAKEN AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT TO PROCESS THESE REPORTED CHANGES.

MAKE NECESSARY CHANGES TO THE CASE BASED ON INFORMATION REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

S-411-SNAP - PO FORMS USED IN LIEU OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM

A COMPLETED APPLICATION (OFS 4APP OR OFS 4MR) OR ONLINE APPLICATION FOR SNAP, FITAP, OR KCSP MAY BE ACCEPTED IN PLACE OF A SIMPLIFIED REPORT, AS LONG AS THE CASE IS ACTIVE WHEN THE APPLICATION IS SUBMITTED. AN INTERVIEW IS NOT REQUIRED.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD APPLIES OR SUBMITS A REDETERMINATION APPLICATION FOR FITAP OR KCSP BY THE 12TH CALENDAR DAY OF THE SNAP SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH OR WITHIN TWO WEEKS PRIOR TO THE REPORT MONTH AND FAILS TO SUBMIT THE

2 of 10 SIMPLIFIED REPORT FOR REVIEW OF THE SNAP CASE, USE THE APPLICATION SUBMITTED TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT PROCESS. DOCUMENT THE ACTIVITY BY ENTERING A CASE NOTE TO INDICATE THAT AN APPLICATION OR REDETERMINATION APPLICATION WAS USED IN THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT PROCESS RATHER THAN THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

IF AN APPLICATION IS RECEIVED IN AN OFFICE OTHER THAN WHERE THE ACTIVE CASE IS BEING PROCESSED FOR SIMPLIFIED REPORT, THE APPLICATION ASSIGNMENT MUST BE ROUTED TO THE WORKER WHO IS ASSIGNED THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT SO THAT THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MAY BE PROCESSED. DOCUMENT WHO THE APPLICATION WAS ROUTED TO BY ENTERING A CASE NOTE.

S-412-SNAP - PO VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR PROCESSING AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT ARE THE SAME AS WHEN A SNAP HOUSEHOLD REPORTS AN INTERIM CHANGE. HOWEVER, ACTION ON THE CHANGES REPORTED IS DIFFERENT THAN ACTION ON AN INTERIM CHANGE.

● IF THE REPORTED CHANGE RESULTS IN AN INCREASE IN BENEFITS AND IS REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IN THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE REPORT MONTH, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE THE MONTH AFTER THE CHANGE IS REPORTED IF THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY THE DUE DATE GIVEN ON THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION. AUTHORIZE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS, IF NECESSARY.

(SEE C-850-SNAP/FITAP FOR PROCEDURES TO DETERMINE THE FIRST MONTH BENEFITS ARE AFFECTED).

AN OFS 18C SHOULD NOT BE SENT TO REQUEST VERIFICATION FOR INFORMATION REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM (OFS 4SR) IS CONSIDERED THE REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT. THE 5TH OF THE SR MONTH IS THE DUE DATE FOR THE REQUESTED VERIFICATION.

EXAMPLE: A JUNE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN THE OFFICE ON MAY 30TH. THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED CONTRIBUTIONS HAVE DECREASED FROM $350 PER MONTH TO $100 PER MONTH. NO VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED.

● IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN MAY AND VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED IN MAY OR NO LATER THAN JUNE 5TH, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE JULY. ISSUE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS FOR JUNE.

● IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN MAY AND VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED IN JUNE, BUT AFTER THE 5TH OF THE MONTH, INCREASE BENEFITS EFFECTIVE JULY. NO SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS ARE ISSUED FOR JUNE.

3 of 10 ● IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED IN MAY AND VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, DO NOT REQUEST VERIFICATION. THE $350 CONTRIBUTIONS WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

● IF THE CHANGE WILL RESULT IN DECREASED SNAP BENEFITS, THE HOUSEHOLD’S STATEMENT MAY BE USED TO TAKE ACTION ON THE REPORTED CHANGE.

AN OFS 13SI MUST NOT BE SENT:

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS AN INCREASE IN PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED INCOME AND DOES NOT PROVIDE THE VERIFICATION. USE THE HOUSEHOLD'S STATEMENT TO BUDGET THE INCREASE IN INCOME.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT WORKS AT SHOE STATION AND REPORTS THAT SHE HAD AN INCREASE IN HER WAGES BY $200 A MONTH. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. SINCE THIS EMPLOYMENT WAS PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED AND WILL RESULT IN A DECREASE IN BENEFITS, NO REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION IS NEEDED. USE THE CLIENT’S STATEMENT TO BUDGET THE INCREASE.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A DECREASE IN PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED INCOME AND DOES NOT PROVIDE THE VERIFICATION. NO ACTION IS TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGE. THE INCOME CURRENTLY BUDGETED WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT HER MOTHER NOW GIVES HER CONTRIBUTIONS OF $150 PER MONTH INSTEAD OF $250 PER MONTH. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. SINCE THE CONTRIBUTIONS WERE PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, NO REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION IS NEEDED. CONTINUE TO BUDGET THE $250 PER MONTH IN CONTRIBUTIONS.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS THE TERMINATION OF A JOB, IS EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS, AND DOES NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION, NO ACTION IS TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGE. THE INCOME CURRENTLY BUDGETED WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT HAS A TWO-YEAR OLD CHILD AND REPORTS THAT SHE LOST HER JOB AND DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION. DO NOT REQUEST VERIFICATION. CONTINUE TO BUDGET THE PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED EARNINGS.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS LEGALLY OBLIGATED CHILD SUPPORT PAYMENTS HAVE DECREASED AND DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION, USE THE HOUSEHOLD’S STATEMENT TO BUDGET THE DECREASE IN PAYMENTS.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT HIS LEGALLY OBLIGATED CHILD SUPPORT PAYMENTS HAVE DECREASED BY $100 PER MONTH. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED.

4 of 10 SINCE NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED, USE THE CLIENT’S STATEMENT TO BUDGET THE $100 DECREASE IN THE LEGALLY OBLIGATED CHILD SUPPORT PAYMENT.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS LEGALLY OBLIGATED CHILD SUPPORT PAYMENTS HAVE INCREASED AND DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION, NO ACTION IS TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGE. THE EXPENSE CURRENTLY BUDGETED WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT HIS LEGALLY OBLIGATED CHILD SUPPORT PAYMENTS HAVE INCREASED BY $100 PER MONTH. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. SINCE NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED, NO ACTION IS TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGE. THE LEGALLY OBLIGATED CHILD SUPPORT CURRENTLY BUDGETED WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A DECREASE IN PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED INCOME ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IN THE MONTH PRIOR TO THE REPORT MONTH AND DOES NOT PROVIDE THE VERIFICATION. NO ACTION IS TAKEN ON THE REPORTED CHANGE. THE INCOME CURRENTLY BUDGETED WILL CONTINUE TO BE BUDGETED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT’S JUNE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS RECEIVED ON MAY 30TH. THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT HER AUNT NOW GIVES HER CONTRIBUTIONS OF $100 PER MONTH INSTEAD OF $350 PER MONTH. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. SINCE THE CONTRIBUTIONS WERE PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, NO REQUEST FOR VERIFICATION IS NEEDED. CONTINUE TO BUDGET THE $350 PER MONTH CONTRIBUTIONS.

NOTE: IF THE VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED BY JUNE 5TH, ISSUE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS FOR JUNE. IF VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED IN JUNE BUT AFTER THE 5TH OF THE MONTH, DO NOT ISSUE SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS FOR JUNE.

THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT SHOULD BE PROCESSED WITHOUT VERIFICATION WHEN THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A CHANGE AS OUTLINED ABOVE.

AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT:

● IF A JOB LOSS IS REPORTED BY SOMEONE WHO IS NOT EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS, AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED. VOLUNTARY QUIT MUST BE EXPLORED AND VERIFIED.

EXAMPLE: A SINGLE PERSON HOUSEHOLD WHICH IS NOT EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS REPORTED THE LOSS OF A JOB AND DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION. VOLUNTARY QUIT MUST BE EXPLORED TO DETERMINE CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY FOR THE HOUSEHOLD. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

5 of 10 ● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A NEW SOURCE OF INCOME, SUCH AS A NEW JOB OR NEW UNEARNED INCOME, AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS A NEW JOB AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND DOES NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION. SINCE THIS IS A NEW SOURCE AND NOT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, VERIFICATION IS NEEDED TO PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

● IF THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY SHOWS WAGES ON LWC QUARTERLY WAGE (LDET) AND THE HOUSEHOLD DID NOT REPORT THE JOB ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT SUBMITS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND DOES NOT REPORT EMPLOYMENT. REVIEW OF THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY INDICATES NEW EMPLOYMENT WITH WENDY’S. SINCE THIS IS A NEW SOURCE OF INCOME AND NOT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, VERIFICATION IS NEEDED TO PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

● IF THE NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER IS REPORTED AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND VERIFICATION IS NEEDED FOR THE NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED. THE HOUSEHOLD MUST BE CONTACTED TO DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY FOR THE NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER AND ADDITIONAL QUESTIONS MUST BE ASKED. THE OFS 12 (ADDITION OF A HOUSEHOLD MEMBER FORM) SHOULD BE USED AS A GUIDE FOR ASKING QUESTIONS ABOUT THE NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBER.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS THAT HER BROTHER MOVED IN THE HOME. THE CLIENT REPORTED EARNINGS FOR HER BROTHER AND DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION. THE CLIENT MUST BE CONTACTED TO DISCUSS THE NEW MEMBER’S ELIGIBILITY. VERIFICATION OF THE BROTHER’S INCOME MUST BE REQUESTED. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS MULTIPLE CHANGES AND THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS NOT PROVIDED, OR THE INFORMATION PROVIDED IS INSUFFICIENT TO DETERMINE CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY OR BENEFIT LEVEL.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT, WHO IS EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION, REPORTED THE TERMINATION OF A JOB. THE CLIENT ALSO REPORTED RECEIVING CONTRIBUTIONS FROM HER MOTHER. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. THE BENEFIT LEVEL CANNOT BE DETERMINED WITHOUT THE VERIFICATION. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS A DECREASE IN WAGES AND AN INCREASE IN THE AMOUNT OF CHILD SUPPORT RECEIVED DIRECTLY FROM THE FATHER. NO VERIFICATION WAS PROVIDED. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

6 of 10 EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS A NEW JOB AND PROVIDES ONLY ONE CHECK STUB. NOT ENOUGH INFORMATION IS PROVIDED TO DETERMINE BENEFIT LEVEL. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS A CHANGE IN SHELTER EXPENSES AND DOES NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION OF THE EXPENSES.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS HE IS NOW PAYING $500 PER MONTH RENT BUT DID NOT PROVIDE VERIFICATION. AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT.

WHEN AN OFS 13SI IS REQUIRED TO REQUEST VERIFICATION, THE FORM MUST LIST THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION AND MUST ADVISE THE CLIENT THAT THE INFORMATION MUST BE SUBMITTED NO LATER THAN THE DUE DATE ON THE OFS 13SI (CUTOFF).

S-412-1-SNAP - PO Multiple Changes

IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTS MULTIPLE CHANGES AND PROVIDES SOME BUT NOT ALL OF THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION, DETERMINE IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MAY BE PROCESSED USING THE HOUSEHOLD’S STATEMENT AND VERIFIED INFORMATION.

● IF THE UNVERIFIED CHANGE RESULTS IN INCREASED SNAP BENEFITS, VERIFICATION IS REQUIRED TO PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

● IF THE UNVERIFIED CHANGE RESULTS IN DECREASED SNAP BENEFITS AND INCOME WAS PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, USE THE HOUSEHOLD’S STATEMENT TO PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT, WHO IS EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS, REPORTS THE TERMINATION OF A JOB. THE CLIENT ALSO REPORTS RECEIVING AN INCREASE IN THE AMOUNT OF CONTRIBUTIONS FROM HER MOTHER. SHE PROVIDES PROOF THAT SHE IS NO LONGER WORKING BUT DID NOT VERIFY THE INCREASE IN CONTRIBUTIONS. SINCE THE JOB LOSS WAS VERIFIED AND CONTRIBUTIONS FROM HER MOTHER WERE PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED, WE CAN TAKE THE CLIENT'S STATEMENT ABOUT THE NEW AMOUNT OF CONTRIBUTIONS AND PROCESS THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT WHO IS EXEMPT FROM WORK REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS REPORTS THE TERMINATION OF A JOB. THE CLIENT ALSO REPORTS THAT SHE STARTED RECEIVING CONTRIBUTIONS FROM HER MOTHER. SHE VERIFIED THE JOB LOSS BUT NOT THE NEW SOURCE OF INCOME (CONTRIBUTIONS). AN OFS 13SI MUST BE SENT TO REQUEST VERIFICATION OF CONTRIBUTIONS SINCE THEY WERE NOT PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED.

7 of 10 EXAMPLE: THE CLIENT REPORTS A DECREASE IN WAGES AND AN INCREASE IN CHILD SUPPORT INCOME RECEIVED (NOT ON LASES), WHICH WAS PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED. VERIFICATION OF THE DECREASED WAGES WAS PROVIDED BUT NOT THE INCREASE IN CHILD SUPPORT INCOME. USE THE CLIENT’S STATEMENT TO BUDGET THE INCREASE IN CHILD SUPPORT INCOME SINCE IT WAS PREVIOUSLY VERIFIED.

S-413-SNAP - PO COMPLETE REPORT NOT RECEIVED

IF A COMPLETE REPORT IS NOT RECEIVED BY THE DEADLINE ON THE OFS 4SR, A REMINDER NOTICE MUST BE SENT TO THE HOUSEHOLD. AN AUTOMATED SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REMINDER NOTICE (OFS 13SN) WILL BE SENT TO HOUSEHOLDS THAT HAVE NOT SUBMITTED A SIMPLIFIED REPORT BY THE DUE DATE ON THE OFS 4SR. IF THE HEAD OF THE SNAP HOUSEHOLD IS THE PAYEE FOR THE FITAP OR KCSP CASE, THE FITAP OR KCSP CASE WILL ALSO BE CLOSED.

A MANUAL OR SEMI-AUTOMATED SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REMINDER NOTICE OF INCOMPLETE FILING (OFS 13SI) MUST BE SENT TO HOUSEHOLDS THAT SUBMITTED AN INCOMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT TO INFORM THE HOUSEHOLD OF WHAT INFORMATION IS NEEDED TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. THE DUE DATE MUST BE COMPLETED ALLOWING THE HOUSEHOLD 10-DAYS TO PROVIDE VERIFICATION. IF THE 10TH DAY FALLS ON A WEEKEND OR HOLIDAY, THE DUE DATE WOULD BE THE FOLLOWING WORKDAY.

II. PROCEDURES

IF THE CHANGE OF ADDRESS OR NAME WAS PROVIDED THROUGH CAFÉ SSP, BY PHONE, MAIL, FAX, OR EMAIL, PROVIDE THE OFS 1VR ALONG WITH THE ATTACHED LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION TO THE CLIENT. IF THE CLIENT RETURNS THE OFS 1VR INDICATING “YES” THEY NEED ASSISTANCE IN COMPLETING THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION, THE WORKER SHALL CONTACT THE CLIENT BY TELEPHONE AND PROVIDE THE REQUESTED ASSISTANCE. UPON RECEIPT, FILE ALL COMPLETED OFS 1VRs IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY SYSTEM AND RETAIN FOR AT LEAST 36 MONTHS.

IF THE APPLICANT RETURNS THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION TO THE PARISH OFFICE:

● REVIEW THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION FOR LEGIBILITY AND COMPLETENESS.

● VERIFY THAT THE APPLICANT SIGNED THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION IN THE APPROPRIATE BOX.

● PROVIDE ASSISTANCE WITH COMPLETING THE LOUISIANA VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATION UNLESS ASSISTANCE IS REFUSED.

● RUN ELIGIBILITY AND AUTHORIZE THE CASE. IF BENEFITS DO NOT CHANGE OR NO CHANGES WERE REPORTED ON THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, ELIGIBILITY MUST STILL BE RUN AND THE CASE MUST STILL BE AUTHORIZED.

EXCEPTION: ADVANCE NOTICE IS REQUIRED PRIOR TO IMPOSING A SANCTION FOR FLEEING FELON RESTRICTIONS, PROBATION/PAROLE VIOLATIONS, Adults convicted of certain felonies as stated in E-221-1 SNAP-PO, AND FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS, SUCH AS STEP OR VOLUNTARY QUIT.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name S – Simplified Reporting Section No./Name S-500-FITAP-SNAP Complete Reports Document No./Name S-510-FITAP Complete Reports Effective Date January 15, 2018

1 of 2 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

A COMPLETE OFS 4SR – SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM INCLUDES:

● NEW ADDRESS IF THE CLIENT HAS MOVED.

● IF NEW HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS ARE REPORTED, THEIR BIRTH DATE, SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER, RELATIONSHIP TO THE HEAD OF HOUSEHOLD, AND CITIZENSHIP INFORMATION MUST ALSO BE REPORTED.

● THE NAMES OF ANY HOUSEHOLD MEMBERS WHO HAVE DIED OR LEFT THE HOME SINCE THE LAST DEPARTMENT CONTACT.

● INDICATION OF WHETHER THE AMOUNT OF INCOME FROM A JOB HAS CHANGED BY MORE THAN $100 PER MONTH FOR ANY HOUSEHOLD MEMBER.

● A REPORT THAT A NEW JOB HAS STARTED OR A JOB TERMINATED AND VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED.

● INDICATION OF WHETHER THE AMOUNT OF UNEARNED INCOME HAS CHANGED BY MORE THAN * $100 ** PER MONTH FOR ANY HOUSEHOLD MEMBER.

● A NEW SOURCE OF UNEARNED INCOME AND VERIFICATION IS PROVIDED.

● INDICATION OF A CHANGE IN THE AMOUNT OF LEGALLY OBLIGATED CHILD SUPPORT.

● IF THE HOUSEHOLD REPORTED AN INTERIM CHANGE OUTSIDE OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORTING PROCESS AND ACTION WAS NOT TAKEN TO PROCESS THE CHANGE, THE CHANGE MUST BE REVIEWED AND DISCUSSED WITH THE HOUSEHOLD WHEN COMPLETING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT.

● APPROPRIATE SIGNATURES (SIGNATURE OF THE HEAD OF THE HOUSEHOLD, OTHER RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLD MEMBER OR THE AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE).

NOTE: IF A SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM IS RECEIVED AND INCLUDES THE APPROPRIATE SIGNATURE BUT DOES NOT CONTAIN RESPONSES TO THE QUESTIONS ON THE FORM, THE AGENCY SHALL CONSIDER THIS A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND THE CLIENT HAS NO CHANGES TO REPORT. HOWEVER, IF THERE IS A HIT ON THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY, THE HIT MUST BE CLEARED BEFORE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS CONSIDERED COMPLETE.

1 of 5 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

DO NOT CONSIDER A SIMPLIFIED REPORT COMPLETE IF:

● IT DOES NOT HAVE APPROPRIATE SIGNATURES,

● IT IS NOT ACCOMPANIED BY REQUIRED VERIFICATION,

● INFORMATION PROVIDED IS QUESTIONABLE OR IS NOT SUFFICIENT TO ESTABLISH ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFIT LEVEL,

● MULTIPLE CHANGES ARE REPORTED OR ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFIT LEVEL CANNOT BE DETERMINED WITHOUT THE INFORMATION/VERIFICATION, OR

● ELIGIBILITY AND/OR BENEFIT LEVEL CANNOT BE DETERMINED WITHOUT THE INFORMATION/VERIFICATION.

NOTE: DO NOT CONSIDER THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT INCOMPLETE IF INELIGIBILITY CAN BE ESTABLISHED BASED ON INFORMATION PROVIDED.

S-611-FITAP - PO UNSIGNED SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORMS

IF A PAPER SIMPLIFIED REPORT FORM IS RETURNED BY THE HOUSEHOLD BUT IS NOT SIGNED, A MANUAL SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REMINDER NOTICE OF INCOMPLETE FILING OFS 13SI AND THE OFS 4SR THAT THE CLIENT COMPLETED MUST BE SENT INFORMING THE HOUSEHOLD THAT THE FORM MUST BE SIGNED AND RETURNED NO LATER THAN THE DUE DATE ON THE OFS 13SI. THE WORKER MUST FOLLOW THE STEPS PROVIDED IN S-611- FITAP-PR TO RETURN THE PAPER SIMPLIFIED REPORT TO THE HOUSEHOLD FOR SIGNATURE. THE OFS 13SI INFORMS THE CLIENT THAT THEY MAY ALSO SIGN THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT OVER THE TELEPHONE BY CALLING * 1-888-LAHELPU (888-524-3578), ** MONDAY – FRIDAY, 8:00 AM-2:00 PM AND SPEAKING WITH A WORKER.

SIMPLIFIED REPORTS SUBMITTED THROUGH THE CAFÉ SELF SERVICE PORTAL (SSP) ARE CONSIDERED TO BE SIGNED.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD SUBMITS A PAPER SIMPLIFED REPORT, IT MUST BE REGISTERED IN LITE.

S-612-FITAP - PO MISSING VERIFICATION

IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS SUBMITTED WITHOUT THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION AND ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFIT LEVEL CANNOT BE DETERMINED WITHOUT THE VERIFICATION, THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS INCOMPLETE. SEND A MANUAL OR SEMI-AUTOMATED SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REMINDER NOTICE OF INCOMPLETE FILING (OFS 13SI)

S-612-1-FITAP - PO Simplified Report Received After OFS 13SN Sent

S-613-FITAP - PO REPORT WITH QUESTIONABLE/INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION

WHEN A SIMPLIFIED REPORT CONTAINS QUESTIONABLE INFORMATION OR LACKS SUFFICIENT INFORMATION TO DETERMINE THE HOUSEHOLD’S CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCE, SEND A MANUAL OR SEMI-AUTOMATED SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REMINDER NOTICE OF INCOMPLETE FILING (OFS 13SI) NO LATER THAN THE 12TH CALENDAR DAY OF THE REPORT MONTH ADVISING THE HOUSEHOLD WHAT INFORMATION IS NEEDED AND THAT IT MUST BE SUBMITTED NO LATER THAN THE DUE DATE ON THE OFS 13SI.

 CLICK ON ‘OTHERS’ IN THE TOP NAVIGATION AND SELECT ‘CORRESPONDENCE’,  CLICK ON THE GENERATE SEMI-AUTOMATED SUB-TAB AND ENTER THE CASE ID AND CLICK ‘SEARCH’,

IF THE HOUSEHOLD SUBMITS A PAPER SIMPLIFED REPORT, THE WORKER MUST REGISTER THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT. TO REGISTER A PAPER SIMPLIFIED REPORT:

 CLICK ON ‘OTHERS’ IN THE TOP NAVIGATION,  SELECT ‘REDETERMINATION/SIMPLIFIED REPORTING’,  SELECT THE REGISTER SIMPLIFIED REPORTS SUB-TAB,  ENTER THE ‘FORM RECEIVED DATE’,  ENTER THE CASE ID, AND  CLICK THE ‘ASSIGN TO ROUND ROBIN’ BUTTON.

NOTE: IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT BELONGS TO A SPECIFIC WORKER, WAIT 15 MINUTES AND THEN REQUEST THAT A SUPERVISOR REASSIGN THE SIMPLIFED REPORT TO THE APPROPRIATE WORKER.

S-612-FITAP - PR MISSING VERIFICATION

IF THE CLIENT SUBMITS A SIMPLIFIED REPORT WITHOUT REQUIRED VERIFICATION, SEND A MANUAL OR SEMI-AUTOMATED SIMPLIFIED REPORTING REMINDER NOTICE OF INCOMPLETE FILING (OFS 13SI) REQUESTING THE REQUIRED VERIFICATION AND ADVISING THE CLIENT THAT THE INFORMATION MUST BE SUBMITTED NO LATER THAN THE DUE DATE ON THE OFS 13SI. 1 of 5 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

S-711-FITAP – PO CASE CLOSURE

LITE WILL GENERATE AN AUTOMATED REMINDER NOTICE (OFS 13SN) ON THE 12TH * OF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH TO REMIND THE HOUSEHOLD THAT THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT (SR) HAS NOT BEEN RECEIVED. THE OFS 13SN REMINDS THE HOUSEHOLD TO PROVIDE A COMPLETED AND SIGNED SIMPLIFIED REPORT OR TO SUBMIT A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IN LITE OR OVER THE TELEPHONE AND PROVIDE ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION WITHIN 10 DAYS. ** *** THE CASE WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY CLOSED ON THE SECOND TO LAST DAY (CUT OFF) OF THE SR MONTH IF THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT IS NOT RECEIVED.

NOTE: SINCE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT WAS NOT RECEIVED, NO ACTION WOULD NEED TO BE TAKEN ON THE CLEARANCE SUMMARY AS THE WORKER WILL NOT NAVIGATE TO DATA COLLECTIONS IN LITE.

IF ALL ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS ARE MET, REOPEN THE CASE ONLY IF A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION ARE RECEIVED BY THE LAST DAY OF THE CALENDAR MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH.

S-712-FITAP PO REINSTATEMENT AFTER CLOSURE FOR FAILURE TO SUBMIT A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT

IF A HOUSEHOLD PROVIDES A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, AS DEFINED IN S-510- FITAP, (INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION), AFTER CLOSURE BUT DURING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH OR IN THE CALENDAR MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH, BENEFITS WILL BE REINSTATED. THE REINSTATEMENT DATE IS THE DATE THE COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION IS RECEIVED. IF THE REINSTATEMENT DATE IS DURING THE MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH, BENEFITS WILL BE PRORATED.

EXAMPLE: MR. SMITH’S SNAP CASE WAS CERTIFIED FROM SEPTEMBER THROUGH AUGUST WITH A SIMPLIFIED REPORT DUE IN FEBRUARY. MR. SMITH’S CASE CLOSED ON CUTOFF FOR FAILURE TO TURN IN THE VERIFICATION NEEDED TO COMPLETE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT PROCESS. ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION WAS RECEIVED ON FEBRUARY 28. THE CASE IS REINSTATED EFFECTIVE FEBRUARY 28. THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD OF SEPTEMBER THROUGH AUGUST REMAINS THE SAME. BENEFITS ARE NOT PRORATED FOR MARCH.

IF THE ACCOMPANYING FITAP OR KCSP CASE CLOSED AS A RESULT OF FAILURE TO PROVIDE A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, AND THE SNAP CASE IS REINSTATED, THE FITAP OR KCSP CASE MUST ALSO BE REINSTATED.

IF A HOUSEHOLD PROVIDES A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, (INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION), AFTER CLOSURE BUT DURING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH OR IN THE CALENDAR MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH, AND LATER SUBMITS AN APPLICATION (EITHER MANUAL OR ONLINE), TAKE THE FOLLOWING ACTION:

● PROCESS THE CASE AS A REINSTATEMENT USING THE COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION PROVIDED BY THE CLIENT. THE NEW APPLICATION MUST BE REVIEWED TO DETERMINE IF THERE ARE ANY CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES SINCE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND VERIFICATION WAS SUBMITTED. IF THERE ARE CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES, A REVIEW OF CURRENT HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES MUST BE COMPLETED WITH THE HOUSEHOLD. IF ADDITIONAL INFORMATION WAS SUBMITTED WITH THE APPLICATION, IT MUST BE USED TO DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFIT LEVEL WHEN REINSTATING THE CASE. RECEIPT OF THE APPLICATION MUST BE DOCUMENTED.

● THE CLIENT MUST BE ADVISED THAT THE CASE WILL BE REINSTATED BACK TO THE DATE THE COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION WAS RECEIVED AND THAT A NEW APPLICATION WAS NOT REQUIRED.

ADDITIONAL CLEARANCES SHALL NOT BE COMPLETED WHEN REINSTATING THE HOUSEHOLD’S ELIGIBILITY. CLEARANCES RUN AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT SHALL BE USED TO DETERMINE CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD SUBMITS A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION AFTER THE LAST DAY OF THE CALENDAR MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH, ADVISE THE HOUSEHOLD TO REAPPLY.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD SUBMITS AN APPLICATION AFTER CASE CLOSURE FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, ACCEPT THE APPLICATION AND PROCESS IN ACCORDANCE WITH APPLICATION PROCESSING POLICY AT C-600-SNAP-FITAP. THE APPLICATION MAY NOT BE USED TO REINSTATE BENEFITS.

THE CASES ARE REINSTATED EFFECTIVE MARCH 10. THE CERTIFICATION PERIOD OF SEPTEMBER THROUGH AUGUST REMAINS THE SAME. BENEFITS ARE PRORATED FOR MARCH.

THE CASE MUST BE PROCESSED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THE REINSTATEMENT DATE. THE ORIGINAL CERTIFICATION PERIOD REMAINS THE SAME.

II. PROCEDURES

S-711-SNAP - PR CASE CLOSURE

IF ALL ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS ARE MET, REOPEN THE CASE ONLY IF A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION ARE RECEIVED BY THE LAST DAY OF THE CALENDAR MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH.

S-712-SNAP – PR REINSTATEMENT AFTER CLOSURE FOR FAILURE TO SUBMIT A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT

IF A HOUSEHOLD SUBMITS:

 A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, AND  ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATIONS ARE RECEIVED BY THE LAST DAY OF THE CALENDAR MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH, THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MAY BE REINSTATED. TAKE THE FOLLOWING ACTION IN LITE:

o CLICK ON ‘START WORK ITEM’, o SELECT SIMPLIFIED REPORT FROM THE DROPDOWN FOR “WHAT ACTION DO YOU WANT TO PERFORM?” AND CLICK THE ‘NEXT’ BUTTON, o CLICK ON BLUE ARROWS IN THE LEFT NAVIGATION AND SELECT PROGRAM REQUEST, o CLICK ON THE PENCIL ICON FOR THE PROGRAM, o SELECT REINSTATEMENT FOR ‘TYPE OF ACTION’, o SELECT ‘REINSTATEMENT AT SR’ FOR REINSTATE/REVERT TO OPEN REASON o ENTER THE DATE THE SR WAS RECEIVED FOR REINSTATEMENT/REVERT TO OPEN DATE AND CLICK THE ‘NEXT’ BUTTON, o NAVIGATE THROUGH DATA COLLECTION UPDATING ANY INFORMATION THAT NEEDS TO BE UPDATED, o CLICK ON THE ‘RUN EDBC’ BUTTON TO RUN ELIGIBILTY AND, AUTHORIZE THE CASE.

NOTE: CLEARANCE SUMMARY MUST BE CLEARED BEFORE THE CASE IS AUTHORIZED.

IF A HOUSEHOLD PROVIDES A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, (INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION), AFTER CLOSURE BUT DURING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH OR IN THE CALENDAR MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH, AND LATER SUBMITS AN APPLICATION (EITHER MANUAL OR ONLINE), TAKE THE FOLLOWING ACTION:

 PROCESS THE CASE AS A REINSTATEMENT USING THE COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION PROVIDED BY THE CLIENT. THE NEW APPLICATION MUST BE REVIEWED TO DETERMINE IF THERE ARE ANY CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES SINCE THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT AND VERIFICATION WAS SUBMITTED. IF THERE ARE CHANGES IN HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES, A REVIEW OF CURRENT HOUSEHOLD CIRCUMSTANCES MUST BE COMPLETED WITH THE HOUSEHOLD. IF ADDITIONAL INFORMATION WAS SUBMITTED WITH THE APPLICATION, IT MUST BE USED TO DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY AND BENEFIT LEVEL WHEN REINSTATING THE CASE. RECEIPT OF THE APPLICATION MUST BE DOCUMENTED.

 THE CLIENT MUST BE ADVISED THAT THE CASE WILL BE REINSTATED BACK TO THE DATE THE COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION WAS RECEIVED AND THAT A NEW APPLICATION WAS NOT REQUIRED.

ADDITIONAL CLEARANCES SHALL NOT BE COMPLETED WHEN REINSTATING THE HOUSEHOLD’S ELIGIBILITY. CLEARANCES RUN AT SIMPLIFIED REPORT SHALL BE USED TO DETERMINE CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD SUBMITS A COMPLETE REPORT INCLUDING ALL REQUIRED VERIFICATION AFTER THE LAST DAY OF THE CALENDAR MONTH FOLLOWING THE SIMPLIFIED REPORT MONTH, ADVISE THE HOUSEHOLD TO REAPPLY.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD SUBMITS AN APPLICATION AFTER CASE CLOSURE FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE A COMPLETE SIMPLIFIED REPORT, ACCEPT THE APPLICATION AND PROCESS IN ACCORDANCE WITH APPLICATION PROCESSING POLICY C-600-SNAP-FITAP. THE APPLICATION MAY NOT BE USED TO REINSTATE BENEFITS.

Division/Section Family Support Chapter No./Name 4 – Economic Stability (ES) Part No./Name S − Simplified Reporting Section No./Name S-800-SNAP Forms and Notices Document No./Name S-810-SNAP Forms and Notices Effective Date May 1, 2022

1 of 1 I. STATEMENT OF POLICY

The following forms and notices are used in the Simplified Reporting process:

● OFS 4SR, Simplified Report: The Simplified Report advises the household of the due date for returning the form and consequences for failure to submit a Simplified Report. The Simplified Report is * system-generated. ** *** ● OFS 13SN, Simplified Reporting Reminder Notice: The reminder notice informs the household that a complete Simplified Report has not been received. The notice provides a due date for when the Simplified Report and verification should be submitted.

● OFS 13SI, Simplified Reporting Reminder Notice of Incomplete Filing: The semi-automated or manual notice of incomplete filing is used to request verification or additional information.

● OFS 13SO, Simplified Reporting System Notice: The automated notice is mailed to households included in Simplified Reporting to inform them of reporting requirements. A manual notice will be sent to the household if required.

***

The forms listed above are also available in Spanish and Vietnamese. The appropriate version must be used when the household reports that no one in the household understands English and the household needs communication in Spanish or Vietnamese.

II. PROCEDURES

There are no procedures associated with this policy.

III. FORMS AND INSTRUCTIONS

OFS 4SR Form / Instructions Simplified Report OFS 13SI Form / Instructions Simplified Reporting Reminder Notice of Incomplete Filing OFS 13SN Form / Instructions Simplified Reporting Reminder Notice OFS 13SO Form / Instructions Simplified Reporting System Notice ***
